raw.description:
The Senior Technical Integration Specialist plays a pivotal part in onboarding new practices’ clinical data, new payers' claims data, and managing technical implementation projects with healthcare vendors. The Sr. Technical Integration Specialist is responsible for supporting data integration efforts, managing system deployments, and ensuring successful go-live of AI and data-driven solutions in a complex healthcare environment.

What you'll be doing

  • Acting as the technical point of contact for both external and internal stakeholders during the onboarding and implementation process.
  • Managing, coordinating, and executing data integration and tech integration projects, including EMR integrations, third-party vendor integrations, data retrievals, API connections, and SFTP data feeds with vendors.
  • Facilitating conversations between internal and external tech and business stakeholders, designing, documenting and presenting data flow diagrams, and project managing integrations to ensure successful and smooth delivery of the end results.
  • Translating clinical and operational requirements into technical configurations and workflows.
  • Creating and maintaining integration documentation including technical specifications, workflow and processes diagrams, implementation guides, and SOPs.
  • Performing data QA and validation activities, including executing scripts and manual checks for data format, completeness, and accuracy.
  • Troubleshooting and resolving integration issues, coordinating with engineering, vendor, or client teams as needed.
  • Managing go-live planning, execution, maintenance and provide post-implementation support.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED FOR SUCCESS

  • Bachelor’s degree in quantitative or technical field such as Computer Science, Health Informatics, Information Systems, Statistics, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in a technical implementation, data integration, or data analytics in the healthcare industry.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare data formats and standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, CCDA, XML, JSON)
  • Familiarity with clinical vocabularies and coding systems (e.g., CPT, ICD-10, SNOMED, NPI, RXNORM).
  • Extensive experience working with data and technical integration projects that includes ETL pipeline, data normalization/processing, SFTP, and API connections
  • Proficiency with cross-team project tracking/documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence
  • Experience with data QA and validation processes.
  • Familiarity in SQL, Python, and Bash for data querying and script execution
  • Proven experience in leading technical implementation projects in healthcare, including client or vendor onboarding.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS (S3, Lambda, Step Functions), GCP, or Azure.
  • Understanding of healthcare workflows (e.g., care management, risk adjustment, quality improvement, revenue cycle, prior authorizations, value-based care).
  • Strong communication and presentation skills for interfacing with clinical and technical stakeholders.

WHAT WE'D LOVE FOR YOU TO HAVE

  • Fluency in SQL
  • Fluency in Python
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with building API endpoints for data transfer
  • Familiarity with the Arcadia Analytics Foundry database schema
  • Experience using source control software (e.g. GitHub, CVS, Subversion) throughout a software development lifecycle for production

The base pay range for this role is between $100,000.00 to $115,000.00 per year based upon experience and qualifications.

ALIVE with Purpose: How We Thrive at Guidehealth

At Guidehealth, our values come to life in everything we do.

  • We are Driven by Accountability — grounded in transparency, reliability, and integrity as we navigate challenges and opportunities alike.
  • Always Growing, Always Learning — staying curious and continuously improving inspires us to shape a better future for healthcare.
  • With Collaborative Innovation, we solve problems creatively, making every experience better for our employees and the patients we serve.
  • At Guidehealth, Every Voice Matters — we believe our collective strength is rooted in the unique perspectives of each team member.
  • And through Empathy in Action, we build stronger connections with those who count on us.
  • This is what it means to be ALIVE with purpose. This is how we thrive — together — at Guidehealth.

BENEFITS:

While you are hard at work advancing value-based healthcare, we are here to ensure YOU have the care you and your family need and the opportunities for growth and development. Our commitments to you include:

  • Work from Home: Guidehealth is a fully remote company, providing you the flexibility to spend less time commuting and more time focusing on your professional goals and personal needs.
  • Keep Health a Priority: We offer comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans to keep you covered.
  • Plan for the Future: Our 401(k) plan includes a 3% employer match to your 6% contribution.
  • Have Peace of Mind: We provide Life and Disability insurance for those "just in case" moments. Additionally, we offer voluntary Life options to keep you and your loved ones protected.
  • Feel Supported When You Need It Most: Our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) is here to help you through tough times.
  • Take Time for Yourself: We offer paid time off plans helping you achieve work-life balance and meet your personal goals.
  • Support Your New Family: Welcoming a new family member takes time and commitment. Guidehealth offers paid parental leave to give you the time you need.
  • Learn and Grow: Your professional growth is important to us. Guidehealth offers various resources dedicated to your learning and development to advance your career with us.

All full-time employees of Guidehealth who work 30 hours per week or more are eligible for our comprehensive benefits package. Temporary employees and contractors are not eligible for benefits.

COMPENSATION:

The listed compensation range listed is paid bi-weekly per our standard payroll practices. Final base pay decisions are dependent upon a variety of factors which may include, but are not limited to: skill set, years of relevant experience, education, location, and licensure/certifications.

OUR COMMITMENT TO EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYMENT

Diversity, inclusion, and belonging are at the core of Guidehealth’s values. We are an equal opportunity employer. We enthusiastically accept our responsibility to make employment decisions without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation and identity, national origin, citizenship, religion, marital status, familial status, physical, sensory, or medical disability, Family and Medical Leave, military or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth or other related medical conditions, or any other classification protected by federal, state, and local laws and ordinances. Our management is fully dedicated to ensuring the fulfillment of this policy with respect to hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, termination, recruitment advertising, pay, and other forms of compensation, training, and general treatment during employment. 

OUR COMITTMENT TO PROTECTION OF PATIENT AND COMPANY DATA

This position is responsible for following all Security policies and procedures in order to protect all PHI and PII under Guidehealth’s custodianship as well as Guidehealth Intellectual Properties. For any security-specific roles, the responsibilities would be further defined by the hiring manager.

As a remote-first organization handling sensitive healthcare data, Guidehealth verifies candidate identity at multiple stages of the hiring and onboarding to safeguard patient privacy, data security, and compliance requirements.

REMOTE WORK TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Guidehealth is a fully remote company. We provide new employees with the necessary equipment to function in their role at no charge to the employee. Employees provide their own internet connection, capable of conducting video calls on camera and connecting to various internal and external systems. The required internet speed is a minimum of 100 mbps download, 10 mbps upload. Please run a speed test here to confirm your internet connection meets these requirements.

SECONDARY EMPLOYMENT

At Guidehealth, we value transparency and collaboration as part of our commitment to excellence. As your primary employer, we kindly ask all team members to disclose any secondary employment, regardless of whether it may present a potential conflict of interest.

To ensure smooth teamwork and availability, employees must be accessible during our stated working hours. We foster connection and engagement by asking team members to join virtual meetings with their cameras on.

WHO IS GUIDEHEALTH?

Guidehealth is a data-powered, performance-driven healthcare company dedicated to operational excellence. Our goal is to make great healthcare affordable, improve the health of patients, and restore the fulfillment of practicing medicine for providers. Driven by empathy and powered by AI and predictive analytics, Guidehealth leverages remotely-embedded Healthguides™ and a centralized Managed Service Organization to build stronger connections with patients and providers. Physician-led, Guidehealth empowers our partners to deliver high-quality healthcare focused on outcomes and value inside and outside the exam room for all patients. 

As a growing and innovative organization, we operate with a high degree of agility. Employees are expected to adapt to evolving business needs, step in to support cross-functional initiatives, and contribute beyond traditional role boundaries when needed. This collaborative and flexible mindset is essential to our success. We encourage cross-training, ongoing development, and a commitment to learning across all areas of the business—ensuring we continue to grow and you continue to thrive as a high-performing, mission-driven team.

Join us as we put healthcare on a better path!!

Overview

Join an amazing team that is consistently recognized for our achievements and culture, including our most recent Forbes award of being one of America's Best Midsize Employers for 2026!

Position Summary:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and maintaining complex software systems. This position involves leading agile teams or projects, mentoring junior engineers, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality software solutions.

Geo-Salary Information

An in-person interview may be required during the hiring process

State specific pay scales for this role are as follows:

$94,458 to $179,048 (CA, NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA)

$85,871 to $162,771 (NV, OR, AZ, CO, WY, TX, ND, MN, MO, IL, WI, FL, GA, MI, OH, VA, PA, DE, VT, NH, ME)

$77,283 to $146,464 (UT, ID, MT, NM, SD, NE, KS, OK, IA, AR, LA, MS, AL, TN, KY, IN, SC, NC, WV)

In CA: Typical hiring range is $123,077.70 to $170,941.25

The expected base salary for this position will vary depending on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills and location.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Write high-quality code for complex scenarios with good test coverage.
  • Review and translate product requirements into robust designs to ensure high-quality distributed application systems that are modular, configurable, reusable, fast, effective, user-friendly, secure, compliant, scalable, and maintainable.
  • Lead design and code reviews of multiple applications to ensure best practices, adherence to Mercury standards, and high quality.
  • Lead the sprint team to deliver new or improved features, addressing any impediments to delivering high-quality solutions in the sprint backlog.
  • Collaborate with other teams and stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of intended functionality.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team, fostering a culture of innovation and excellence within Mercury engineering.

Qualifications

Education:

Minimum:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or other related fields OR equivalent combination of education and experience

Preferred:

  • Master’s Degree in Computer Science.

Experience:

Minimum:

  • 5+ years software programming experience with 2+ years experience in Technologies used at Mercury, more than one years experience leading and mentoring engineering teams

Preferred:

  • 6 or more years of experience with Guidewire Policy Center (configurations and integrations)
  • 4 or more years of experience with Java/J2EE
  • 2 or more years of experience utilizing technologies such as Kafka, AWS, S3, Drools, Blaze, etc.
  • 2 or more years of experience with Personal lines products
  • 1 or more years of experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GUnit, etc.

Skills:

  • Proficient in programming in one or more industry-standard languages (e.g., Java, Python, Go, C++, JavaScript).
  • Experienced in leveraging various data structures, algorithms, and design patterns. Skilled in relational databases, NoSQL, and caching solutions.
  • Experienced in APIs using modern protocols like REST and gRPC. Proficient in message queuing, data streaming, workflow, and integration frameworks (such as Apache Kafka, Apache NiFi, Amazon SQS, MS MQ, Apache Camel, etc.).
  • Knowledgeable in microservices architecture.
  • Experienced in containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Proficient in leveraging DevSecOps to improve engineering efficiency.
  • Experienced in designing and implementing high-quality distributed application systems that are modular, configurable, maximize reuse, and are fast, effective, user-friendly, secure, compliant, scalable, and maintainable. Skilled in leveraging analytics data and experimentation to design and improve systems for speed, scalability, and effectiveness. Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication abilities. Strong ability to collaborate and influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders to address impediments and deliver desired results. Demonstrated leadership skills through mentoring and providing technical guidance to team members.
  • Experienced in driving technical strategy and vision for a team.
  • Preferred: Experience in cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.

About the Company

Why choose a career at Mercury?

At Mercury, we have been guided by our purpose to help people reduce risk and overcome unexpected events for more than 60 years. We are one team with a common goal to help others. Everyone needs insurance and we can’t imagine a world without it.

Our team will encourage you to grow, make time to have fun, and work together to make great things happen. We embrace the strengths and values of each team member. We believe in having diverse perspectives where everyone is included, to serve customers from all walks of life.

We care about our people, and we mean it. We reward our talented professionals with a competitive salary, bonus potential, and a variety of benefits to help our team members reach their health, retirement, and professional goals.

Learn more about us here:

Perks and Benefits

We offer many great benefits, including:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexibility to work from anywhere in the United States for most positions
  • Paid time off (vacation time, sick time, 9 paid Company holidays, volunteer hours)
  • Incentive bonus programs (potential for holiday bonus, referral bonus, and performance-based bonus)
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and pet insurance
  • 401 (k) retirement savings plan with company match
  • Engaging work environment
  • Promotional opportunities
  • Education assistance
  • Professional and personal development opportunities
  • Company recognition program
  • Health and wellbeing resources, including free mental wellbeing therapy/coaching sessions, child and eldercare resources, and more

Mercury Insurance is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Pay Range

USD $94,458.00 - USD $179,048.00 /Yr.

raw.description:
Relevant du Directeur principal, PI et innovation SAP ainsi que de la Vice-présidence, livraison pour l’affectation aux mandats, le/la Développeur(euse) Full-Stack et intégration, SAP BTP développe les services, les applications et les intégrations conçus pour les clients de Talan.

Ce rôle est centré sur le développement, les essais et la mise en production de code maintenable. Vous collaborez avec les architectes, les spécialistes fonctionnels et les équipes de soutien afin de transformer les conceptions en composantes sécurisées et observables pouvant être transférées aux opérations.

Votre mission consiste à :

  • Expertise technique et fonctionnelle
    • Développer des services et applications avec le modèle de programmation d’applications infonuagiques SAP, notamment les modèles CDS, les services OData v4, la logique d’affaires, la validation et les autorisations.
    • Créer des interfaces SAP Fiori et SAPUI5, des API et des services reliant les processus SAP et non SAP.
  • Résolution de problèmes et pensée analytique
    • Construire du contenu dans SAP Integration Suite, incluant les flux, transformations, politiques d’API, événements, mécanismes de reprise, alertes et surveillance.
    • Écrire des essais unitaires et d’intégration, participer aux revues de code et maintenir les chaînes d’intégration et de déploiement continus en état de fonctionnement.
  • Excellence opérationnelle
    • Soutenir les essais, la correction des anomalies, la mise en production, la stabilisation et la résolution des causes fondamentales.
  • Collaboration et esprit d’équipe
    • Produire la documentation technique, les guides de déploiement et le matériel de transfert, puis contribuer aux revues de code de manière constructive.
  • Partage des connaissances
    • Enrichir les composantes, modèles et exemples de code réutilisables de la pratique et accompagner l’intégration des nouveaux développeurs.

Job Description

Reporting to the Principal Director, SAP Innovation and IP and the Vice President, Delivery for engagement assignment, the SAP BTP Full-Stack and Integration Developer builds the services, applications, and integrations designed for Talan clients.

This role focuses on building, testing, and shipping maintainable code. You partner with architects, functional specialists, and support teams to turn designs into secure, observable components that can be transferred to operations.

Your mission consists of:

  • Technical and functional expertise
    • Build services and applications with the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model, including CDS models, OData v4 services, business logic, validation, and authorization.
    • Create SAP Fiori and SAPUI5 interfaces, APIs, and services that connect SAP and non-SAP processes.
  • Problem solving and analytical thinking
    • Build content in SAP Integration Suite, including flows, mappings, API policies, events, retry logic, alerting, and monitoring.
    • Write unit and integration tests, participate in code review, and keep continuous integration and deployment pipelines healthy.
  • Operational excellence
    • Support testing, defect resolution, cutover, stabilization, and root-cause correction.
  • Collaboration and team mindset
    • Produce technical documentation, deployment guides, and handover material, and contribute constructive code reviews.
  • Knowledge sharing
    • Expand the practice’s reusable components, templates, and code samples, and support the onboarding of new developers.
  • Expérience : Minimum de six (6) ans en développement logiciel, dont au moins trois (3) ans sur SAP BTP.
  • Expertise CAP : Minimum de trois (3) ans avec Node.js ou Java, modélisation CDS et conception de services OData v4.
  • Développement d’interfaces : Minimum de trois (3) ans avec SAPUI5 et Fiori Elements, JavaScript ou TypeScript, SQL et SAP HANA Cloud.
  • Intégration et sécurité : Minimum de deux (2) ans avec SAP Integration Suite, incluant un scénario événementiel, ainsi qu’une expérience pratique avec XSUAA, destinations, connectivité sur site et propagation du principal.
  • Formation : Baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, technologies de l’information ou domaine connexe.
  • Conditions : Poste à distance au Canada; déplacements occasionnels, généralement inférieurs à 15 % du temps.
  • Communication : Avoir de bonnes aptitudes en communication orale et écrite, en français et en anglais afin notamment de communiquer avec une clientèle située partout en Amérique du Nord.

Atouts

  • ABAP Cloud et RAP, SAP Build Apps, SAP Build Process Automation, Kyma, conteneurs, Kubernetes ou Python.
  • Certification SAP BTP Extensions with CAP, Integration Suite, Fiori ou ABAP Cloud.

Qualifications

  • Experience: At least six (6) years in software development, including at least three (3) years on SAP BTP.
  • CAP expertise: At least three (3) years with Node.js or Java, CDS modelling, and OData v4 service design.
  • Interface development: At least three (3) years with SAPUI5 and Fiori Elements, JavaScript or TypeScript, SQL, and SAP HANA Cloud.
  • Integration and security: At least two (2) years with SAP Integration Suite, including an event-driven scenario, plus hands-on experience with XSUAA, destinations, on-premises connectivity, and principal propagation.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Conditions: Canada-based remote role; occasional travel, typically under 15% of working time.
  • Communication: Good oral and written communication skills, in French and English, to communicate with clients located across North America.

Assets

  • SAP enterprise architecture, TOGAF, SAP LeanIX, cloud architecture, or SAP Activate certification.
  • Experience with RISE with SAP, mergers and acquisitions, or assessing SAP AI and agentic capabilities

Quels sont les avantages de vous joindre à nous ?

En plus de faire partie d'une équipe professionnelle et dynamique, vous aurez droit à nos différents éléments de compensation et autres avantages, mais surtout la chance de travailler avec une équipe formidable.

Tout ce que vous méritez et plus encore :

  • Développement professionnel;
  • Partage des profits;
  • Régime d’assurances collectives dès le premier jour;
  • RPDB, Régime de participation différée aux bénéfices;
  • Travail flexible en mode hybride;
  • Allocation pour le transport en commun et le téléphone cellulaire;
  • Une généreuse participation de l’employeur à votre REER collectif.

Talan offre des salaires concurrentiels et des chances égales pour tous. Si vous êtes motivés à relever des défis stimulants et répondez aux exigences, faites-nous parvenir votre curriculum vitae dès maintenant !

Notez que nous ne communiquerons qu'avec les candidatures retenues pour une entrevue. Au sens de la présente offre d'emploi, le genre féminin et le genre masculin désignent indistinctement le personnel des deux sexes et n'établissent aucune distinction particulière basée sur le sexe.

Talan souscrit au principe d'équité en matière d'emploi.

Additional Information

What about the advantages of joining us?

Aside from joining a professional and dynamic team, you will be entitled to our compensation plan and various other benefits, as well as the opportunity to be part of a talented team.

All that you deserve and more:

  • Professional development;
  • Profit sharing;
  • Health and well-being insurance from your first day;
  • Deferred Profit-Sharing Plan (DPSP);
  • Flexible hybrid work;
  • Public transit and cell phone allowance;
  • Generous employer contributions to your group RRSP.

Talan offers competitive salaries and equal opportunities for all. If you are motivated to take on stimulating challenges and meet the requirements, send us your resume now!

Please note that we will only communicate with candidates selected for an interview. For the purposes of this job offer, the feminine and masculine genders designate indistinctly the staff of both sexes and do not establish any distinction based on sex.

Talan is committed to employment equity.

Talan is an international group that supports its clients in their end-to-end Data & AI transformation by combining management consulting with technological expertise.

With over 6,000 employees across five continents, we accelerate our clients' transformations through long-term partnerships, creating measurable and sustainable impact.

Our value proposition is built on a structured innovation ecosystem: 2,500 Data & AI experts, proprietary solutions built on advanced models, and an applied research, experimental development, and innovation laboratory.

In Americas, our multidisciplinary teams bring over 30 years of experience helping business leaders across key industries achieve measurable performance and strong ROI, designing, building, and scaling solutions that enable companies to grow more efficiently.

raw.description:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.
Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.
We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

This is a foundational engineering role. You will own a critical domain of the platform on which Agiloft's CLM product is built as one of a small team of staff engineers who each own a core part of the platform and shape its direction together. This is a backend- and distributed-systems–weighted position with deep ownership of your domain and end-to-end accountability for its design, scalability, reliability, and security as the product and customer base grow.

You will work across the organization with engineering leaders, senior engineers, product leaders, and partner teams to understand where the product is going, translate business and product goals into durable platform architectures, and align diverse stakeholders on the technical direction. This means, you will set architectural direction alongside a peer group of staff engineers of your caliber. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines deep backend and cloud expertise with the influence to drive architecture across functional boundaries.

Job Responsibilities

    DATA MODEL & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE

  • Own the canonical data models and service boundaries in your domain
  • Design models and boundaries that let independent systems evolve in parallel without duplicating logic or creating competing implementations
  • Evolve the platform through additive, backward-compatible changes that introduce new capabilities without disrupting existing behavior.
  • Own the architecture of one or more critical platform domains, with responsibility for design integrity, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term technical health.

    • DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS & CLOUD ARCHITECTURE (AWS)

  • Design AWS-native, event-driven and asynchronous services that scale on demand, degrade gracefully under load, and remain cost-efficient as volume grows.
  • Architect the backend to enable and support AI/ML workloads at scale with a focus on performance, scalability and cost efficiency.
  • Act as architectural steward for these services, keeping them scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable as customer and platform demands grow.
  • Drive cloud-native design principles: stateless services, managed-service adoption, and failure-tolerant, self-healing architectures.

    • SECURITY & MULTI-TENANCY

  • Treat tenant isolation, authentication, and authorization as first-class design concerns across every service and API you own.
  • Design secure authentication and token-handling flows, permission-aware data access, and safe credential management for an enterprise, multi-tenant platform.
  • Design for correct, isolated behavior across tenant, environment, and data-residency boundaries, and reason explicitly about security posture and blast radius when centralizing sensitive capabilities.

    • TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL INFLUENCE

  • Partner with product- and engineering leaders to develop a deep understanding of customer and business needs and translate them into platform architectures that solve the problem
  • Lead the technical design of major platform initiatives end to end, and drive alignment across teams and functions whose priorities and incentives do not always converge.
  • Integrate diverse stakeholders and project teams around a shared technical direction, navigating differing functional interests with sound judgment and strong interpersonal skill.
  • Produce clear, rigorous design documents, service contracts, and acceptance criteria that others can review, build on, and trust, setting the standard for technical design on the team.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate and sharpen design and implementation, applying the judgment to know where they add leverage and where deeper thinking is required.
  • Lead by example in applying AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate architecture, design, implementation, and testing, using sound technical judgment to amplify productivity without compromising quality, maintainability, or depth of thinking.

    • API DESIGN

  • Design clean, versioned API contracts on top of the platform's data models — including high-scale bulk and asynchronous operations — with deterministic behavior, idempotency, structured error handling, and well-defined limits.
  • Establish contract tests and permission-enforcement validation as first-class parts of every API you design.

    • DELIVERY & ENGINEERING EXCELLENCE

  • Own initiatives end to end from design through release, with accountability for product quality in your domain and high standards for reliability, security, observability, performance, scalability, usability, and cost across the services you own
  • Champion modern practices: infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, continuous delivery, and observability-by-default
  • Lead platform-modernization and refactoring initiatives while maintaining delivery velocity and improve the developer experience for the services you own.
  • Identify and drive improvements to how the engineering organization designs and delivers

This role is ideal for a project management professional who combines strong delivery leadership with business analysis and Agile facilitation skills. The Project Manager will partner closely with customers, stakeholders, and delivery teams to gather business requirements, prioritize work, manage project execution, and ensure successful outcomes aligned with organizational goals.

raw.description:
About MedeAnalytics

MedeAnalytics is the Enterprise Healthcare Performance company that delivers AI-driven, cloud-native solutions to help payers, risk-bearing providers and other value- and risk-bearing entities measurably improve performance by reducing costs, improving quality and MLR, optimizing utilization, increasing reimbursement, and elevating care quality across all lines of business. Its enterprise health data management platform—built on its proprietary Health Fabric™—unifies clinical, claims, financial, and social data into a single, scalable source of truth that fuels insights, action, and AI.

As the industry’s healthcare intelligence partner of choice for more than 30 years, MedeAnalytics combines its platform, cross-domain enterprise analytics, AI-powered workflows, and Strategic Advisory™ services to transform intelligence into accountable execution—delivering greater ROI across value-based care, risk and quality, cost and utilization management, and network optimization.

MedeAnalytics empowers organizations to move faster from insight to impact with confidence and measurable results. To learn more, visit medeanalytics.com and follow MedeAnalytics on LinkedIn and Facebook.

About Our Opportunity

Core Requirement

This role requires a proven strategic payer sales leader with demonstrated success selling and expanding enterprise solutions with health plans, primary focus in Medicare Advantage and Medicaid, secondarily in Commercial markets. The ideal candidate understands the distinct business, regulatory, operational, and market dynamics of each line of business and can translate payer priorities into credible executive-level strategies that drive measurable growth.

Position Overview

The Vice President, Payer Growth is responsible for generating new business and expanding strategic health plan relationships within an assigned territory and account portfolio. This leader will develop territory and account strategies, build trusted relationships with payer executives, identify and quantify whitespace, and lead complex enterprise sales opportunities from initial engagement through contract execution.

A key focus of the role is creating a comprehensive growth strategy for an existing portfolio of health plan clients, meaning accelerate cross-sell opportunities; and pursuing new logo opportunities with national, regional, State sponsored, and other risk-bearing payers.

The successful candidate will connect payer priorities—including affordability, healthcare economics, risk and quality performance, value-based care, population health, member engagement, customer and group reporting, AI, and enterprise data strategy to the MedeAnalytics Health Performance Platform and broader solution portfolio. This individual must be equally effective as an enterprise seller, strategic account leader, healthcare advisor, and cross-functional team orchestrator.

Key Responsibilities

New Business and Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute a territory growth strategy across Medicare Advantage and Medicaid.
  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline through executive relationships, market intelligence, targeted prospecting, partnerships, and industry engagement.
  • Create account-specific strategies for priority health plans, including relationship maps, business hypotheses, solution alignment, and pursuit plans.
  • Lead consultative conversations that connect payer business priorities to MedeAnalytics' data, analytics, AI, workflow, and advisory capabilities.
  • Manage complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery and solution development through executive presentations, RFPs, commercial negotiations, and contract execution.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed annual new-logo, expansion, ARR, and revenue targets.

Strategic Account Expansion

  • Serve as the commercial growth leader for an assigned portfolio of existing health plan clients.
  • Partner with Account Management to develop and execute strategic growth and success plans for each priority account.
  • Build a deep understanding of each client's strategy, operating model, technology and analytics environment, financial objectives, transformation initiatives, and competitive landscape.
  • Identify and quantify whitespace across the MedeAnalytics portfolio and convert it into actionable near- and long-term opportunities.
  • Expand relationships beyond current users and buyers by developing executive sponsorship across business, clinical, financial, technology, analytics, and operational functions.
  • Lead the commercial strategy for expansions, cross-sells, and upsells, positioning MedeAnalytics as a long-term enterprise partner.
  • Coordinate executive sponsorship and internal resources around the highest-value growth opportunities.

Territory and Market Leadership

  • Maintain a comprehensive territory plan covering current clients, priority prospects, market dynamics, competitive positioning, and revenue potential.
  • Apply a strong understanding of the distinct priorities of Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, dual-eligible, and commercial health plans to shape relevant executive conversations and growth strategies.
  • Monitor payer trends, policy changes, competitive activity, and emerging client needs, translating market intelligence into commercial opportunities.
  • Represent MedeAnalytics at industry conferences, client events, executive meetings, and other payer forums.
  • Establish MedeAnalytics as a strategic thought partner—not solely a technology or analytics vendor—with health plan leadership.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Operating Discipline

  • Serve as the commercial lead for assigned strategic accounts, coordinating Account Management, Product, Marketing, Solution Consulting, Services, Partnerships, and executive leadership.
  • Translate client needs and market intelligence into actionable input for product strategy, partnerships, messaging, and go-to-market priorities.
  • Collaborate with solution and product leaders to develop compelling business cases tied to measurable clinical, financial, operational, and member outcomes.
  • Lead regular account and territory reviews focused on pipeline, client health, revenue risk, whitespace, relationship coverage, and next actions.
  • Maintain disciplined opportunity management, forecasting, account planning, and CRM hygiene.

Measures of Success

  • New-logo ARR and revenue
  • Expansion ARR and revenue from existing clients
  • Qualified pipeline creation, progression, and conversion
  • Growth of MedeAnalytics' footprint within strategic accounts
  • Executive relationship depth and breadth
  • Strategic account and territory plan execution
  • Forecast accuracy
  • Client advocacy and referenceability
  • Achievement of annual territory revenue objectives

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 10+ years of successful enterprise sales, strategic account growth, or business development experience in healthcare technology, analytics, SaaS, consulting, or related solutions serving health plans.
  • Demonstrated sales and account-expansion success across Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and commercial health plan markets.
  • Strong understanding of the distinct economics, regulatory requirements, operating models, purchasing dynamics, and strategic priorities of government-sponsored and commercial health plans.
  • Proven ability to originate, develop, and close complex, multi-million-dollar enterprise opportunities.
  • Experience developing and expanding relationships with large national, regional, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and/or provider-sponsored health plans.
  • Strong understanding of payer priorities, including affordability, medical cost management, value-based care, risk adjustment, quality, population health, network performance, member engagement, and enterprise analytics.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare data, including medical and pharmacy claims, clinical, financial, eligibility, provider, and social risk data.
  • Ability to engage credibly with C-suite and senior executives across business, clinical, financial, operational, technology, and analytics functions.
  • Experience navigating complex RFPs, procurement processes, contracting, and enterprise decision-making environments.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority.
  • Highly self-directed, with the discipline to manage a large territory and portfolio of complex strategic accounts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Established executive relationships within the U.S. payer market.
  • Experience selling enterprise healthcare data platforms, analytics, AI, population health, value-based care, quality, risk, or financial performance solutions.
  • Understanding of modern healthcare data architecture, cloud platforms, interoperability, AI/ML, and enterprise analytics environments.
  • Experience helping health plans unify fragmented data and analytics environments or expand enterprise adoption of a strategic platform.
  • Demonstrated payer-market thought leadership and the ability to represent MedeAnalytics credibly with senior industry executives.

Leadership Profile

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. The ideal candidate will bring strong commercial ownership, strategic thinking, and executive relationship-building skills to manage their territory and account portfolio as a trusted partner to health plan leaders.

Additional Information:

MedeAnalytics believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is $165,000 - $195,000 USD + commission opportunities. Please note that actual compensation for all roles may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, relevant work experience, professional achievements/qualifications, skill level, business need, location and will be finalized at the time of offer.

Benefits Include:

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage – Effective the first of the month following your start date
  • Company-Paid Life & AD&D Insurance, plus Short-Term and Long-Term Disability (STD/LTD)
  • Company-Paid Employee Assistance Program (EAP) premium tier for your wellbeing
  • 401(k) Plan with company match
  • Paid Holidays and Paid Time Off (PTO)Accruals
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program
  • Professional Development Opportunities to support your growth
  • And More!

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where this position is located; we are unable to provide or transfer sponsorship.

MedeAnalytics values committed, inspired, and passionate team members. If you’re looking to make an impact doing work that matters, you’re in the right place. Help us shape the future of healthcare by joining #TeamMede.

Important notices:

  • We do not use outside vendors/agencies — please no unsolicited calls or invites.

  • All MedeAnalytics job opportunities are posted exclusively on our Careers Page or trusted partner job boards. Any other communications claiming to be from us are not legitimate. Always verify opportunities before sharing personal or financial information.

raw.description:
The NetSuite Administrator exists to own, operate, and continuously improve Omilia's Oracle NetSuite ERP environment — a complex OneWorld setup spanning four legal entities with multi-currency, multi-book accounting, ARM-driven revenue recognition, and live Greek fiscal compliance. This role is the single point of technical accountability for NetSuite at Omilia, sitting at the intersection of Finance operations and enterprise systems. The successful individual works autonomously as a trusted partner to Finance, Engineering, and external auditors, ensuring the system is always audit-ready, integrated, and aligned to business needs.

Accountabilities

  • Own and govern the NetSuite ERP environment end-to-end, including system health, change control, and continuous improvement across all subsidiaries.
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of multi-book accounting, intercompany transactions, and consolidated financial reporting in NetSuite OneWorld.
  • Maintain and evolve the Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) module to support compliant, audit-ready revenue recognition under IFRS 15 / ASC 606.
  • Act as the primary technical owner of NetSuite integrations, ensuring reliable data flow between NetSuite and billing, CRM, and payroll platforms.
  • Sustain audit readiness across SOC 2, PCI-DSS, and statutory frameworks by maintaining system documentation, access controls, and change evidence.
  • Drive NetSuite development and improvement projects, liaising with implementation partners and evaluating SuiteApps to expand system capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage user roles, permissions, and access controls across all subsidiaries within the OneWorld environment.
  • Maintain and improve saved searches, custom reports, dashboards, and KPIs for Finance and Leadership stakeholders.
  • Administer accounting period opens/closes and coordinate month-end and year-end system tasks.
  • Configure and maintain Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) — Revenue Arrangements, Revenue Elements, and Recognition Rules — for SaaS subscription contracts.
  • Troubleshoot revenue recognition discrepancies across primary and secondary accounting books.
  • Administer multi-book accounting setup (primary EUR/USD and secondary EUR/USD books) and monitor intercompany transaction matching, elimination entries, and FX postings.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot integrations between NetSuite and third-party platforms including billing, CRM, and payroll systems.
  • Build and maintain saved searches, SuiteQL queries, and workflows to automate Finance operations.
  • Support the myDATA integration for Greek VAT and fiscal reporting compliance.
  • Maintain change logs, system documentation, and control evidence for internal and external auditors.
  • Lead or participate in NetSuite improvement and implementation projects, and evaluate SuiteApps or third-party tools to expand capabilities.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on NetSuite administration experience.
  • Proven experience with NetSuite OneWorld in a multi-subsidiary, multi-currency environment — non-negotiable.
  • Strong working knowledge of NetSuite multi-book accounting (primary and secondary books).
  • Experience configuring the Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) module.
  • Proficiency in SuiteQL for custom reporting and data extraction.
  • Solid understanding of accounting fundamentals: debits/credits, intercompany eliminations, FX revaluation.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a remote setup.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to have:

  • SuiteScript 2.x experience for workflow automation and scripting.
  • IFRS 15 / ASC 606 revenue recognition in a SaaS context.
  • IFRS 16 lease accounting in NetSuite.
  • Fixed Asset Management (FAM) module experience.
  • Experience integrating NetSuite with billing platforms such as Nue, Zuora, or Salesforce CPQ.
  • Exposure to Greek myDATA or similar e-invoicing and fiscal reporting integrations.
  • NetSuite Administrator or SuiteFoundation certification.
  • NetSuite SuiteAnalytics Workbook experience.
  • Background in enterprise SaaS or PE-backed technology environments.

Omilia Note

- Contribute actively and effectively as an integrated team member.
- Act as an Omilia ambassador in all interactions.

Benefits

  • Fixed compensation;
  • Long-term employment with the working days vacation;
  • Development in professional growth (courses, training, etc);
  • Being part of successful cutting-edge technology products that are making a global impact in the service industry;
  • Proficient and fun-to-work-with colleagues;
  • Apple gear

Omilia is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that embracing diversity in all its forms enriches our workplace and drives our collective success. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels welcomed, valued, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives without regard to factors such as race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, heredity, disability, age, or veteran status, all eligible candidates will be given consideration for employment.

We're building a new mobile application on PHP and React Native, and we're looking for an engineer who can help shape it while keeping our existing web application stable and reliable for the customers who depend on it every day.

This is a hands-on role that balances two tracks: building new mobile-facing functionality and APIs, and investigating defects, troubleshooting production issues, and making incremental improvements to an existing vanilla PHP codebase. You'll work closely with Product, QA, and Support to resolve issues and ensure consistent behavior across web and mobile. This role is ideal for an experienced PHP engineer who is energized by modernization work but can also dive into legacy systems - someone who enjoys understanding complex business logic and knows that a stable foundation is what makes new development possible.

This is a remote position, but candidates must be located in LATAM.


Key Responsibilities & Deliverables

Mobile & Platform Development

  • Help stand up our new React Native mobile application, from project setup through first release.
  • Build and extend the PHP APIs and services that power it.
  • Help define how the mobile app integrates with existing systems.
  • Establish patterns and conventions for mobile development that the team will build on as it grows.
  • Own features and components end to end, from design discussion through development and release
  • Identify opportunities to modernize patterns in the existing codebase as new work touches them.

Application Stability & Bug Resolution

  • Investigate, diagnose, and resolve bugs in a vanilla PHP application.
  • Debug complex issues across application logic, database interactions, and integrations.
  • Deliver safe, well-tested fixes that minimize regression risk.
  • Analyze logs, error reports, and monitoring data to identify root causes.
  • Collaborate with QA and Support to reproduce reported issues and validate fixes.
  • Assist with performance improvements and reliability enhancements.

Engineering Practices

  • Participate actively in code reviews and technical discussions.
  • Apply agreed-upon standards for code quality, testing, and deployment.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or something similar) to accelerate development, testing, and documentation.
  • Contribute incremental improvements to shared utilities or internal tooling.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience working as a PHP engineer delivering production software.
  • Hands-on React Native experience, including at least one application shipped to the App Store and/or Google Play.
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs that service web or mobile clients.
  • Demonstrated ability to debug and fix issues in large or legacy codebases.
  • Solid understanding of relational databases and SQL.
  • Solid understanding of modern development practices, including version control (Git), CI/CD, and automated testing.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote role and switching context between new development and production support.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, especially when tracing complex bugs.
  • Experience using AI-assisted coding tools as part of daily development workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with PHP applications that integrate with third-party APIs.
  • Experience incrementally modernizing legacy systems without disrupting production.
  • Understanding of secure coding practices and data integrity concerns.
  • Familiarity with mobile-specific concerns such as offline behavior, push notifications, or app release cycles.

$3,000—$3,500 USD

raw.description:
*Dutch speaking*

Wil jij jouw ervaring in klantcontact inzetten voor dossiers waarin niet altijd direct duidelijk is wie er aansprakelijk is? Als Klantenservice Medewerker Aansprakelijkheidsverzekeringen bij KCD behandel je uiteenlopende en soms complexe situaties. Je onderzoekt wat er precies is gebeurd, duikt in polisvoorwaarden en wet- en regelgeving en maakt vervolgens zelfstandig een goed onderbouwde beslissing.

Geen standaard antwoorden, maar dossiers waarin jouw beoordelingsvermogen en aanpak écht het verschil maken. Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid om situaties van A tot Z te behandelen en hebt daarbij oog voor zowel de inhoud als de impact op de klant.

De rol

Als Klantenservice Medewerker Aansprakelijkheidsverzekeringen behandel je klantvragen en dossiers waarbij aansprakelijkheid niet altijd direct duidelijk is. Je brengt de situatie zorgvuldig in kaart, verzamelt de benodigde informatie en beoordeelt op basis van de feiten, polisvoorwaarden en geldende wet- en regelgeving wat de juiste afhandeling is.

Je krijgt bijvoorbeeld een klant aan de lijn die als vriendendienst de badkamer bij zijn buurman betegelt, maar daarbij per ongeluk het nieuwe bad beschadigt. Of een klant belt omdat zijn fiets is gestolen, terwijl deze op slot stond én met een ketting aan een lantaarnpaal was vastgemaakt. In dit soort situaties is het aan jou om de juiste vragen te stellen, de situatie te beoordelen en tot een passende beslissing te komen.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het zelfstandig behandelen van complexe aansprakelijkheidsdossiers van A tot Z;

  • Klanten telefonisch te woord staan en hun situatie zorgvuldig in kaart brengen;

  • Doorvragen en relevante informatie verzamelen om tot een goede beoordeling te komen;

  • Dossiers beoordelen aan de hand van polisvoorwaarden, wet- en regelgeving en de beschikbare feiten;

  • Zelfstandig inhoudelijke beslissingen nemen en deze duidelijk onderbouwen;

  • Klanten op een duidelijke en professionele manier informeren over jouw beslissing;

  • Omgaan met situaties waarin belangen kunnen botsen of bewijsvoering niet direct duidelijk is;

  • Zorgen voor een correcte en zorgvuldige administratieve afhandeling van dossiers.

Naast het behandelen van dossiers werk je samen met collega's aan een goede dienstverlening:

  • Je bespreekt complexe of opvallende casussen met collega's;

  • Je deelt kennis en ervaringen en leert van verschillende situaties;

  • Je ontvangt coaching en feedback om jouw inhoudelijke kennis verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Je denkt mee over het verbeteren van processen en de kwaliteit van de dienstverlening.

In deze functie is geen dossier hetzelfde. Het ene moment ben je bezig met het analyseren van een schade, terwijl je even later met een klant bespreekt waarom een bepaalde beslissing is genomen. Juist de combinatie van klantcontact, inhoudelijke analyse en zelfstandig beslissen maakt deze functie afwisselend.

Dit krijg je

Bij KCD krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen de verzekeringswereld. Je krijgt begeleiding en coaching om steeds meer kennis en ervaring op te doen in aansprakelijkheidsverzekeringen. Naarmate je meer ervaring opdoet, krijg je steeds meer zelfstandigheid in het behandelen van complexe dossiers.

Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

  • Een bruto uurloon van €16,50;

  • Een flexibel contract waarbij je minimaal 28 uur per week werkt (20-28 / 24-32 / 28-36);

  • Werktijden van maandag tot en met vrijdag tussen 08:00 en 18:00 uur;

  • Een opleidingsbudget van €300,- per jaar voor trainingen en cursussen;

  • Een goed geregelde pensioenregeling;

  • Een functie waarin je veel verantwoordelijkheid krijgt en jezelf inhoudelijk kunt ontwikkelen;

  • Een prettige werkomgeving waarin je samenwerkt met collega's en terechtkunt voor vragen en ondersteuning.

Requirements

Dit ben jij

Als Klantenservice Medewerker Aansprakelijkheidsverzekeringen vind je het leuk om situaties uit te pluizen en tot de kern van een probleem te komen. Je stelt de juiste vragen, kunt verschillende belangen tegen elkaar afwegen en durft zelfstandig een beslissing te nemen.

Je vindt het interessant dat niet iedere situatie een standaardoplossing heeft en krijgt energie van dossiers waarin je echt moet nadenken. Tegelijkertijd verlies je de klant niet uit het oog en weet je jouw beslissing op een duidelijke en professionele manier uit te leggen.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • Mbo 4 werk- en denkniveau;

  • Ervaring in klantcontact, bijvoorbeeld binnen een klantenservice- of verzekeringsomgeving;

  • Een sterk analytisch en beoordelend vermogen;

  • Je kunt goed luisteren, doorvragen en hoofd- van bijzaken onderscheiden;

  • Je bent in staat om zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen en deze goed te onderbouwen;

  • Je kunt goed omgaan met verschillende belangen en soms lastige klantgesprekken;

  • Je bent nauwkeurig en kunt goed werken met verschillende systemen en informatiebronnen;

  • Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift;

  • Je bent minimaal 28 uur per week beschikbaar.

Over KCD

Klant Contact Diensten (KCD) verzorgt het klantcontact voor bekende Nederlandse verzekeraars. Vanuit huis of op kantoor help je mensen écht verder; met kennis, aandacht en een luisterend oor. We investeren in jouw ontwikkeling en zorgen ervoor dat je steeds meer kennis en verantwoordelijkheid kunt opbouwen binnen de verzekeringswereld.

In deze functie krijg je de kans om je verder te ontwikkelen in een inhoudelijke rol waarin klantcontact en verzekeringskennis samenkomen. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen en leert iedere dag van nieuwe en uitdagende situaties.

Klaar voor een functie waarin je niet alleen klanten helpt, maar ook écht zelf het verschil maakt? Solliciteer direct en ontdek of deze rol bij jou past!

Overview

LMI is seeking an Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) Engineer to support a Special Operations Command (SOCOM) mission partner with production machine learning, predictive forecasting, natural language processing, generative AI, and real-time decision-support capabilities. The AI/ML Engineer will design, implement, optimize, integrate, and sustain scalable AI/ML solutions within secure web-based applications and enterprise workflows. This position will work as part of a cross-functional data science product team to translate validated models into reliable operational capabilities while advancing reusable engineering patterns, governance, security, documentation, and enterprise AI/ML best practices.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and achieve mission success.

This position requires an active Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, test, and optimize machine learning algorithms for predictive forecasting, rate prediction, resource planning, and real-time decision support.
  • Develop and refine supervised, unsupervised, time-series, regression, ensemble, and other appropriate models to meet stringent accuracy, reliability, explainability, latency, and efficiency requirements.
  • Develop natural language processing and generative AI solutions, including large language models and retrieval-augmented generation capabilities tailored to approved business, operational, and intelligence use cases.
  • Engineer reusable model services, application programming interfaces, containers, and software components that integrate seamlessly into secure web-based applications, dashboards, and other mission data products.
  • Design scalable and reliable architectures for batch and real-time inference, model serving, monitoring, and application support across development, test, and production environments.
  • Integrate predictive models into existing web-based applications and enterprise workflows while ensuring compatibility, reliability, security, and seamless user functionality.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and data engineers to establish compatible data structures, features, pipelines, interfaces, and validation methods for model training, evaluation, deployment, and sustainment.
  • Conduct performance testing, hyperparameter tuning, error analysis, back-testing, drift detection, and model monitoring; document assumptions, limitations, risks, and opportunities for continued improvement.
  • Implement MLOps and DevSecOps practices for source control, automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, model versioning, deployment, monitoring, rollback, and repeatable sustainment.
  • Apply responsible and secure AI/ML engineering practices, including access control, data protection, model governance, explainability, evaluation, auditability, and risk management.
  • Support enterprise synchronization, integration, governance, sustainment, and adoption of AI/ML capabilities across multiple mission teams, stakeholder organizations, applications, and products.
  • Develop projects that automate or augment human cognitive workload and respond rapidly to emerging operational requirements and changes in the mission environment.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation covering algorithms, system architecture, interfaces, security, testing, deployment, operations, and integration processes.
  • Develop user guides, training materials, demonstrations, instructional videos, and knowledge-transfer products sufficient for a qualified practitioner to assume future operation and sustainment of the capability.
  • Provide rapid-response engineering and product-level staff augmentation based on changes in mission priorities and the operational environment.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, software engineering, mathematics, engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Five or more years of professional experience designing, developing, deploying, and sustaining machine learning models or AI-enabled software capabilities in production environments.
  • Advanced proficiency with Python and practical experience with modern machine learning frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, or comparable technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and validating predictive models, including time-series, regression, ensemble, or comparable forecasting methods, against defined accuracy and performance requirements.
  • Experience operationalizing models through application programming interfaces, services, containers, automated testing, version control, continuous integration and delivery, model registries, monitoring, and repeatable deployment processes.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, data structures, feature pipelines, data quality controls, and secure integration with relational, non-relational, object-storage, or analytical data platforms.
  • Experience developing scalable architectures for batch or real-time inference, model serving, application integration, monitoring, and production support.
  • Knowledge of responsible and secure AI/ML engineering practices, including access control, data protection, model governance, explainability, evaluation, auditability, and risk management.
  • Experience producing clear algorithm, architecture, interface, test, deployment, operational, and knowledge-transfer documentation for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across data science, data engineering, software, cybersecurity, governance, and operational teams.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver reliable production capabilities in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, software engineering, mathematics, engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience with secure government cloud environments such as AWS GovCloud or Azure Government and with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, DevSecOps, or comparable production delivery practices.
  • Prior military service or direct professional experience supporting U.S. Special Operations Forces.

Target Competencies

  • Mission Focus
  • Technical Excellence
  • Systems Engineering
  • Product Ownership
  • Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement
  • Clear Communication
  • Adaptability and Continuous Learning

Target Salary Range: $122,000-$211,000

Disclaimer: The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

description: AXON Networks delivers a robust AI-driven, analytics-based orchestration platform and a wide portfolio of next-gen high-speed routers that leverage the newest Wi-Fi technologies.

raw.title: Director of Product Line Management (US - Remote)
raw.excerpt: AXON Networks delivers a robust AI-driven, analytics-based orchestration platform and a wide portfolio of next-gen high-speed routers that leverage the newest Wi-Fi technologies.
raw.description:
AXON Networks delivers a robust AI-driven, analytics-based orchestration platform and a wide portfolio of next-gen high-speed routers that leverage the newest Wi-Fi technologies. Together, these technologies give ISPs the ability to manage and troubleshoot their networks in real time, and to deliver an outstanding customer experience.

AXON Networks is a trusted strategic partner for its customers, helping them evaluate their current technologies and business models, and creating and executing strategies that enable them to innovate faster, accelerate their digital transformations, and strengthen their relationships with consumers.

AXON Networks is headquartered in Irvine, CA USA with Asia HQ in Singapore and also operating in Denmark, Spain and Vietnam.

We are seeking a Director of Product Line Management to define, build, and scale a portfolio of telecom enterprise services and network products. This leader will own the strategy and business performance of offerings that enable enterprises and service providers to connect locations reliably, securely, and at scale - from access devices and Layer 2 switching platforms to Carrier Ethernet and managed connectivity services.

Operating as the general manager for the product line, the Director will translate customer and market requirements into differentiated architectures, investment priorities, roadmaps, launch plans, and lifecycle decisions. The ideal candidate has brought purpose-built products - such as Layer 2 switches, Ethernet NIDs/eNIDs, access platforms, or edge appliances - from concept through certification, scale, and end-of-life, and understands how those platforms become repeatable, SLA-backed services.

What You'll Own

  • Portfolio strategy and P&L: Set the multi-year strategy, market segmentation, investment thesis, pricing, packaging, revenue plan, margin targets, and portfolio rationalization decisions using customer and competitive insight.

  • Product creation: Lead the end-to-end development of Layer 2 switching, Carrier Ethernet demarcation, NID/eNID, access, and edge products, including market requirements, business cases, PRDs, platform choices, feature priorities, release criteria, and lifecycle plans.

  • Enterprise service portfolio: Build scalable services including Ethernet Private Line and Virtual Private Line, E-LAN, DIA access, managed LAN, cloud connectivity, and adjacent secure or assured connectivity offers.

  • Technical and platform direction: Partner with Engineering and Architecture on switching silicon, system architecture, network operating software, optics, timing, power, thermal, security, manageability, and service-assurance requirements.

  • Partner and supply ecosystem: Evaluate and manage chipset, ODM/JDM, contract manufacturing, optics, software, certification, and technology partners; balance cost, differentiation, quality, availability, and roadmap control.

  • Product lifecycle governance: Establish disciplined stage gates from discovery and concept through development, field trials, launch, sustaining engineering, refresh, migration, and end-of-sale/end-of-support.

  • Go-to-market leadership: Define positioning, competitive differentiation, sales plays, solution bundles, enablement, launch readiness, reference customers, and adoption programs with Sales and Marketing.

  • Operational readiness: Ensure products and services are deployable, observable, supportable, and automatable through OSS/BSS, inventory, orchestration, telemetry, assurance, and zero-touch provisioning capabilities.

  • Team leadership: Build, coach, and develop a high-performing product line management team; create clear decision rights, operating rhythms, accountability, and succession plans.

Domain Expertise

Candidates with demonstrated depth across several of the following areas will be strongly preferred:

  • Layer 2 switching: Ethernet switching architectures; VLANs and IEEE 802.1Q; QinQ/802.1ad; LAG and MC-LAG; STP/RSTP/MSTP; LLDP; QoS, buffering, multicast, and resiliency.

  • Carrier Ethernet and MEF services: E-Line/E-LAN/E-Tree service constructs, EPL/EVPL, bandwidth profiles, class of service, service OAM, SLA design, UNI/NNI concepts, and MEF-aligned lifecycle automation.

  • Network demarcation and access: NIDs/eNIDs, CPE/uCPE, fixed and mobile access, multi-rate GbE interfaces, optics, synchronization, timing, and carrier-grade deployment considerations.

  • Hardware and software platforms: Merchant silicon and SDK ecosystems, BSPs, embedded systems, network operating systems, APIs, telemetry, secure boot, software maintenance, component lifecycle, and supply-chain risk.

  • Service assurance and automation: IEEE 802.1ag CFM, ITU-T Y.1731, performance monitoring, fault isolation, zero-touch provisioning, streaming telemetry, orchestration, inventory, and closed-loop assurance.

  • Commercial product management: Market sizing, competitive analysis, portfolio economics, pricing, gross margin, unit cost, forecasting, business cases, channel strategy, and contract or SLA implications.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 12+ years in product management or product line leadership in telecom, networking, or enterprise connectivity, including 5+ years leading teams or major portfolios.

  • Proven product delivery: A record of launching and scaling physical networking products such as Layer 2 switches, NIDs/eNIDs, access devices, routers, or edge appliances, together with software and service capabilities.

  • Business ownership: Demonstrated responsibility for a product line business plan, revenue and margin performance, pricing, roadmap investment, and lifecycle decisions.

  • Technical fluency: Ability to engage credibly with system architects and engineers on hardware, silicon, NOS/software, optics, protocols, APIs, telemetry, and deployment tradeoffs without losing sight of customer and commercial outcomes.

  • Market leadership: Strong understanding of enterprise buyer needs, telecom operator economics, global competitive dynamics, routes to market, and standards-based service delivery.

  • Cross-functional influence: Success aligning Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and external partners around high-stakes product decisions.

  • Executive influence: Exceptional communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics, align senior stakeholders, and drive decisions.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related field; MBA or advanced technical degree preferred.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Growth and economics: Revenue, bookings, adoption, strategic account penetration, gross margin, forecast accuracy, inventory health, and return on product investment.

  • Execution: Roadmap predictability, on-time launch, quality, certification readiness, field-trial conversion, and lifecycle discipline.

  • Customer outcomes: Service availability, SLA performance, deployment velocity, support burden, customer satisfaction, and renewal/expansion.

  • Leadership: Team capability, decision quality, cross-functional alignment, and development of future product leaders.

Why Join Us

  • Build the portfolio: Shape the next generation of enterprise connectivity products and services from architecture through commercial scale.

  • Work across the stack: Unite hardware, software, automation, assurance, and managed services to solve real connectivity problems.

  • Lead with autonomy: Join an entrepreneurial, customer-obsessed organization that values sound judgment, ownership, collaboration, and accountability.

Working Conditions

This is a full-time leadership position operating in a professional office and remote collaboration environment. The role requires flexibility to work across global time zones and to support important customer, partner, launch, or operational matters outside standard business hours when reasonably necessary.

Travel and Physical Requirements

Ability to travel domestically and internationally, typically up to 25-35%, with a valid passport and no material travel restrictions. The role requires extended computer use and periodic visits to offices, laboratories, manufacturing partners, data centers, and customer network sites.

Annual salary range: $220,000 - $320,000

Join AXON Networks!
