Werkstudent:in Statistik (m/w/d)

25 € / Stunde · 20 Stunden / Woche · Möglicher Übergang in Festanstellung nach Studienabschluss · Kleines Team, große Verantwortung

Worum es geht

Wir begleiten Mediziner:innen durch ihre Promotion — von Methodik über Auswertung bis zur fertigen Dissertation. Unsere Klient:innen sind keine Studenten, sondern erwachsene Profis, die liefern müssen.

Als Werkstudent:in arbeitest du direkt an realen Mandaten mit: Du übernimmst statistische Auswertungen, unterstützt bei der Methodendiskussion, prüfst wissenschaftliche Texte und arbeitest dich Schritt für Schritt in eigenständige Klient:innen-Betreuung ein. Das ist keine Kaffeekoch-Werkstudi-Stelle, sondern echte fachliche Verantwortung mit Senior-Backup.

Ehrlich gesagt

Wir sind ein kleines Unternehmen mit hoher Schlagzahl und hoher Effizienz. Wir brauchen sorgfältige, einsatzbereite und mitdenkende Werkstudent:innen, die methodisch sauber arbeiten, lernen wollen und in einem wachsenden Unternehmen Verantwortung übernehmen.

Im Gegenzug bekommst du etwas, das ein typischer Werkstudi-Job nicht bietet: echte Mandate ab Tag 1, direkter Kundenkontakt, sichtbare Wirkung deiner Arbeit, und einen klaren Pfad in eine Festanstellung nach deinem Abschluss — wenn die Leistung stimmt.

Was du machst

  • Statistische Auswertungen in R, Python, SPSS und MAXQDA durchführen — unter Anleitung, mit wachsender Eigenständigkeit

  • Methodenteile in Dissertationen auf Korrektheit und Klarheit prüfen

  • Doktorand:innen einfache Methoden schriftlich und im Gespräch erklären

  • Senior-Berater:innen bei komplexeren Mandaten zuarbeiten

  • Eigene kleinere Mandate übernehmen, sobald du fachlich sicher bist

  • KI- und Automatisierungstools einsetzen, um Auswertungen effizienter zu machen

Was du mitbringst

  • Immatrikuliert in Statistik, Psychologie (empirisch/quantitativ), Sozialwissenschaft (quant), Wirtschaftsmathematik, BWL mit Empirie-Schwerpunkt, Mathematik, Public Health (quantitativ) oder vergleichbar.

  • Bachelor ab dem 4. Semester oder im Master. Frühere Semester nur bei klarem Stats-Tutor-Track.

  • Mindestens 12 Monate verbleibende Studienzeit — wir investieren in dich, und das soll sich lohnen.

  • Aktuelle Statistik-Praxis. Du hast SPSS, R oder Python im letzten Semester konkret benutzt — aus Hausarbeiten, Tutorien, Werkstudent:innenjobs oder eigenen Projekten.

  • Erfahrung im Erklären von Methoden — als Tutor:in, Übungsleiter:in, Studienkreis-Nachhilfelehrer:in, Hilfskraft am Lehrstuhl oder vergleichbar. Wer schon einmal jemandem Statistik ruhig erklärt hat, bringt das wichtigste Soft-Skill mit.

  • Strukturierte, methodische Arbeitsweise. Du planst, bevor du loslegst. Du arbeitest sorgfältig statt hektisch. Du erkennst Inkonsistenzen in Daten oder Texten.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Verbindlichkeit. Du hältst Deadlines ein, lieferst zuverlässig, fragst nach, wenn du nicht weiterkommst — bevor du Tage verlierst.

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau — du musst Texte korrigieren und mit Senior-Klient:innen schriftlich klar kommunizieren.

  • Lust auf Privatwirtschaft, nicht auf Uni-Karriere.

Tutor-/Nachhilfe-Track ist explizit erwünscht — wenn du bereits Studienkreis, Übungsleitung oder vergleichbar gemacht hast, schick uns das mit.

Was wir bieten

  • Vergütung: 25 € / Stunde — deutlich über dem üblichen Werkstudi-Niveau, weil wir Qualität bezahlen

  • Arbeitszeit: 20 Stunden / Woche, flexibel mit dem Studienplan vereinbar

  • Echte Aufgaben: Eigene Mandate, eigene Kund:innen, eigene Auswertungen — kein Hilfsarbeiter:innenkram

  • Mentoring: Persönliche Einarbeitung durch Senior-Berater:innen, Tool-Schulung, Methodendiskussion

  • Profi-Umfeld: MacBook, moderne Tools, KI-Stack — keine Bastellösungen

  • Übergangs-Option: Wer liefert, bekommt nach Studienabschluss ein Übernahmeangebot in Festanstellung

  • Klare Strukturen: Max. 2–3 Personen pro Büro, keine Konzernpolitik, keine Meetings ohne Zweck

Wen wir nicht suchen

Wir suchen keine Werkstudent:innen, die einen CV-Eintrag brauchen und Kaffeekochen aussitzen. Keine Studierenden, die nach Abschluss promovieren oder in der Wissenschaft bleiben wollen. Keine Theoretiker:innen, die sich in Details verlieren, ohne zu liefern. Wer langsam, unzuverlässig oder konfliktscheu ist, wird hier nicht glücklich — und wir auch nicht.

Wir suchen jemanden, der ruhig, methodisch und ergebnisorientiert arbeitet — und für den die Werkstudi-Stelle der erste Schritt in eine ernsthafte Karriere bei uns sein kann.

Bewerbung

Schick uns Lebenslauf, aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung und ein kurzes, persönliches Anschreiben.

  1. Warum du als Werkstudent:in bei uns arbeiten willst — und nicht in einem Konzern oder als Hilfskraft an der Uni.

  2. Was du nach deinem Studienabschluss konkret machen möchtest.

Relevante Arbeiten, Code oder Projektbeispiele gerne dazu.

Unvollständige Bewerbungen sortieren wir aus. Bei passenden Bewerbungen melden wir uns innerhalb von 5 Werktagen.

Job Description:

The Databricks Administrator will be responsible for the administration, configuration, optimization, and support of our Databricks platform. This role will work closely with data engineers, data scientists, analytics teams, and IT security to ensure a secure, reliable, and high-performing environment for data processing, machine learning, and analytics workloads.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT:

Platform Administration & Operations

  • Administer and maintain Databricks workspaces across development, test, and production environments.
  • Configure and manage clusters, pools, jobs, and workflows to support ETL, streaming, and ML workloads.
  • Monitor platform health, capacity, and performance; proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Manage Databricks runtime versions, libraries, and integrations with cloud storage and data services.
  • Implement and maintain backup, recovery, and business continuity procedures for Databricks assets.

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Configure and maintain identity and access management (IAM) roles, groups, and permissions in Databricks.
  • Implement and enforce security best practices, including encryption, network controls, and data access policies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to ensure adherence to organizational and regulatory requirements.
  • Support implementation of data governance standards (e.g., Unity Catalog, catalogs, schemas, tables, and permissions).

Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Optimize cluster configurations, autoscaling, and job scheduling to balance performance and cost.
  • Analyze usage metrics and costs; implement strategies for cost control and chargeback/showback where applicable.
  • Recommend and implement platform tuning and optimization strategies for large-scale data workloads.

Collaboration & Support

  • Partner with data engineers, analysts, and data scientists to understand workload requirements and recommend best practices in Databricks usage.
  • Provide Tier 2/3 support for Databricks-related incidents and service requests.
  • Develop and maintain platform documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
  • Conduct user onboarding, training, and knowledge-sharing sessions on Databricks capabilities and best practices.

Automation & DevOps

  • Automate workspace and cluster provisioning, configuration, and policy enforcement using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation).
  • Integrate Databricks with CI/CD pipelines for code deployment and environment management.
  • Support version control best practices for notebooks, jobs, and configuration.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
Bring your expertise and drive for innovation to GDIT.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
  • Alternative Path: If the candidate does not possess a relevant four-year degree, an additional four years of relevant work experience will be required.

Required Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience administering cloud-based data platforms or big data environments.
  • Hands-on administration experience with Databricks (Azure Databricks / AWS Databricks / GCP Databricks – specify as needed).
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Databricks workspaces, clusters, jobs, pools, and notebooks
    • Cloud storage (e.g., Azure Data Lake Storage, S3, GCS) and networking concepts
    • Identity and access management in the relevant cloud provider (Azure AD / IAM / etc.)
  • Experience with scripting and automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash).
  • Familiarity with Spark concepts (clusters, executors, jobs, partitions) and performance considerations.
  • Demonstrated experience monitoring and troubleshooting platform performance and reliability issues.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to reliability and service quality.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, agile environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Databricks certification(s) (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate/Professional, Lakehouse Fundamentals, Administrator).
  • Experience with:
    • Unity Catalog and fine-grained data access controls
    • CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.)
    • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform strongly preferred)
    • Log aggregation and monitoring tools (Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Delta Lake, structured streaming, and data Lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience in enterprise environments with strong security and compliance needs.

Security Clearance Level:

  • This role will require you to obtain and maintain a Public Trust and will require you to provide onsite fingerprinting at a designated facility. This investigation may review personal and criminal behavior, financial conduct, foreign influence, as well as other adjudications.
  • This position has a U.S. residency requirement. The USPS security clearance process requires the selected candidate to have resided in the U.S. (including U.S. Territories) for the last five years as follows: U.S. Citizens cannot have left the U.S. (including U.S. Territories) for longer than 6 months consecutively in the last 3 years (unless they meet certain exceptions). Non-U.S. Citizens cannot have left the U.S. (including U.S. Territories) for longer than 90 days consecutively in the last 3 years.

raw.description:
Claims Specialty Adjuster II

Say hello to Hagerty

Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do, and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us!

As a Claims Specialty Adjuster II, you will provide efficient and effective disposition of assigned claims through timely investigation, evaluation, and negotiation. This adjuster works well under limited supervision using company best practices. They must execute files within their authority to make appropriate decisions regarding coverage, settlement, and liability. The Specialty Adjuster II handles claims involving fire, theft, vandalism, specialty products, collision (1st and 3rd), shop damage, special investigations and various other comprehensive losses and a variety of complex claims. This position investigates coverage, evaluates, settles damages and effectively resolves claims to conclusion in a timely manner. In this role this adjuster is responsible for taking recorded statements, reviewing policies for coverage, settling claims including total losses, writing Reservation of Rights and Coverage disclaimer letters, when appropriate. The person in this role takes ownership of their personal brand, stays professional and works well individually and within a dynamic team atmosphere.

What you’ll do

  • Makes timely and appropriate contacts with necessary parties, determines, and completes appropriate level of investigation for coverage determination.
  • Determines exposure, establishes adequate initial reserves, and makes timely adjustment to reserve(s) as required.
  • Determines settlement value and negotiates proper settlement of claims within authority. Provides recommendations for settlement and disposition of claims exceeding authority level.
  • Works closely with the Special Investigation Unit (“SIU”) on claim investigations
  • Pursues subrogation when appropriate.
  • Handles first party auto property damage losses and occasionally third-party property damage losses.
  • Demonstrates strong negotiating skills
  • Controls expenses and expense reserves on storage, towing, appraisals, vendors, or legal counsel
  • Problem solves complaints or questions
  • Demonstrating technical learning and skill
  • Exemplifies strategic agility
  • Submit timely large loss reports and occasional Large Loss reporting

Authority/Accountability Level:

  • A Claims Specialty Adjuster II can analyze and determine exposure for fire, theft, vandalism, and a variety of complex claims of varying loss types. This person must exercise discretion to identify and resolve coverage issues, identify and investigate potential fraud, and settle losses as appropriate. A Claims Specialty Adjuster II will process approximately 500-700 lines annually and is responsible for reporting out to various departments within the business.

This Job Is Responsible for Producing the Following Results:

  • Maintaining stellar customer service tracked through company metrics
  • Handles claims for fire, vandalism, theft, complex coverage in personal lines and working in tandem with the SIU to complete thorough investigations in order to determine coverage, liability, and settlement
  • Meets or exceeds individual goals to help the department reach its targets
  • Making appropriate coverage and/or settlement decisions
  • Setting timely reserves
  • Consistently produces quality work product
  • Analyzes facts to justify the assistance of SIU, engineers, investigators, or legal counsel
  • Ability to take quality recorded statements from many parties
  • Identifies Red Flags
  • Ability to write accurate Reservation of Rights letters and Coverage declinations
  • Manages expenses
  • Pursues recovery as applicable
  • Fueling engagement within the team and department

This might describe you

  • Must be detail oriented and show a high level of accuracy
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Knowledgeable in insurance products and expertise
  • Exercise decisiveness and execution within their authority
  • Must have ability to work individually and as a team
  • Ability to maintain confidential information
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Strong time management and organizational ability
  • Must possess a keen interest in self-development
  • Needs to be reliable, accountable, and trustworthy
  • Must be able to motivate and lead others
  • Demonstrate proficiencies with computer software & multitasking
  • Must maintain impeccable attendance
  • Must be licensed and bondable

Other things to note

  • This position is open to U.S. remote work. However, team members who reside within 20 miles of the Traverse City headquarters will follow a hybrid schedule, working from the office three days per week.
  • Familiarity with public company requirements, including Sarbanes Oxley and key regulations, if applicable. For SOX compliant roles, responsible for designing, executing, and documenting internal controls where they have been identified as owners to prevent errors in financial reporting, processes, and business operations. Including attestation to the completeness, accuracy, and compliance of all financial reporting data, where applicable.

We are an inclusive automotive community where all are welcomed, valued and belong regardless of race, gender, age, or car preference.  We are united by our shared passion for driving, our commitment to preserve car culture for future generations and our desire to make a positive impact in the world.

raw.description:
The location for this posting is in the APAC region.
We work in English, so excellent written and spoken English is essential.

Freelancing at Human Made

Join Human Made as a freelancer and you’ll feel like part of the team. You’ll be working on interesting and complex projects, alongside some of the industry's top talent. We’re fully remote, and have been for over 10 years, so you can expect well established ways of working, and a vibrant online culture.

Once you are qualified, you'll be added to our freelance talent pool and be invited to projects that suit your availability and expertise as soon as they become available, which might not be immediately. Once you are booked on a project, you will integrate as part of the team, so you are expected to join team meetings and activities (although we have a strong emphasis on asynchronous communication).

The Scrum Master Role at Human Made

As a Scrum Master you will create self-organising teams that are flexible and fully productive during sprints, with the goal of creating high performing teams. To do this you should be able to plan deliverables and help teams monitor their performance. You should have a thorough understanding of scrum/agile concepts, and can apply them through coaching and mentoring. You understand value, as it applies to the companies we work with and its alignment with our own priorities, and you are consistent in pursuing it.

Responsibilities:

These are the main areas of focus for a Scrum Master:

Applying Scrum To Produce High Quality Work

  • Manage each projects scope and timeline
  • Create and maintain a team culture that facilitates a shared responsibility for successful delivery
  • Guide team on principles and practice of the agile framework being used in the project
  • Work with team to help define and refine project scope, estimates, and resource requirements for projects
  • Prepare and facilitate workshops (either virtual or in-person) to establish project needs and relationships
  • Facilitate meetings to monitor project progress and resolve any issues the team may be experiencing
  • Remove impediments or guide the team to remove impediments
  • Assess the time and financial impact of scope change and communicate to stakeholders as appropriate
  • Identifies when to use experiments for learning and solutioning

Accountability To The Business

  • Be commercially aware: Understand the status of the budget of your projects and be able to report on them back to the company
  • Allocation management of project needs in conjunction with your squad composition

Building And Safeguarding Relationships

  • Facilitate wider engagement with internal and external stakeholders, and partners engaged in delivery
  • Build a partnership relationship with clients, understanding their business imperatives as context for helping align the team on those goals
  • Understand the workings and needs of the account you are partnered with
  • Communicate regularly; be proactive in facing difficult conversations
  • Manage your interactions with clients and internal team professionally, and personably
  • Using data to allow the team and wider business to make critical decisions

Striving For Great Work

  • Develop creative and technical judgement and strive for high quality output
  • Share progress and communicate to internal and external stakeholders
  • Conduct team reviews and retrospectives to promote continuous improvement

raw.title: Wholesale Footwear Manager EMEA - Remote (m/w/d)
raw.excerpt: Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX: As Wholesale Footwear Manager EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sustainable commercial growth across the region while protecting the premium positioning and long-term equity of ARC’TERYX.
raw.description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:


As Wholesale Footwear Manager EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sustainable commercial growth across the region while protecting the premium positioning and long-term equity of ARC’TERYX. You will shape and execute the regional wholesale strategy, developing strategic partnerships with leading outdoor specialty, mountain, trail running and premium sporting goods retailers. You will have the opportunity to build and strengthen a high-performing regional sales organization while creating new structures, processes and commercial opportunities across diverse EMEA markets. Working across countries, channels and cultures, you will navigate the complexity of balancing ambitious growth objectives with disciplined distribution and exceptional brand presentation. This role offers the opportunity to play a key part in growing the ARC’TERYX footwear business and strengthening our credibility within the outdoor community through authentic retail partnerships, technical expertise and meaningful consumer experiences.
This role can be hired remote. Business operations occur on Central European Time (CET/CEST) and extensive travel throughout EMEA is required.

Meet Your Future Team:


The EMEA Wholesale team is responsible for building strong, long-term partnerships with our retail and distribution network while delivering sustainable commercial growth across the region. Working collaboratively across markets, functions and channels, the team is focused on strengthening our premium distribution, elevating the consumer experience and ensuring ARC’TERYX products are represented with authenticity and excellence.

If you were in the Wholesale Footwear Manager EMEA role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

  • Developing and executing the EMEA wholesale footwear strategy in alignment with global business objectives and regional market opportunities
  • Building and strengthening long-term partnerships with leading outdoor specialty retailers, mountain shops, trail running specialists, premium sporting goods retailers and selected omnichannel partners
  • Leading and developing regional sales representatives, Key Account Managers, Area Sales Managers, Technical Representatives and agencies to deliver a high-performance, partnership-led sales culture
  • Managing commercial planning across markets and strategic accounts, including annual agreements, Joint Business Plans, seasonal pre-orders, in-season replenishment and sell-through performance
  • Collaborating cross-functionally and across international markets to optimize assortments, forecasting, inventory productivity, merchandising standards and future collection strategies

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

  • Delivering sustainable double-digit growth across priority EMEA markets while protecting premium distribution and long-term brand equity
  • Strengthening strategic relationships with leading specialty outdoor retailers and key distribution partners across the region
  • Increasing footwear sell-through through stronger assortment planning, retail activation, technical education and premium merchandising
  • Improving forecasting accuracy, inventory productivity and commercial visibility across EMEA
  • Developing multi-year business plans by region, country and strategic account to identify and unlock sustainable growth opportunities
  • Elevating ARC’TERYX footwear visibility and credibility within the outdoor community through strategic retail initiatives, athlete engagement, product testing, field clinics and authentic consumer experiences
  • Building a high-performance regional sales culture focused on consultative selling, collaboration, coaching and long-term partnership
  • Strengthening distribution and channel discipline to ensure every commercial decision contributes to the long-term value of the brand

Are you our next Wholesale Footwear Manager EMEA?

  • You have a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sports Management or a related field
  • You bring 8–10+ years of international sales experience, ideally within premium outdoor, technical footwear or a related premium sporting goods environment
  • You have a proven track record managing wholesale business across multiple EMEA markets
  • You have a strong network within the European outdoor footwear and specialty retail community
  • You have experience negotiating complex international commercial agreements and developing long-term strategic customer partnerships
  • You have demonstrated success in delivering profitable growth while protecting premium brand positioning and disciplined distribution
  • You have strong commercial, analytical and strategic planning capabilities, with the ability to translate market opportunities into actionable business plans
  • You are an experienced people leader and coach, capable of inspiring sales teams, agencies and cross-functional partners toward ambitious objectives
  • You are comfortable working across multiple countries, cultures and markets, balancing regional consistency with local market needs
  • You have experience using Salesforce, SAP, Power BI, Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, CRM platforms and/or retail analytics tools
  • You are fluent in English, with German highly desirable; French, Italian or Spanish would be advantageous
  • You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions
  • You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity and a fast-evolving business environment
  • You effectively balance autonomy and collaboration while working across international markets
  • You inspire breakthrough thinking, continuous improvement and a high-performance sales culture
  • You seek the best solutions, with an unwavering commitment to leaving it better
  • Your passion for commercial excellence is matched by your passion for getting outside and maintaining genuine credibility within the outdoor community

    • This role requires approximately 50-70% international travel throughout EMEA, with a focus on Europe, as well as approximately four annual journeys to Vancouver for key company moments such as Kick Off and Leadership Summit. You will regularly engage with specialty retailers, distributors, outdoor events, athlete activations, mountain festivals and international trade shows, while participating in product testing, field clinics and outdoor experiences to maintain deep product and consumer credibility.

Equal Opportunity

Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance.
Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.
All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.

Leave it Better

We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there’s always a better way.
Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world.
Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better
Disruptive evolution. In pursuit of better. Always.
Commit. We set bold objectives and see them through.

raw.description:
Position Summary

As an L1 Help Desk Lead, you will serve as the first line of technical support—helping end users resolve issues related to Microsoft 365, account access, devices, and service requests. You’ll work with tools such as Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365 Admin Center, and ServiceNow. This role is perfect for someone looking to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced MSP environment and build a strong foundation in IT support and cloud administration.

Key Responsibilities
• Serve as the initial point of contact for end-user technical issues and service requests via phone, email, and ticketing systems.
• Troubleshoot account issues in Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including password resets, lockouts, and group membership updates.
• Provide basic support for Microsoft 365 applications such as Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive.
• Use ServiceNow to log, track, and manage incidents, ensuring timely resolution or escalation.
• Support Microsoft 365 environments under the guidance of senior staff (e.g., mailbox permissions, license verification, Intune device enrollments).
• Escalate advanced issues—such as device compliance, Conditional Access modifications, and file migrations—to L2+ engineers.
• Follow documented SOPs and contribute to internal documentation (e.g., knowledge-base articles).
• Maintain clear, professional communication with end users throughout the support process.

⸻

Preferred Exposure or Willingness to Learn
• Microsoft 365 Admin Center: license checks, mailbox management, Teams administration.
• Intune / Endpoint Manager: basic understanding of device compliance and enrollment troubleshooting.
• Conditional Access & Security: awareness of security controls and when to escalate issues.
• SharePoint/Teams Migrations: basic troubleshooting during cloud storage transitions.

⸻

Qualifications
• 1+ year of IT Help Desk or technical support experience.
• Familiarity with Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow (or similar platforms).
• Strong communication and customer service skills.
• Ability to follow processes and collaborate effectively with remote teams.
• Eagerness to learn and grow in cloud administration and endpoint security.
• Ability to create and maintain documentation (e.g., KB articles).

raw.description:
To help keep everyone safe, we encourage all applicants to pay close attention to protect themselves during their job search. When applying for a position online you are at risk of being targeted by malicious actors looking for personal data. Please be aware we will only reach out via email using the domain quanata.com. Anything that does not match those domains should be ignored and considered a security risk.

About Us

Quanata is on a mission to help ensure a better world through context-based insurance solutions. We are an exceptional, customer centered team with a passion for creating innovative technologies, digital products, and brands. We blend some of the best Silicon Valley talent and cutting-edge thinking with the long-term backing of leading insurer, State Farm.

Learn more about us and our work at quanata.com

Our Team

Quanata, LLC is an insurance technology innovation company that engineers advanced risk prediction and prevention solutions, develops risk-focused acquisition capabilities, and builds/supports a full-stack, flexible, digital & increasingly AI-native insurance platform. This helps our primary clients, State Farm and HiRoad Assurance Company, adapt to evolving market needs. Quanata, LLC is wholly owned and funded by State Farm.

As a company that prioritizes an inclusive and positive culture, we believe the core of our success is in hiring talented people — across disciplines — who want to help us make a quantifiable impact.

The Role

As a Senior Manager, Back End Engineering, you’ll lead a team of engineers responsible for the core policy, billing, and financial ledger platforms that support key product and operational initiatives at Quanata.

You’ll combine people leadership with technical and architectural guidance, helping your team deliver scalable, secure, high-performing systems. You’ll also help improve how the team operates, from engineering processes and capacity planning to technical decision-making and delivery.

Working closely with Product Management, Program Management, engineering leaders, and other teams across the company, you’ll help align technical execution with broader business goals while coaching and developing mid-level, senior, and staff engineers.

Your Day-to-Day

  • Coach, lead, and develop a team of mid-level, senior, and staff software engineers.
  • Provide architectural guidance and support technical decision-making for back end systems.
  • Partner with Product Management, Program Management, and teams across the company to drive successful product delivery.
  • Improve engineering processes to increase team efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Set and manage expectations with leadership and external stakeholders.
  • Drive team performance against KPIs for throughput, product quality, security, and performance.
  • Lead sprint and roadmap planning, capacity modeling, and resourcing efforts.
  • Stay current on industry trends and help drive adoption of engineering best practices.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree, an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 8–10 years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years of engineering management experience.
  • Experience with personnel development and performance management.
  • Project management experience.
  • Experience with sprint and roadmap planning, capacity modeling, and resourcing.
  • Strong technical architecture fluency, with a focus on back end systems.
  • Strong enterprise partnership and stakeholder management skills.
  • Executive-ready written communication skills.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in a financial sector such as insurance, banking, or investing.
  • Experience with AI-assisted engineering practices, including spec-driven development, context and harness engineering, and autonomous agentic workflows.
  • Familiarity with technologies used by the team, including Go, Python, TypeScript, GraphQL, gRPC, Postgres, Mongo, Snowflake, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS.

Salary: $249,000 to $367,000*

*Please note that the final salary offered will be determined based on the selected candidate's skills, and experience, as well as the internal salary structure at Quanata. Our aim is to offer a competitive and equitable compensation package that reflects the candidate's expertise and contributions to our organization.

Additional Details:

  • Benefits: We provide a wide variety of health, wellness and other benefits.These include medical, dental, vision, life insurance and supplemental income plans for you and your dependents, a Headspace app subscription, monthly wellness allowance and a 401(k) Plan with a company match.
  • Work from Home Equipment: Given our virtual environment— in order to set you up for success at home, a one-time payment of $2K will be provided to cover the purchase of in-home office equipment and furniture at your discretion. Also, our teams work with MacBook Pros, which we will deliver to you fully provisioned prior to your first day.
  • Paid Time Off: All employees accrue four weeks of PTO in their first year of employment. New parents receive twelve weeks of fully paid parental leave which may be taken within one year after the birth and/or adoption of a child. The twelve weeks is applicable to both birthing and non-birthing parent.
  • Personal and Professional Development: We’re committed to investing in and helping our people grow personally and professionally. All employees receive up to $5000 each year for professional learning, continuing education and career development. All team members also receive LinkedIn Learning subscriptions and access to multiple different coaching opportunities through BetterUp.
  • Location: We are a remote-first company for most positions so you may work from anywhere you like in the U.S, excluding U.S. territories. For most positions, occasional travel may be requested or encouraged but is not required. Some positions might require travel per the job description provided to the employee. Employees based in the San Francisco Bay Area or in Providence, Rhode Island may commute to one of our local offices as desired.
  • Hours: We maintain core meeting hours from 9AM - 2PM Pacific time for collaborating with team members across all time zones.

Quanata, LLC is an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

If you are a San Francisco resident, please read the City and County of San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance notice.
This role is employed by Quanata, LLC which is a separate company in the State Farm family of companies.
If you require a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner for assistance.

raw.description:
Job Description:

The Principal Database Engineer (DBE) is a senior technical leader responsible for the architecture, automation, performance, and operational excellence of NextGen's enterprise database platforms supporting cloud-first healthcare applications. This role bridges deep database engineering with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevOps practices to build highly available, scalable, secure, and observable data platforms across public cloud environments.
  • Define, architect, evolve and govern highly available, resilient, and secure enterprise database platforms across cloud environments (AWS, GCP).
  • Lead the reliability, performance, scalability, and lifecycle management of Microsoft SQL Server platforms while driving enterprise-wide migrations and modernization initiatives toward PostgreSQL and cloud-native database services.
  • Design and develop automated frameworks for database provisioning, patching, backup validation, failover testing, and routine maintenance using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management.
  • Partner with Platform Engineering to design and implement robust database release automation, CI/CD pipelines, schema versioning, and environment standardization.
  • Collaborate with application development teams to optimize database design, query performance, schema evolution, and deployment strategies for cloud-native and microservices-based architectures.
  • Establish comprehensive database observability standards, implementing telemetry, logging, proactive alerting, and performance analytics across all database environments.
  • Define and improve database reliability objectives, recovery strategies, and operational readiness practices.
  • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and drive permanent corrective actions following major database production incidents, establishing post-mortem reviews to mitigate future risks.
  • Author enterprise engineering standards, reusable automation modules, and comprehensive technical documentation to reduce operational complexity and improve platform consistency.
  • Align database technology roadmaps with business goals in partnership with engineering leadership.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging databases and data-tier technologies to recommend architectural improvements that enhance long-term reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Serve as the primary technical authority for database architecture and cloud migrations, mentoring junior and mid-level engineers while influencing technical strategy across the engineering organization.
  • Support strategic cloud initiatives across AWS and Google Cloud while remaining cloud-provider agnostic wherever practical.
  • Perform other duties that support the overall objective of the position.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
  • Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required qualifications for the position.

Experience Required:

  • 10+ years of experience designing, supporting, and managing enterprise relational database platforms in production, with extensive experience operating in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and DevOps practices.
  • Experience participating in incident response, root cause analysis, SRE initiatives, and implementing database DevOps practices like schema versioning and release automation.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, influencing enterprise technical standards, and driving legacy database migrations (such as SQL Server) to cloud-native or open-source platforms.
  • Experience supporting cloud-native applications, Kubernetes, or containerized workloads, ideally within SaaS, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries (preferred).

License/Certification Required:

  • Microsoft SQL Server certification or equivalent experience.
  • AWS or Google Cloud Professional certification (preferred).
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or equivalent containerization certification (preferred).
  • Terraform Associate or equivalent Infrastructure as Code certification (preferred).
  • ITIL Foundation or SRE-related certifications (preferred).

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Knowledge of: Expert-level Microsoft SQL Server administration, engine internals, high availability/disaster recovery (HADR) strategies, and performance engineering. PostgreSQL or other enterprise relational database platforms, including database design, query optimization, and modernization pathways. Public cloud architectures (AWS/GCP), containerized environments (Kubernetes), and modern infrastructure automation principles. Observability and monitoring frameworks, including tools like Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry (preferred).
  • Skill in: Advanced scripting and programming using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or equivalent languages to eliminate manual operational toil through automation. Database performance engineering, advanced SQL query tuning, and deep troubleshooting of distributed data systems. Influencing and presenting technical strategies and architectures to both technical teams and executive-level leadership.
  • Ability to: Influence technical strategy and translate complex technical concepts into actionable architectures across multi-disciplinary engineering organizations. Balance urgent operational support and platform maintenance with strategic, forward-looking engineering innovation. Communicate complex technical designs clearly and author comprehensive technical standards and documentation. Act as a cultural catalyst for DevOps and SRE adoption within the broader database engineering community.

The company has reviewed this job description to ensure that essential functions and basic duties have been included. It is intended to provide guidelines for job expectations and the employee's ability to perform the position described. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate. This document does not represent a contract of employment, and the company reserves the right to change this job description and/or assign tasks for the employee to perform, as the company may deem appropriate.

NextGen Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

raw.title: Working Student (m/f/d): Legal Research & Platform Implementation
raw.excerpt: Europe's private markets manage trillions in assets, yet much of the work behind them still runs on manual processes, spreadsheets, and fragmented legacy systems.
raw.description:
Europe's private markets manage trillions in assets, yet much of the work behind them still runs on manual processes, spreadsheets, and fragmented legacy systems. Investor onboarding, KYC/AML checks, subscriptions, and closings can take weeks and tie up lawyers, fund administrators, and compliance teams.

Vestlane is changing that. We build the KYC/AML and onboarding platform for funds and asset managers: one system that takes investors from first contact to closing, with screening, risk scoring, and monitoring built in and audit-ready by default. Fund managers get a faster, fully digital process; their investors get an experience that finally matches the quality of the funds they invest in.

Since 2021, we have onboarded 12,000+ investors & assets from around the world into 600+ funds, working with leading European and international fund managers. Our team combines lawyers, engineers, and compliance experts, and we work in small, senior teams with real ownership and short decision paths. If you want to shape how an entire industry handles compliance rather than maintain the status quo, you'll fit in here.

Tasks

In this role, you work at the intersection of fund law, legal research, client implementation, and legal engineering. Your analysis doesn't end in a memo: you turn it into digital workflows that run in live fund closings and investor onboardings.

  • Research and assess legal questions in the fund space: analyze limited partnership agreements (LPAs), subscription documents, and regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions, including Germany, Luxembourg, the UK, and many more.
  • Work directly with fund managers, law firms, and fund administrators to understand their existing legal and compliance processes and translate them into scalable, standardized workflows on Vestlane.
  • Implement subscription documents on our platform: build them into legally sound, production-ready digital workflows with form logic, field mapping, and e-signature integration (DocuSign).
  • Support client implementations from the first document review to go-live, and take on more responsibility for your own projects as you grow into the role.
  • Feed what you learn back into our product: spot recurring legal and regulatory requirements across clients and jurisdictions and share them with our Product and Engineering teams.
  • Work closely with our Legal & Compliance team, who provide subject-matter guidance, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our legal-tech processes, templates, and documentation.

Requirements

  • You are studying law (ideally from the fourth semester onwards) with an interest in corporate, business, or capital markets law, or you have already completed your degree. Students of business law (LL.B./LL.M.) and legal trainees (Referendar:innen) looking for a part-time role are equally welcome.
  • You enjoy working through complex legal questions, but you are just as interested in what happens after the analysis: how requirements are implemented in practice and turned into efficient, repeatable processes.
  • You work in a structured, detail-oriented way. Getting a document exactly right matters to you, because it will run in real fund closings.
  • You are curious about technology and want to get hands-on with digital tools and processes. You don't need to be a developer, but you enjoy figuring out how things work.
  • You communicate confidently in German and English, in writing and with clients.

Nice to have, not required:

  • First exposure to fund law, fund structures, or investor onboarding, for example through a seminar, internship, or a position at a law firm or fund administrator.

Benefits

  • 20 hours per week, flexibly scheduled around lectures and exam periods
  • Remote-first, preferably located in the Cologne/Bonn area
  • Full equipment for working from wherever you are
  • Structured onboarding and a fixed mentor in the Legal & Compliance team
  • Real client projects and live fund closings from an early stage
  • Fund law across multiple jurisdictions and legal-tech tooling you won't find in a law firm
  • Clear career path support after your studies

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. A CV is enough, no cover letter needed. We review every application personally and get back to you within two weeks. After that, the process is one short step: a 45-minute call where we get to know each other, talk about your experience so far, and answer everything you want to know about the role.

Questions before applying? Reach out to us directly, we're happy to help.

Role: Regional Sales Manager, Bus Division Location: Ontario Schedule: Remote, Full Time, Monday to Friday 8:00am-4:30pm Crestline Coach is a long-established family orientated organization in Saskatoon, SK, that has grown to become North America's leading ambulance manufacturer and Canada's largest supplier of small to mid-size commercial buses for transit, paratransit, shuttle, and tour applications. With safety, innovation, and durability always at the forefront of our business, we now inspire today’s industry standards. Crestline Coach has strong values that align with our culture that demonstrate a customer centric focus, leadership, integrity, family spirit, and excellence in all we do. We are seeking an energetic, customer-focused, and results-driven Regional Sales Manager to support the continued growth of our Bus Division throughout Ontario. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated sales professional who thrives on building relationships, generating new business opportunities, and helping customers find transportation solutions that meet their unique needs. Reporting to the Vice President, Specialty Vehicles and Canadian Customer Care & Aftermarket, the Regional Sales Manager is responsible for developing and managing customer relationships, prospecting new business opportunities, delivering product presentations, preparing quotations, responding to tenders and RFPs, and managing the sales process from initial contact through vehicle delivery. The successful candidate will be a self-starter who enjoys working independently, has strong business acumen, and possesses the drive to grow an established territory while identifying new opportunities within municipal, transit, paratransit, healthcare, and commercial transportation markets.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As the Regional Sales Manager, you will:

  • Develop and execute territory sales strategies to achieve unit sales, revenue, margin, and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Generate leads and actively prospect for new business opportunities throughout Ontario.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with municipal, government, transit, paratransit, healthcare, and commercial transportation customers.
  • Manage and grow a robust sales pipeline through prospecting, networking, referrals, and customer engagement activities.
  • Conduct customer meetings, product demonstrations, presentations, and site visits.
  • Identify customer requirements and recommend solutions that align with operational needs and budget objectives.
  • Respond to tenders, RFPs, and procurement opportunities within municipal and public-sector markets.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, including lead qualification, quoting, negotiations, order processing, and delivery coordination.
  • Prepare accurate quotations and proposals using established pricing and quoting tools.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Production, Customer Care, and Sales Support teams to ensure customer expectations are met.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts, opportunity pipelines, customer records, and sales activities within Salesforce or a similar CRM platform.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer needs to identify growth opportunities.
  • Attend industry trade shows, conferences, networking events, and customer functions to promote Crestline products and services.
  • Achieve customer satisfaction goals and maintain strong long-term customer relationships.
  • Provide regular sales forecasts, territory updates, and market intelligence to leadership.

QUALIFICATIONS

As the Regional Sales Manager, you will bring:

  • Minimum 3-5 years of sales experience, preferably selling capital equipment or complex business-to-business solutions.
  • Experience selling to municipalities, government organizations, transit agencies, healthcare organizations, or public-sector customers is considered a strong asset.
  • Demonstrated success in business development, prospecting, and territory growth.
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
  • Post-secondary education in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field is preferred.
  • Equivalent combinations of education, training, and experience will be considered.

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE

  • Strong prospecting and lead-generation abilities.
  • Experience managing long sales cycles and complex customer relationships.
  • Familiarity with municipal procurement processes, tenders, and RFPs is considered an asset.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or similar systems.
  • Familiarity with quoting and proposal management software is considered an asset.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects and manage competing deadlines.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

  • Customer-focused with a passion for building long-term relationships.
  • Self-motivated and highly driven to achieve results.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong business acumen and professional presence.
  • High emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills.
  • Collaborative team player who enjoys working cross-functionally.
  • Adaptable, resilient, and proactive.
  • High level of integrity, accountability, and attention to detail.

Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

The Lead Financial Wellness Planning and Advisory Services Associate is responsible for handling escalated calls, quality call monitoring, serving as a Principal reviewer and completing Best Interest Profile supervisory reviews for the multi-site Investment Service team. In partnership with leadership, the Lead Associate coaches associates to strengthen wealth management conversations and uses data and trend analysis to identify opportunities to improve service quality, associate performance, and operational outcomes. The role helps ensure a participant-focused, regulatory-compliant environment that reflects Empower’s culture, vision, values, and operating principles.

What You Will Do

  • Responsible for handling and responding to complex escalated calls including, working with the participant, researching the situation, timely resolution in partnership with Supervisory Managers, as well as related coaching with associates

  • Handle complex escalated participant calls, research issues, coordinate timely resolutions with Supervisory Managers, and provide related coaching to associates.

  • Coordinate research requests and follow up to ensure complete resolution of participant issues.

  • Partner with Supervisory Managers to resolve exceptions and complex service issues in a timely manner.

  • Monitor calls for service quality, regulatory compliance, and opportunities for associate coaching and development.

  • Coach associates on cross-selling, wealth management, and tax-exempt strategies to strengthen participant conversations.

  • Analyze call statistics, quality results, escalations, exceptions, service requests, and other operational data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Develop and communicate data-driven insights and recommendations to leadership to support operational, service quality, and associate performance improvements.

  • Use reporting and analytical tools to evaluate performance metrics and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

  • Coordinate the distribution and resolution of service requests to support timely completion.

  • Provide managers with feedback on call quality, identified issues, and associate training opportunities.

  • Complete all required elements of Best Interest Profile supervisory reviews.

  • Support leadership with the development of job aids, new-hire training, new-product training, performance metrics, and other resources.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and develop training materials, including job aids and training manuals, in partnership with management and training teams.

  • Complete fraud verification for distributions exceeding established policy thresholds, including required second-level verification prior to distribution.

  • Research and address participant account questions and concerns in accordance with FINRA and SEC guidelines, including situations involving disputed commitments.

  • Coach, mentor, train, and cross-train associates.

  • Make outbound calls as required by business needs.

  • Serve as a Principal on staff.

  • Attend required meetings and training sessions and respond appropriately to managerial feedback.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in financial services

  • FINRA Series 7, 24, 63, and 65 registrations required. FINRA Series 9/10 may be accepted in lieu of Series 24.

  • FINRA fingerprinting required

  • Experience in brokerage trading and trade approval preferred

  • Five years of wealth management experience

What Will Set You Apart

  • Analyst or data analytics experience, including experience analyzing operational or performance data to identify trends and support business decisions.

  • Experience developing reports, dashboards, metrics, or data-driven recommendations for business leaders.

  • Experience using reporting and analytical tools to evaluate business and performance data.

  • Experience with brokerage trading and trade approval.

  • Demonstrated ability to effectively handle and resolve escalated client issues.

  • Deep knowledge of wealth management and tax-exempt sales strategies.

  • Ability to coach and train associates and develop job-related resources.

  • Dependability and sound judgment.

raw.description:
When applying for roles at Tealium, please use our official careers page or LinkedIn company profile. All other sites where Tealium careers may appear may not be legitimate.

WHO WE ARE

Tealium is the trusted leader in real-time Customer Data Platforms (CDP), helping organizations unify their customer data to deliver more personalized, privacy-conscious experiences. As the demand for connected, intelligent customer engagement grows, Tealium’s leadership in CDP is translating directly into leadership in enabling enterprise AI strategies. By providing clean, consented, and actionable data, Tealium empowers its customers to accelerate the adoption of AI and machine learning, fueling smarter personalization, predictive insights, and business outcomes at scale.

More than 800 leading global brands trust Tealium to power their customer data strategies and deliver real-time, personalized experiences at scale.

Team Tealium has team members present in nearly 20 countries worldwide, serving customers across more than 30 countries. We win together with respect and appreciation for the talents required of all positions and the people who contribute to each of these. We are intentional about our WOWs (Ways of Work) culture, our investment in our team members, and how we care and connect.

With an extraordinary portfolio of investors (including Georgian, Silver Lake Waterman, Battery, and others) and deep industry experience, Tealium has the financial backing, profitability, and expertise to continue to outpace competitors and lead the way in innovation. Today, Tealium holds over 50 patents, and a few of the recent industry recognitions include:

  • A Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms

  • 2025 TrustRadius Award Winner: Buyer’s Choice

  • 2024 Invoca Partner Collaboration Award

  • 2024 G2 Leader in Tag Management & Enterprise Data Governance

  • Tealium Customer Data Hub achieved the Top Rated Award by TrustRadius (2024)

  • Named on Destination CRM’s 2024 Top 100 Technologies List for Sales

  • Named on the 2024 Best and Brightest in the Nation list

  • BuiltIn’s 2024 Best Place to Work

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Tealium is seeking a Sr. Product Manager to join the Enterprise Product Team. As part of the Tealium Product organization, you will help build and evolve products that power customer data infrastructure, activation, and insights for some of the world’s largest brands.

We are looking for a strategic, highly autonomous product leader who can operate independently, leverage AI and modern tools effectively, and drive measurable business impact. This role requires strong ownership, resourcefulness, data-driven decision making, adaptability, and cross-functional collaboration to solve complex problems and accelerate product outcomes in a fast-moving environment.

This is a unique opportunity to shape product direction, influence long-term platform strategy, and bring innovative capabilities to market that transform how brands engage with and better understand their customers.

YOUR DAY TO DAY

  • Own the strategic vision, roadmap, and end-to-end execution for complex enterprise products, operating with a high level of independence and autonomy

  • Champion data-driven decision-making by validating and defining customer opportunities through user interviews, quantitative research, and deep market analysis.Leverage data to inform your strategic and tactical product decisions

  • Leverage AI and modern product management tools to accelerate discovery, optimize workflows, and build smarter product experiences

  • Foster deep cross-functional collaboration, partnering closely with cross-functional teams (sales, customer success, and product marketing) to understand the industry, competitor trends, and market dynamics

  • Build a healthy dose of customer empathy and get into the minds and hearts of our customers

  • Bring a resourceful, creative problem-solving mindset to complex technical and business challenges, adapting quickly to new information and continuous learning

  • Work closely with research and design to validate hypotheses and create loveable product experiences that solve our customers’ biggest problems

  • Partner with engineering leaders and work directly with teams to build world-class, innovative technology and continuously ship value in an agile CI/CD environment

  • Provide ruthless prioritization, backlog management, and focus for engineering teams to deliver customer value

  • Work with internal partners to drive product adoption by contributing to go-to-market strategies, enablement activities, webinars, product demos, documentation, and more

WHAT YOU BRING TO TEALIUM

  • 7+ years as a Product Manager building SaaS products, with proven success driving customer adoption and retention

  • Experience in delivering martech products or solutions across any of the following industries: marketing, eCommerce, retail, travel, digital media, healthcare, or financial services

  • Experience building complex features with large amounts of upstream and downstream dependencies

  • Experience developing product specs, writing user stories, and identifying and prioritizing competing initiatives to deliver results

  • Previous experience in developing and growing a product at scale

  • A proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment through continuous learning and a willingness to evolve product strategies as market needs change

  • Track record of building relationships that inspire a winning spirit with cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Marketing, and Sales

  • Strong communication skills with experience articulating the strategic and financial value of new investment opportunities to senior leadership

  • You are a highly accountable product manager and show genuine care about the people, processes, and technology involved in making a successful product come to life

  • Fluency in English is required,Fluency in Russian is a plus

WAGE TRANSPARENCY

In several countries worldwide, including regions within the EMEA and APJ, employers are required or strongly encouraged to include salary ranges in job postings. While requirements vary by location, transparency is a core value at Tealium. We’re committed to providing clear and consistent compensation information to all applicants, regardless of location.

This position offers a base salary range of £80,000 - £100,000 GBP annually. The final offer is determined by job-related skills, experience, and qualifications. The role may also be eligible for a performance-based bonus and equity options.

WHY YOU WANT TO WORK HERE

At Tealium, we don’t just offer the ordinary, we provide the extraordinary:

  • Tealium WOWs (Ways of Work), our award winning culture is how with think, act and connect together at Tealium
  • Mosaic, our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion is grounded in our mosaic of diverse perspectives and shared belonging as we live in work across the US and in nearly 20 countries
  • Tealium Cares, to promote caring in our communities, 15 hours of paid work time for volunteer activities and programs is offered annually
  • Tealium Connects (remote-first working), enabling many of us to choose where we do our best work and offering new hire stipends to assist with purchasing things we need to support a successful home office environment
  • Tealium Ownership, share in the success of Tealium by becoming an owner of Tealium beginning with new hire equity grants
  • Tealium Time, paid time-off policy to offer flexibility to take time when needed and robust leave programs, including extended paid parental leave and company holidays
  • Healium, health and wellness programs to help us be our best selves in the experiences of health, physical, mental, social, and even financial well-being and wellness
  • Tealium LIFT (Learning is Facilitated at Tealium), offering a myriad of professional development opportunities with over 6,000 courses available on demand to best-in-class manager and leadership development programs
  • Health and Related Benefits Programs, offering market competitive benefits programs
Collectively, we contribute our individual pieces (identity, experiences, heritage, backgrounds, religions, viewpoints, gender and more ) to form the mosaic of Team Tealium. It is our continuing philosophy to recruit and employ the best qualified individuals without regard to race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, and/or any other protected characteristic. Tealium does not tolerate unlawful discrimination of any kind and strives to be an inclusive and respectful workplace.
The highly relevant and differentiated positioning of Tealium’s solutions makes this a unique and rewarding career opportunity.
*Offerings vary by level and location.

Under direct supervision by the Project Director, NU Peer Navigator Network, the Project Coordinator assists with the administration and coordination of all activities associated with a Postsecondary Student Success Grant (PSSG) awarded by the U.S. Department of Education. The Project Coordinator will support grant activities related to peer mentoring, supplemental instruction, and student employment in line with the goals of the grant project. In service of these goals, the Project Coordinator will collect relevant information and data; monitor and organize grant budget spending; assist with relevant clerical and administrative tasks; communicate directly with federal grant staff and other stakeholders; and support the Project Director and Co-Principal Investigators in all other grant-related duties.

Essential Functions

  • Ensure the completion of all grant-funded activities.
  • Support the Academic Peer Navigator program on a monthly basis this includes randomizing course sections in random generator, emailing instructors, coordinating peer navigator schedules, updating curriculum guides, updating course rosters before and after add/drop deadlines, communicating with OLIS to access course shells for (ENG 102, ENG 240, ILR 260, COM 103, and COM 120), and overseeing SOAR queries.
  • Assist with monthly project budget monitoring and request appropriate reimbursements/procurements.
  • Request and monitor vendor contracts and payments in Agiloft.
  • Implementation of contracted services.
  • Update project SharePoint site and other outreach materials.
  • Administer satisfaction surveys for all Peer Navigator programs, including our Academic Peer Navigator, Orientation Peer Navigator, and Dissertation Peer Navigator programs.
  • Reconcile expenses in Workday.
  • Manage facilitation and coordination of the Post Secondary Success Grant Bi-Monthly Steering Committee.
  • Manage all PNN and OPN email inboxes and inquiries.
  • Note taking at all meetings with stakeholders.
  • Event coordination, which includes booking travel, ordering food, managing points of contact, and overseeing logistics of events.
  • Schedule oversight
  • Attend all required Peer Navigator Network Meetings.
  • Creative oversight and curriculum development.
  • Other job-related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities: N/A

Requirements

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field is required.
  • Minimum three (3) years’ experience in administrative support, grant management, office management, executive support, or related positions.
  • Experience coordinating or managing federal grant programs, working with student employees and/or mentoring programs is preferred.

Competencies/Technical/Functional Skills:

  • Proficiency in data entry and completion of online reporting forms related to local, state, federal, or private grants.
  • Ability to participate as an active team member of the team and organization and work toward a common goal. Contributes fully to the team effort and plays an integral part in the smooth running of teams without necessarily taking the lead.
  • Accepts personal accountability, proactively seeks resolution for personal limitations head-on; and supports honesty and respect towards others, the company and oneself.
  • Actively seeks to influence, build effective relationships, and gain alignment with peers, functional partners and/or external partners to accomplish business objectives.
  • Develops new insights into situations; questions conventional approaches; encourages new ideas and innovations; designs and implements new or cutting-edge programs/processes. Ability to generate and/or recognize imaginative or creative solutions that generate successful outcomes.
  • Working knowledge, principles, and practices of office management/systems within a higher education environment, preferred. Demonstrates an understanding of underlying organizational issues.
  • Ability to drive towards achieving measurable and challenging goals to support organizational success. Demonstrates the ability to focus on achieving results consistent with the organization’s objectives. As a leader, develops goals based on the organization’s vision, mission, strategic goals, and objectives.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively communicate with a wide range of individuals of constituencies in a diverse community.
  • Work independently and foster a cooperative spirit within a large and/or small team of diverse cultures, while working in a fast-paced environment with multiple deadlines and frequently changing priorities.
  • Intermediate use of computers and Microsoft Office Suite Applications such as Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook. Experience using Student Information System (SIS) such as SOAR/Peoplesoft systems.

Location: Remote, USA

Travel: Travel required as necessary; less than 15 days annually.

At NV5 Digital, we help architects, engineers, and building owners make better decisions through reliable digital information. We do that by putting people on client accounts who actually know the work — not just the software.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Are you the go-to Revit expert in your office? Do your colleagues come to you when they're stuck on a workflow, a family, or a model that isn't behaving? Do you find yourself thinking about better ways to set up a project before it even starts? Do you enjoy tracing a recurring issue back to its root cause and building a better process so it doesn't keep happening?

If that sounds familiar, and you're ready to take that expertise into a consulting role where you help multiple teams get better — this is worth a look.

What makes our team valuable to clients is deep AEC knowledge — understanding what gets produced at each phase, why it matters, and what it actually takes to make a project run. We look for people who bring that understanding, whether from years in practice, in-house BIM leadership, or hands-on consulting experience.

We're seeking an experienced, highly motivated BIM Manager / Revit Specialist to join our Digital Design team. You'll work alongside a collaborative, experienced team — so you're never left alone to figure it out. Clients get the benefit of the whole team's experience, and you have real backup when things get complicated. What you bring to your accounts matters; so does the team around you.

Responsibilities

Remote, work from home. 5-day, 40-hour work week with some flexibility on working hours. Candidates can be based anywhere in the US.

We work daily in Revit, ACC/Forma, Navisworks, Dynamo, and related platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Work as part of a team serving assigned BIM Management clients — responsive, consistent, and proactive
  • Build and maintain client-specific Revit templates, family libraries, and BIM standards documentation
  • Conduct project kickoffs and advise client teams on Revit workflows, project setup, and best practices for their project types
  • Run regular project health checks — trace patterns and root causes, and recommend sustainable improvements before issues affect the client
  • Deliver Revit training to client staff — one-on-one, small group, and structured sessions tailored to their skill level and workflows
  • Set up and administer ACC/Forma environments; collaborate with client IT on access and infrastructure
  • Maintain client knowledge bases, workflow guides, and BIM resources — keep them current and genuinely useful
  • Contribute to internal practice improvement — share what you learn, flag what could work better

Qualifications

EXPERIENCE & BACKGROUND

  • 5+ years of hands-on Revit experience working in or with AEC firms, with a demonstrated ability to understand project-wide impacts, identify patterns, and improve workflows
  • Strong proficiency in architectural Revit workflows; MEP experience is a meaningful plus
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain templates, develop family libraries, and support Revit environments across active client accounts
  • Proficiency with ACC/Forma — setup, administration, and user enablement
  • Experience delivering training or technical guidance to peers or client teams
  • 2- or 4-year degree in architecture, engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience considered

SKILLS & WORK STYLE

  • You are organized and reliable — clients and teammates know they can count on you
  • You manage your own time and workload without needing someone to check in on you
  • You communicate clearly and consistently, both in writing and one-on-one
  • You follow through on what you say you'll do, and when something comes up you flag it early rather than letting it sit
  • You're comfortable working directly with clients in meetings and training sessions, from individual support calls to brief training workshops
  • You're a team player — comfortable asking for help, sharing what you learn, and contributing to a group that gets better together

NV5 offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, life insurance, PTO, 401(k) and professional development/advancement opportunities.

NV5 complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Salesforce Professional Services focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and articulate clear plans for execution of change programs.
