WHO WE ARE

Elliott Davis pairs forward-thinking tax, assurance and consulting services with industry-leading workplace culture. Our nine offices — located in the fastest growing cities in the US — are built on a foundation of inclusivity, collaboration, and collective growth. We work daily to provide exceptional service to our people, customers, and our communities. Audit and assurance services are provided by Elliott Davis, LLC(doing business in NC and D.C. as Elliott Davis, PLLC), a licensed CPA firm.

Job Summary

We’re Elliott Davis, and we’re revolutionizing what it means to work in the public accounting field. Around here we may do the work of accountants, but we think like startup entrepreneurs, social do-gooders and community leaders.

As part of the Elliott Davis team, you’ll get hands-on experience working alongside some of the leading experts in the financial and consulting field, while enjoying the freedom and autonomy to manage your career and make a positive impact on the world. Our Consulting practice is fast-growing and we are eager for you to be part of this growth!

The role of the Sage Intacct Business Systems Consulting (BSC) Senior Manager is to assist clients with their business systems, including people, daily processes and technology. The BSC Senior Manager is responsible for helping clients evaluate and improve the design and function of their business systems technology stack and look beyond the programs and applications to dig deeper and uncover any disconnects and deficiencies among these three core elements. The BSC Senior Manager will then design strategies to maximize the company’s current technology and identify more appropriate solutions, correct process efficiencies and place individuals where they can make the greatest possible impact within their organization.

This is a leadership role for the Digital Business Systems Consulting Group. Excellent leadership, business development, and communication skills are crucial for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Meet with clients to assess current business systems (people, processes and technology)

  • Prepare key findings and analysis reports on client systems

  • Quickly learn ERP systems and third-party applications, and be able to assist clients with system implementation and restructure projects

  • Oversee extensive transactional flow analysis to assist in correcting errors found and complex reporting requirements setup

  • Formulate plan and timeline for projects

  • Manage complex ERP and restructuring implementation projects

  • Convert records for input into new systems

  • Consult with clients on best practices related to their business processes

  • Review work performed by staff and provide sign off on projects

  • Attend client and networking functions

  • Prepare scope of work for projects, proposals and client engagement letters

  • Business development efforts to include identifying and meeting with prospective clients, submitting proposals and building existing client relations

  • Scheduling department workflow, client billing, and maintaining quality control

  • Supervise staff on projects and provide performance feedback

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Accounting, Business Management, Information Systems or related field

  • 10-15 years relevant work experience

  • 5+ years’ experience as a senior level leader

  • Strong communication and organizational skills

  • Business development experience

  • Strong accounting knowledge: proficiency with financial statements, inventory processes, and general ledger accounting

  • ERP implementation experience (Sage Intacct required; experience with additional ERP systems a plus)

  • Proven experience leading multiple Sage Intacct implementations from discovery, solution design, and configuration through go-live and ongoing client support

  • Ability to think “outside the box” and provide solutions to clients for various business-related tasks and analysis

  • Experience with project management, managing an implementation team, and evaluating processes

  • Ability to manage project budgets, change orders and timelines

  • Experience working with manufacturing processes and inventory structure

  • Knowledge of third-party applications that work with business applications and how to research application needs

  • Strong Excel working knowledge

Preferred but not Required:

  • Active Sage Intacct Certification (Implementation Specialist, Consultant, or Advanced certification preferred)

  • Priorprofessionalservicesexperience

  • Master’s degreeinInformationSystems,BusinessAdministration,orrelatedfield

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US

We believe that when our employees are able to thrive in all facets of life, their work and impact are that much greater.
That's right – all aspects of life, not just your life as an employee, because we understand that there's life beyond your job. Here are some of the ways our work works for your life, your growth, and your well-being:
• generous time away and paid firm holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s

• flexible work schedules

• 16 weeks of paid maternity and adoption leave, 8 weeks of paid parental leave, 4 weeks of paid and caregiver leave (once eligible)
• first-class health and wellness benefits, including wellness coaching and mental health counseling
• one-on-one professional coaching
• Leadership and career development programs
• access to Beyond: a one-of-a kind program with experiences that help you expand your life, personally and professionally

NOTICE TO 3RD PARTY RECRUITERS
Notice to Recruiters and Agencies regarding unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions without prior express written approval. Resumes submitted or candidates referred to any employee of Elliott Davis by any external recruiter or recruitment agency by any means (including but not limited to via Internet, e-mail, fax, U.S. mail, and/or verbal communications) without a properly executed written contract for a specified position by an authorized member of the Talent Acquisition team become the property of Elliott Davis. Elliott Davis will not be responsible for, or owe any fees associated with, referrals of those candidates and/or for submission of any information, including resumes, associated with individuals.

ADA REQUIREMENTS
The physical and cognitive/mental requirements and the work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical Requirements
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:
• Regularly required to remain in a stationary position; use hands repetitively to operate standard office equipment; and to talk or hear, both in person and by telephone
• Required to have specific vision abilities which include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

Cognitive/Mental Requirements
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to:

• Observe and interpret situations.

• Work under deadlines with frequent interruptions; and
• Interact with internal and external customers and others in the course of work.

raw.description:
Go Vocal is a gov-tech SaaS scale-up reshaping digital democracy. Our platform has empowered 750,000+ people across 750+ cities in 20+ countries to participate in local decision-making. Our mission is to build stronger democracies by making public decision-making more inclusive, participatory, and responsive. Recognized as Europe's Best Social Impact Startup and featured in The New York Times, Forbes, and TIME magazine, we're on track to reach 2.5 million active participants.

Most teams talk about AI-powered growth. We're hiring someone to ship it. As our AI Growth Marketing Lead, you'll own our qualified pipeline number and build the experimentation engine that finds the growth levers we haven't cracked yet — using automations, agents, and AI enrichment to run more tests, faster, than a team our size normally could.

If you love shipping, learning fast, and using AI to scale what works (not to spam), you'll feel at home here.

Requirements

What you’ll own

  • Growth experimentation

    You are our growth marketing vertical, you own the qualified pipeline KPI, and you decide proactively what we test to meet targets and scale demand gen exponentially.

  • AI leverage

    We're revisiting our funnel and nurturing system to make real use of automations, agents, and AI enrichment and personalization. You lead that work and turn it into growth workflows that are faster and better than what a bigger team could do by hand.

  • Campaigns and channel management

    Thought-leadership content distribution, GovTech partnerships, ABM, SEO and AI search visibility, paid ads (through our agency). Test them properly, find the right mix, and execute it to high standards.

  • Website ops as a growth surface

    CRO, A/B tests, technical SEO, the demo request flow. You edit pages yourself rather than filing tickets, and you let conversion data decide what gets built next.

  • Measurement

    Leadership trusts and Sales actually uses your reporting. Refreshed automatically, not rebuilt by hand every Monday.

What we expect from you

  • You are a growth marketeer, generalist by personality. Curious across the whole funnel.

  • You build with AI: n8n, Make, Zapier, Claude, Clay/Apollo, your own scripts or agents. We'll ask to see what you've made.

  • You've shipped growth experiments end-to-end: hypothesis, build, launch, readout, decision.

  • You get things done through people who don't report to you: an agency on paid, a Brand team on content, Sales on follow-up.

  • You’re hands-on with the stack: a CRM (Salesforce or HubSpot), GA4, Ahrefs, a CMS like Webflow.

  • You work remotely in Europe (CET ± 2)

  • And you care about the work itself: civic engagement, public trust, governments that actually listen. If that sounds more interesting than marketing for whatever vertical pays best, we'll get along.

You might come from demand gen or digital marketing at a B2B startup, a growth role, a full-stack marketing seat at a small company, or an agency where you ran the whole digital mix for clients. The title on your CV matters less than what you've shipped. You don't need to tick every box. If the mission excites you and you bring the drive to ship, apply.

What can you expect from us?

  • The opportunity to create social impact at scale by helping local governments engage their communities.

  • A key role in our growth from startup to scale-up (currently 50+ employees) and our continued international expansion.

  • A healthy, collaborative work culture with autonomy and ownership.

  • A diverse, international, and mission-driven team that values both purpose and fun.

  • An informal and flexible work environment, including hybrid work options.

  • Regular team events, inspiring lunches, quarterly town halls, and annual global retreats.

  • 10% of your time is dedicated to personal projects and self-development.

  • A competitive compensation and benefits package (between 57.5k and 67.5k EUR base), including o.a. 26 days of PTO, a yearly training budget, a collective bonus plan, unlimited access to mental well-being support (via OpenUp), full remote-work flexibility, and more.

👉 Go Vocal is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. While we’re proud of our cultural diversity and gender parity, we acknowledge the need for greater racial diversity in our team—and we’re actively working to improve it. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply.

Highlights

We’re hiring an AI Growth Marketing Lead to build Go Vocal’s next growth chapter and own and ship our growth experimentation.

raw.description:
About Us

Qualio is a unified quality and compliance management platform that helps regulated organizations get products to market faster with reduced risk. Trusted by biopharma, medtech, and diagnostics companies worldwide, Qualio eliminates fragmented systems that create audit delays and compliance blind spots. Our platform enables audit readiness in weeks through multi-standard automated gap analysis and evidence reuse across ISO and FDA requirements. Qualio is ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and ISO 27701 certified, reflecting our commitment to security, quality, and privacy.

The Qualio team is all-remote, and currently distributed across North America, Europe and Australia.

Who are we?

At Qualio, the engineering department is responsible for the "what" and the "how". "What" as in what should we build for our customers. "How" as in how do we delivery and operate the solution.

We are working on building a platform team providing horizontal services to vertical feature centric product teams to deliver on Qualio's brand promise - "An easy, scalable and trusted QMS".

How do we work?

We are designing our teams to own specific horizontal areas of our application. Teams are made up of a Product manager (PM), Engineering team lead and a team of engineers. Owning the area of application means everything, collaborating with product managers, customer success partners, architecture, peer engineering teams to deliver robust cloud-based solutions that drive powerful experiences to our customers.

As Werner Vogels says, "You build it, you run it".

What do we value?

In order to make this a reality we value a number of things:

  • Iterative development - Solutions are delivered as a collection of small pieces. No big bangs.
  • Test driven development
  • Clean code

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana is looking for a Senior Proofreader to help ensure every member, patient, and provider communication is accurate, clear, compliant, and consistent with brand standards. In this role, you will support high-volume marketing and operational work by reviewing content across digital, print, and direct-to-consumer channels before it reaches the people who rely on Humana for trusted health information.

A typical day may include proofreading campaign materials, validating revisions against marked-up files, checking content for grammar, punctuation, formatting, accessibility, and brand consistency, and partnering with writers, designers, project managers, and quality assurance leaders to resolve issues before final delivery.

The Senior Proofreader reviews customer-facing and internal communications to ensure content is error-free, consistent, and ready for production. This role supports quality assurance processes by verifying that creative and content deliverables meet approved copy, brand, accessibility, and regulatory standards. The work directly contributes to clearer member and patient experiences by reducing errors and improving confidence in Humana communications. The Senior Proofreader also helps teamsmaintainefficient workflows byidentifyingpatterns, documenting issues, and supporting continuous improvement.

Key Role Functions

  • Proofread marketing, member, patient, provider, and operational materials for grammar, punctuation, spelling, formatting, style, and consistency

  • Compare final content against approved source files, change requests, and marked-up documents toconfirmall revisions areaccurateand complete

  • Apply Humana brand, editorial, accessibility, and quality standards across print, digital, email, web, SMS, social, and direct mail deliverables

  • Collaborate with writers, designers, project managers, compliance partners, and quality assurance leaders to resolve content issues before release

  • Track recurring errors, share proofreading insights, and recommend process improvements that strengthen content quality and member experience


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in English, Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

  • 5+ years of professional proofreading, editing, copyediting, or quality review experience

  • 2+ years of experience reviewing customer-facing content in marketing, communications, healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another regulated environment

  • Demonstrated ability to proofread across multiple channels, including print, web, email, direct mail, social, and digital communications

  • Proficiencywith Microsoft Word, Adobe Acrobat, and collaborative workflow or review tools

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience proofreading Medicare, Medicaid, pharmacy, provider, or healthcare marketing materials

  • Experience applying AP Style, brand voice guidelines, editorial style guides, or regulated content standards

  • Experience using Workfront, SharePoint, Adobe Creative Cloud review tools, or similar project management and proofing platforms

  • Working knowledge of accessibility standards, plain language principles, and inclusive language practices

  • Experience supporting high-volume creative, content, or quality assurance workflows in an agency, in-house agency, or enterprise marketing environment

Location & Work Arrangement

  • Preferred locations: Arlington, VA; Louisville, KY; Atlanta, GA; Boston, MA; Chicago, IL; New York, NY; Tampa, FL; Nashville, TN; Dallas, TX; Seattle, WA; Denver, CO; Fort Lauderdale, FL

  • Periodic in-office work may berequiredto support collaboration, key meetings, and leadership engagement. Remote options will be considered based on role needs and candidate experience

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$86,300 - $118,700 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 09-17-2026


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

raw.description:
Job Summary

Aptive is seeking a dynamic, highly motivated, self-starting Consulting Senior Consultant to support our Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) efforts under our Rapid Decision Making Contract with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). This role is essential to the delivery of high-quality, timely training and reinforcement materials that support end-user education and awareness across VHA, and it leads coordination and execution of activities within the Tiered Hub Process (THP) team. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, execution focused consultant with strong project management, communication, research, analysis, and executive presentation abilities. This individual will collaborate closely across subject matter experts (SMEs), training leads, and project managers to deliver visually aligned, accurate, and audience-focused content that meets VHA and CPMO standards.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate evaluation and data-driven decision-making activities, including defining measures of success, tracking performance, and supporting implementation of those frameworks.
  • Serve as a project manager for assigned workstreams, ensuring alignment across teams, tracking dependencies, and driving execution to completion.
  • Plan and execute work within a scaled Agile (SAFe) cadence: author features and user stories, maintain backlog health, support PI Planning and sprint reviews, and manage carryover and cross-team dependencies.
  • Build, validate, and maintain performance metrics and operational dashboards; translate ticket, workflow, and facility-level data into findings leadership can act on.
  • Contribute across multiple functional areas (e.g., evaluation, engagement, training, and operations) to support overall program delivery and priorities.
  • Develop clear, visually compelling presentations and supporting materials that adhere to client branding and style guidelines.
  • Collaborate closely with project leads, trainers, and facilitators to clarify messaging objectives, iterate content based on stakeholder feedback, and ensure materials meet defined learning objectives and resonate with end-user needs, particularly related to education and behavior reinforcement.
  • Facilitate working sessions, office hours, and cross-team forums with clinical, informatics, and technical partners, and brief senior stakeholders directly.
  • Produce high-quality, executive-ready deliverables such as memoranda of agreement (MOAs), courses of action (COAs), concepts of operations, project plans, strategic plans, business rules, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and leadership presentations.
  • Manage tight deadlines and prioritize tasks independently.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field.
  • Minimum of 6 years of consulting experience, ideally with a top-tier management consulting/federal advisory firms, preferably supporting federal clients or large-scale process implementation, training, or communications programs. Additional preference given to EHR, EHRM, or clinical health experience.
  • SAFe Agile certification strongly preferred (e.g., SAFe Agilist, SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, Release Train Engineer, or SAFe Program Consultant), including familiarity with Jira, Jira Align, Mural, and other similar management tools.
  • ProSci Certified
  • Preferably, VA, VHA, or DoD experience with the Federal Electronic Health Record (FEHR), including familiarity with VistA/CPRS, Oracle Health, and VHA governance and escalation structures.
  • Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills at an executive-deliverable standard, including building charts, trackers, and data-driven briefings without dedicated design or analyst support.
  • Strong research and synthesis skills; able to extract relevant content from complex sources and distill it into clear outputs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex concepts for general audiences.
  • Attention to detail, proactive mindset, and strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with minimal direction.
  • Residence in the Washington, DC metro area is preferred to support periodic in-person client and team engagements.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a VA Public Trust suitability determination

About Aptive

About Aptive. Aptive partners with federal agencies to achieve their missions through improved performance, streamlined operations and enhanced service delivery. Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. We specialize in applying technology, creativity and human-centered services to optimize mission delivery and improve experiences for millions of people who count on government services every day. Founded: 2012. Employees: 300+ nationwide.

Aptive is an equal opportunity employer. raw.description:
Votre rôle

Digital Services est l'ESN d'Orange Business qui combine les expertises Cloud, Digital, Data et IA. Plus de 4 000 experts répartis dans toute la France accompagnent des entreprises et institutions publiques dans leur transformation numérique. Nous rejoindre, c'est participer à l'accompagnement de nos clients à travers des missions stimulantes et variées. Digital Services France place le Numérique Responsable au cœur de ses préoccupations, affirmant ainsi l’importance qu’elle accorde au numérique inclusif, durable et de confiance.

🟨 Vous rejoignez le pôle Conseil & Expertise Data & IA d’Orange Business et un collectif composé de Managers et d’Experts intervenant sur les sujets Data et Intelligence Artificielle les plus complexes de la région.

Notre rôle s’articule autour de 5 piliers :

  • Conseil & sécurisation du delivery : intervenir sur les projets complexes, définir les architectures et sécuriser les choix technologiques ;
  • Animation des experts : développer les compétences et diffuser les bonnes pratiques ;
  • Support avant-vente : apporter l’expertise technologique nécessaire à la qualification et à la construction des solutions ;
  • Innovation : expérimenter les technologies émergentes et construire les offres et accélérateurs de demain ;
  • Évangélisation : porter nos convictions auprès des clients et des communautés technologiques.

Passer d'un démonstrateur IA impressionnant à une solution robuste, sécurisée, maîtrisée économiquement et réellement industrialisable : c'est là que commencent les sujets qui nous intéressent.

Notre approche est volontairement agnostique : Cloud ou on-premise, modèles propriétaires ou open source, architectures centralisées ou distribuées. Nous recherchons avant tout la solution la plus pertinente au regard du contexte du client, de ses contraintes de sécurité, de souveraineté, de performance et de coûts.

🟨 Votre rôle

Vous êtes l'un des référents techniques IA du pôle. Vous intervenez en amont et sur les moments structurants des projets pour définir, challenger et sécuriser les choix technologiques.

Vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

  • Concevoir et challenger des architectures IA et GenAI
  • Définir les patterns adaptés : RAG, assistants, agents, multi-agents, workflows IA
  • Choisir modèles, frameworks et composants
  • Comparer solutions propriétaires et Open Source
  • Construire ou superviser des prototypes techniques
  • Sécuriser le passage du prototype à la production
  • Accompagner et challenger les équipes de delivery
  • Analyser performance, latence, qualité et coûts
  • Intégrer sécurité, observabilité, évaluation et gouvernance dès la conception
  • Concevoir des architectures Cloud, hybrides, on-premise ou souveraines

Vous n'avez pas vocation à développer seul(e) chaque composant d'un projet : votre valeur réside dans votre capacité à concevoir, arbitrer, prototyper, sécuriser et faire grandir techniquement les équipes.

Exemples de sujets :

L'Expertise couvre notamment :

  • IA générative et LLM
  • Architectures RAG
  • IA agentique et systèmes multi-agents
  • Orchestration et intégration des agents au SI
  • Architectures Cloud et architectures souveraines
  • Open Source AI
  • Évaluation et observabilité des modèles et agents
  • MLOps / LLMOps / AgentOps
  • FinOps IA et optimisation des consommations
  • Sécurisation des solutions IA
  • Data Governance et MDM augmentés par l'IA
  • Accélération des projets Data et migrations par l'IA

Votre écosystème technologique

Nous recherchons une expertise sur les architectures modernes Data & IA, avec une appétence forte pour les technologies émergentes.

-GenAI & modèles : OpenAI / Azure OpenAI · Anthropic Claude,...

RAG & Context Engineering : Architectures RAG et GraphRAG · Embeddings et reranking · Recherche hybride · Vector stores (Qdrant, pgvector, Weaviate, Pinecone ou équivalents),...

-IA agentique: LangChain / LangGraph · CrewAI · AutoGen ou frameworks équivalents

-Automatisation & Low-Code AI: n8n · Flowise ou équivalents · Intégration d'agents dans des workflows métier · APIs et webhooks · Automatisation de processus

Engineering & industrialisation : Python · FastAPI · APIs REST · Docker · Kubernetes · Git / GitLab,...

-MLOps / LLMOps / AgentOps: MLflow et outils équivalents · Versioning et gestion du cycle de vie · Prompt management · -Évaluation automatique,...

-Évaluation et observabilité: Ragas · DeepEval · LangSmith · Langfuse · Arize Phoenix ou équivalents,...

-Cloud & plateformes IA: Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI · AWS Bedrock / SageMaker · Google Vertex AI / Gemini · Microsoft Fabric · Plateformes Kubernetes et environnements souverains

-Sécurité & gouvernance: Sécurité des systèmes LLM · Prompt injection et data leakage · Guardrails · Contrôle des accès et secrets · Sécurisation des outils exposés aux agents · Traçabilité · AI Act et IA responsable

-FinOps IA: Suivi des tokens et consommations · Arbitrage coût / qualité / latence · Routing entre modèles · Quotas et gouvernance des usages · Optimisation des architectures et infrastructures

Le marché évolue très rapidement : nous recherchons moins un expert d'une liste figée de produits qu'un expert capable d'identifier ce qui mérite réellement d'entrer dans une architecture d'entreprise.

🟨Vos missions :

Animation des experts

Votre expertise doit bénéficier au collectif. Vous contribuez à :

  • Définir les architectures de référence

  • Organiser des retours d'expérience

Votre réussite ne se mesure donc pas uniquement à ce que vous savez faire, mais également à ce que vous rendez possible pour les autres.

Support avant-vente

Vous êtes régulièrement mobilisé(e) sur nos opportunités stratégiques pour :

  • Qualifier les problématiques techniques
  • Concevoir les architectures
  • Challenger les solutions éditeurs
  • Estimer les charges et risques

Innovation

Une partie essentielle de votre rôle consiste à anticiper. Vous contribuez à nos travaux sur :

  • Passage à l'échelle et industrialisation IA
  • Architectures agentiques
  • Assistants et automatisation des processus
  • FinOps IA
  • Open Source AI
  • Souveraineté
  • Data Governance et MDM augmentés par l'IA

Évangélisation

  • Séminaires technologiques

  • Communautés d'experts

Votre profil

🟨Votre profil :

Vous disposez d’une expérience solide dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions Data & IA.

Vous avez déjà conçu ou accompagné la mise en production de solutions intégrant plusieurs briques telles que LLM, RAG, agents, APIs, Cloud ou plateformes Data.

Nous recherchons avant tout quelqu’un capable de :

raw.description:
Job Summary

As a Senior Stakeholder Engagement & Communications Specialist supporting the VA's Center for Care and Payment Innovation (CCPI) within the Strategic Planning Division (SPD), you will serve as a strategic communications leader responsible for planning and executing high-impact engagement activities across a complex federal healthcare ecosystem. You will develop and deliver Congressional briefing materials, SES-level presentations, and guiding-coalition communications that advance CCPI SPD innovation engine efforts within Planning, Innovation & Modernization (PIM), working with other SPD components to connect pilot design, resourcing, evaluation, strategic planning, and enterprise decision making. This role operates at the intersection of federal legislative affairs, executive-level stakeholder management, and large-scale organizational change within one of the nation's largest integrated healthcare systems. The ideal candidate is a seasoned communications strategist who thrives in high-visibility, fast-paced federal environments and brings a disciplined, audience-first approach to translating complex program information into compelling narratives for diverse stakeholders. You are equally comfortable advising senior executives, drafting Capitol Hill briefing packages, and building the coalition relationships necessary to sustain long-term transformation initiatives.

Primary Responsibilities

Develop, coordinate, and deliver Congressional briefing materials, talking points, and testimony support documents that clearly communicate Center for Care and Payment Innovation (CCPI/Strategic Planning Division (SPD) program goals, milestones, and outcomes to legislative audiences. Design and execute a comprehensive stakeholder engagement strategy that identifies key internal and external stakeholders, maps influence and interest levels, and prescribes targeted communication approaches aligned to VA transformation objectives. Produce executive-grade presentations, issue briefs, and decision memoranda for SES-level leaders, the VA Under Secretary, and other senior federal officials, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and strategic alignment with program priorities. Lead guiding-coalition communications by facilitating cross-functional working groups, drafting coalition messaging frameworks, and ensuring consistent, coordinated narratives across VA program offices, VISNs, and partner agencies. Monitor the federal legislative and policy landscape for developments relevant to VA/federal value-based health care solutions that transform and improve care while reducing cost and administrative burden, and provide timely analysis and recommended communications responses to program leadership. Establish and maintain communications cadence plans, editorial calendars, and stakeholder feedback mechanisms to measure engagement effectiveness, surface risks to program adoption, and continuously refine messaging strategies.

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in government or healthcare communications and stakeholder engagement, with demonstrated success supporting large-scale federal program initiatives. Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in Communications, Public Affairs, Political Science, Public Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a closely related field required. Demonstrated experience working with or within VA, another federal cabinet-level agency, or a federal healthcare system, with direct exposure to legislative affairs, executive communications, or program transformation communications. Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and pass a VA background investigation; existing VA or federal facility access eligibility is strongly advantageous. Must be authorized to work in the United States; this position does not offer visa sponsorship. Proven track record developing Congressional briefing packages and SES-level communications products, with the ability to distill technically complex program information into clear, audience-appropriate narratives under tight deadlines.

Desired Qualifications

1. Prior VA-specific or federal legislative-affairs experience, including direct engagement with Congressional staff, the Office of Management and Budget (OMB), or the Office of the Secretary of Veterans Affairs. 2. Familiarity with VA strategic planning or innovation program objectives and/or priorities and/or data-driven and value-based health care solutions that transform and improve care while reducing cost and administrative burden. 3. Experience applying structured change management communication frameworks (e.g., Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter's 8-Step) within a federal or large integrated healthcare environment. 4. Advanced proficiency in executive communication design tools and federal document standards, including Section 508 accessibility compliance for all deliverables. 5. Master's Degree in Communications, Public Affairs, Public Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent advanced professional development in federal communications.

raw.description:
About Tiberius Aerospace

Tiberius Aerospace is a cutting-edge Aerospace and Defense company committed to delivering innovative, secure, and compliant solutions for our customers. We specialize in mission-critical technology services for government and private sector customers, ensuring excellence in aerospace systems design, performance, and compliance. To serve our nations with Strength, Honor, and Purpose - forging the systems that defend freedom and shape the future of defense.

Position Overview

Tiberius is seeking an experienced Capture Manager to lead the pursuit of strategic opportunities across the Department of Defense and Intelligence Community, from early identification through contract award.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives before the RFP drops building customer relationships, shaping requirements, running competitive intelligence, and assembling the win strategy that turns an early lead into a program of record. The Capture Manager will work closely with the cofounders, business development, engineering, and program teams to convert Tiberius's technical capability into funded, winnable pursuits.

The ideal candidate has run capture campaigns inside DoD or IC acquisition environments, understands how programs of record actually get built, and can operate with the pace and informality of a startup while speaking fluently to program offices, primes, and government stakeholders.

What You'll Do

  • Own capture strategy and execution for strategic pursuits across DoD and IC customers, from early qualification through award

  • Identify, qualify, and prioritize opportunities aligned with Tiberius's programs and technical roadmap, including bid/no-bid recommendations to leadership

  • Build and execute capture plans: customer engagement strategy, win themes, competitive positioning, teaming approach, and price-to-win input

  • Build and maintain relationships with program office, requirements, and acquisition stakeholders ahead of formal solicitations

  • Run competitive intelligence track incumbents, likely competitors, past performance, and pricing patterns to shape a winning position

  • Identify and negotiate teaming relationships with primes, subcontractors, and industry partners where capability gaps exist

  • Partner with engineering and program teams to translate customer requirements into a compelling, technically credible solution

  • Support proposal development: shape win themes, review compliance, and contribute to proposal sections as needed

  • Track and report pursuit status, pipeline, and capture milestones through the CRM, in partnership with the RevOps Manager

  • Represent Tiberius at industry days, technical forums, and customer engagements

Capture Process & Competitive Strategy

  • Lead gate reviews (qualify, pursue, propose, submit) with clear go/no-go criteria and executive sign-off

  • Develop win themes and discriminators grounded in Tiberius's actual technical differentiation, not generic value props

  • Coordinate black-hat and competitive assessment sessions ahead of major pursuits

  • Maintain a live capture pipeline with accurate stage, value, probability, and next-action data

  • Work with contracts and finance on pricing strategy and cost-realism for major pursuits

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of capture management experience in DoD or IC acquisition environments

  • Demonstrated track record of shaping and winning defense programs, from early-stage pursuits through program of record

  • Strong understanding of DoD/IC acquisition pathways: FAR/DFARS, OTAs, SBIR/STTR, MTA, IDIQ, and program-of-record transitions

  • Experience building and negotiating teaming agreements with primes, subs, and industry partners

  • Excellent relationship-building skills across government, industry, and internal technical stakeholders

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort presenting to senior government and executive audiences

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment with minimal structure, building process as you go

Preferred

  • Prior military service or direct experience supporting a DoD or IC program office

  • Active or recent TS/SCI clearance, or eligibility to obtain one

  • Experience capturing opportunities in fires, precision munitions, autonomy, or related weapons-systems domains

  • APMP Capture Practitioner Certification or equivalent

  • Experience at an early-stage or high-growth defense-tech company, not only a traditional prime

  • Familiarity with Salesforce or a comparable CRM for pipeline tracking

What We're Looking For

  • A relationship-first operator who builds trust with program offices long before an RFP exists

  • Someone who can hold both the big picture (program-of-record strategy) and the granular (teaming agreements, pricing input, proposal compliance)

  • A collaborative leader who can pull engineering, program, and executive stakeholders into a single pursuit without needing formal authority to do it

  • Comfortable being the first Capture Manager in the building

  • Bias for action balanced with the discipline to walk away from a bad-fit pursuit

Growth Opportunity

This role provides the opportunity to build the capture function for a rapidly growing aerospace and defense company from the ground up, working directly with the cofounders to convert Tiberius's technical roadmap into a funded pipeline of programs of record.

raw.description:
About Vantage Data Centers

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Procurement Department

The Procurement team is responsible for securing the equipment Vantage’s data centers require to function. The team leads these efforts from conception through commissioning, working with Sales, Operations, New Site Development, and Engineering along the way. Procurement also works closely with vendor partners to come up with a vertically integrated design, and we manage these partners to deliver the projects on schedule and budget. Vantage is unique in that our technical staff is given the responsibility and authority to directly drive the process. Our internal team can align long-term operational sustainability with value engineering and cost metrics to deliver products aligned with corporate goals. This approach empowers each member of the team to drive high- impact decisions and even more impactful results.

Position Overview

This role can be remote or based in any of our US locations: Denver, CO; Phoenix, AZ; Santa Clara, CA; or Ashburn, VA.

This role owns the global mechanical category strategy and supplier ecosystem for advanced thermal management systems supporting data center infrastructure. Scope includes chillers, cooling towers, heat exchangers, pumps, valves, piping systems, and emerging liquid cooling technologies such as CDUs and skids. The role is responsible for ensuring cost, quality, delivery, and reliability outcomes, while enabling scalable deployment across regions and reducing supply chain and technical risks.

The Director partners closely with Mechanical Engineering, Product, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, and Reliability teams to ensure alignment with design standards, capacity expansion plans, and evolving cooling technologies. This role also drives global supplier strategy, performance governance, and total cost of ownership improvements, while proactively managing risks such as long-lead equipment constraints, regulatory exposure, and technology transitions.

Essential Job Functions

  • Build and execute global category strategy for air and liquid cooling infrastructure aligned to capacity growth, reliability targets, and engineering standards

  • Map global supply base by technology and region, establishing preferred supplier frameworks and regional execution models

  • Lead sourcing and negotiations for mechanical equipment, including chillers, cooling towers, CDUs, pumps, and heat exchangers, as well as spares and service agreements

  • Develop contracting strategies including indexed commodities, bundled equipment and installation, time-and-material vs fixed-price structures, warranties, and performance guarantees

  • Partner with Engineering and Product to drive specification alignment, design-to-cost initiatives, and development of standard equipment building blocks and approved equipment libraries

  • Coordinate with Quality and Commissioning to define acceptance criteria (FAT/SAT), documentation requirements, and change control processes

  • Ensure supplier capacity planning for long-lead equipment and manage expediting, escalation, and recovery plans to mitigate schedule risk

  • Lead supplier performance management including scorecards, QBRs, reliability tracking, corrective action programs, and continuous improvement initiatives

  • Manage risks associated with cooling systems, including single-source exposure, regulatory impacts, extreme-weather resilience, and controls obsolescence

  • Drive total cost of ownership improvements across energy efficiency, water usage, maintenance strategies, and lifecycle performance

  • Develop cost models, should-cost benchmarks, and pricing frameworks for equipment, installation, and commissioning

  • Maintain contract portfolios including framework agreements, service/maintenance agreements, warranty terms, and spares strategies

  • Deliver supplier performance dashboards, risk registers, and executive-level insights on category performance and supply risks

  • Additional duties as assigned by Management

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field; equivalent experience considered

  • 5+ years of experience in category management or sourcing within mechanical systems, HVAC, or capital equipment

  • Working knowledge of advanced cooling technologies including air-cooled and water-cooled systems, pumping/hydronics, and liquid cooling architectures

  • Experience with capital equipment procurement, contracting, and lifecycle cost analysis

  • Strong negotiation, cost modeling, and supplier management expertise

  • Ability to partner cross-functionally with engineering, construction, commissioning, and operations teams

  • Experience managing supplier performance, reliability metrics, and risk mitigation strategies

  • Understanding of commissioning, acceptance testing, and product lifecycle requirements for mechanical infrastructure

  • Travel required is expected to be up to 20% but may increase over time as the business evolves

Physical Demands and Special Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Additional Details

  • Salary Range: $190,000-200,000 Base + Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)

  • This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.

  • Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Quest Software is seeking an experienced AI Software Engineer to help define and advance AI-first software development practices for a cloud-native SaaS product on the Microsoft Azure platform. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute directly to the product codebase while also helping the team adopt AI coding approaches that improve development speed, code quality, test coverage, refactoring and troubleshooting. raw.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

Equinix Fabric is the world's leading Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) interconnection platform, operating across 65+ global metros and connecting enterprises, hyperscalers, and network service providers through carrier-class ethernet. The core ethernet layer - EPL, EVPL, and virtual connections - is the revenue engine at the heart of Fabric.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to own this core ethernet services portfolio, spanning Fabric EPL/EVPL virtual connections, port and LAG management, service tokens, and Equinix Metro Connect (Fabric Metro Connect). This leader will shape how customers consume physical and virtual Layer 2 connectivity through a simpler, more unified portfolio to improve customer experience and strengthen Fabric's position as the default interconnection platform for cloud, AI, and enterprise networking.

This is a senior individual contributor role with P&L accountability, direct customer engagement, and a direct line to the product leadership team. You will define the roadmap, make the business case for investment, influence cross-functional execution, and help shape the next generation of Equinix's flagship Ethernet services.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define the 3-year vision and quarterly roadmap for Fabric EPL/EVPL virtual connections, port and LAG architectures, service tokens, and Equinix Fabric Metro Connect

  • Lead the strategic convergence of Fabric virtual connections and packet-based Metro Connect, simplifying customer choice while increasing attach, adoption, and portfolio value. Drive the ethernet services product toward higher speeds (400G+), broader metro availability, and richer service types (E-Line, E-LAN, E-Tree, multipoint)

  • Shape the MACsec, QoS, and resiliency roadmap in partnership with engineering and network architecture

P&L & Business Case Ownership

  • Own the Fabric ethernet and Fabric Metro Connect P&L - revenue, attach rate, margin, and competitive pricing

  • 7+ years of product mgmt experience, including meaningful ownership of a cloud infrastructure, networking, digital platform, or carrier connectvity products.Build and defend investment cases for major roadmap bets, including capacity expansion, new metro launches, and service type additions

  • Partner with Finance and Sales to model WTP (willingness to pay), segment economics, and pricing architecture

  • Track and report on product KPIs: port utilization, virtual connection growth, average bandwidth per connection, and customer retention

Technical Product Leadership

  • Author precise, engineering-ready PRDs for ethernet service capabilities - VLAN handling, L2CP behavior, redundancy plane design, LAG provisioning, bandwidth tiers

  • Be the internal authority on carrier ethernet standards (MEF E-Line, E-LAN, E-Tree; 802.1Q, 802.1ad QinQ, MACsec, LACP)

  • Work closely with network architecture on PE node topology, port provisioning, and the physical-to-virtual service binding model

  • Engage deeply with the API-first vision - define the OpenAPI surface for ethernet services consumed by enterprise and cloud customers programmatically

Customer & Market Engagement

  • Conduct structured discovery with enterprise network architects, cloud on-ramp teams, and carrier customers

  • Own the competitive lens on carrier ethernet peers and adjacent NaaS providers

  • Partner with Sales Engineering and Solutions Architecture on strategic deals requiring custom ethernet service design

  • Represent the ethernet portfolio at customer advisory boards, industry forums (MEF, PTC), and external events

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of product mgmt experience, including meaningful ownership of a cloud infrastructure, networking, digital platform, or carrier connectvity products.

  • Deep working knowledge of carrier ethernet: EPL, EVPL, E-LAN, 802.1Q/QinQ, MEF standards, Layer 2 forwarding, VLAN architectures

  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise and cloud WAN architecture - DCI, SD-WAN overlays, BGP, cloud on-ramp connectivity

  • Track record of owning a P&L or product line financials - pricing, margin analysis, investment modeling

  • Experience writing engineering-grade product specs that go directly into development sprints without translation overhead

  • Ability to operate at the intersection of deep technical detail and C-suite business narrative - comfortably shifting registers

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience at a NaaS provider, cloud provider, IXP, or carrier with direct data center or colocation interconnect products

  • Familiarity with Equinix Fabric, AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, or Google Cloud Interconnect product mechanics

  • Exposure to MEF 3.0 certification frameworks and carrier Ethernet OAM (802.3ah, Y.1731)

  • Experience with API product design - REST/OpenAPI - for network provisioning platforms

  • Prior experience in a global product role spanning AMER, EMEA, and APAC markets

Overview

The Proposal Manager will lead the development and coordination of client-facing responses, including RFPs, RFIs, client questionnaires, and related projects. This role is responsible for managing proposal timelines, organizing requirements, identifying content gaps, coordinating input from SMEs, and producing clear, client-focused content.

This position requires a proposal professional who can manage active pursuits with limited direction but with the support of a team. The ideal candidate can think strategically about client needs, ask effective follow-up questions, recognize weak or incomplete content, and escalate issues to internal SMEs. Strong writing judgment, project ownership, collaborative confidence, and the ability to translate complex business information into polished proposal content are essential.

In addition to active proposal support, the Proposal Manager will support content governance initiatives. This includes maintaining reusable content in Responsive, supporting post-submission audits, improving library accuracy, reducing outdated or duplicative/trivial (ROT) records, strengthening AI-assisted proposal workflows, and creating reusable sales assets that improve future response quality and speed.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage assigned RFPs, RFIs, client questionnaires, and related proposal projects from intake through submission.
  • Review client requirements, instructions, scoring criteria, attachments, portals, and deadlines to create a clear work plan.
  • Build proposal schedules, track action items, manage deadlines, and follow up with internal contributors.
  • Develop first-draft proposal responses using approved content, prior submissions, the proposal library, and other approved sources.
  • Write, revise, and tailor proposal content for clarity, compliance, client relevance,

tone, and strategic positioning.

  • Identify gaps in proposal responses and determine what information is needed from SMEs.
  • Coordinate SME input: prepare clear requests, follow up, and help translate SME feedback into client-ready content.
  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to align proposal content with solution strategy, client needs, value proposition, and pursuit priorities.
  • Support proposal compliance by checking that responses address client questions directly and follow required formats.
  • Manage attachments, exhibits, certifications, supplemental documents, and other supporting materials required for proposals with the support of the broader team.
  • Use proposal automation and AI tools responsibly to accelerate drafting, improve consistency, and standardize content while validating accuracy against approved sources.
  • Support post-submission audits to identify new, updated, or improved content that should be captured for future reuse.
  • Maintain and improve the proposal content library, including standard answers, boilerplate content, case examples, location information, solution descriptions, and reusable proposal language.
  • Help reduce redundant, outdated, and trivial (ROT) content through identification and removal or re-writes.
  • Support tagging, categorization, and content lifecycle processes in the proposal library.
  • Coordinate SME review cycles for high-use, high-risk, or frequently changing content.
  • Support broader organizational initiatives when proposal content, sales messaging, or internal knowledge assets are needed.

raw.excerpt: OverviewPosition Overview:HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market.
raw.description:
Overview

Position Overview:

HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.

The Principal Business Intelligence and Automation Lead owns the business-facing capability that turns operational data into trusted, actionable decisions across HealthEdge. This is an enterprise capability, not a reporting function: the role sets the agenda for what gets measured, what gets automated, and how the business and Technology work together to deliver it.

The person in this role operates as a strategic partner to Operations, Product, and Technology leadership — translating business priorities into data and automation requirements, and shaping HealthEdge's data strategy from the operational vantage point. The role does not own the underlying data platform, architecture, or engineering; that ownership sits with the Data & Analytics Platform team in Technology. The Principal Business Intelligence and Automation Lead owns the demand side of the equation: priorities, requirements, and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Set enterprise priorities for operational reporting and dashboards, ensuring the business consistently has trusted, decision-ready information.
  • Lead business intelligence and analytics efforts that surface insight — not just data — for Operations, Product, and executive stakeholders.
  • Identify and drive business process automation opportunities, including applying AI where it measurably improves speed, accuracy, or cost.
  • Translate business needs into clear data and technology requirements that the Platform team and other Technology partners can build against.
  • Influence HealthEdge's long-term data strategy by bringing operational priorities and real-world business context into platform and architecture planning.
  • Act as the primary business-side partner to the Data & Analytics Platform team, Product, and Technology — owning requirements definition, prioritization, and business validation of delivered solutions.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized roadmap of reporting, analytics, and automation initiatives based on operational impact.
  • Represent the voice of the business in Technology governance and planning forums where data and automation investment decisions are made.

Ownership & Partnership Boundaries:

This capability is deliberately split to keep accountability clear as it scales:

  • Principal Business Intelligence and Automation Lead owns: reporting and automation priorities, business requirements, opportunity identification, business-side data strategy input, and partnership with Product and Technology to validate that delivered solutions meet business needs.
  • Data & Analytics Platform team (Technology) owns: the underlying data platform, architecture, engineering, and technical roadmap.

Neither side substitutes for the other. The Platform team is not accountable for deciding what the business should measure or automate next; the Principal Business Intelligence and Automation Lead is not accountable for how the platform is engineered. The two roles are expected to operate as tightly coupled partners with distinct, non-overlapping accountability.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Operations, Product, and Technology leaders treat this role as the natural first call for "what should we be measuring or automating next."
  • Reporting and automation priorities are demonstrably tied to operational decisions and outcomes, not just delivered dashboards or scripts.
  • Business requirements handed to the Platform team are clear enough to build against with minimal rework.
  • The role has a visible seat at data strategy planning conversations, with operational priorities reflected in the resulting roadmap.

Required Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in business intelligence, analytics, or business process transformation, including significant time operating at an enterprise or cross-functional scope.
  • Demonstrated track record of setting data and automation priorities at an organizational level, not just executing against requirements set by others.
  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous, cross-functional business problems into clear, buildable data and automation requirements.
  • Experience operating as a senior peer to a Technology or Data Platform organization — shaping data strategy and priorities without owning engineering or architecture directly.
  • Strong record of identifying and delivering business process automation at scale, including applying AI/ML in operational contexts.
  • Executive-level communication and influence skills; credible setting and defending priorities directly with Operations, Product, and Technology leadership.
  • Healthcare technology, SaaS, or BPaaS industry experience preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience standing up or scaling an enterprise BI/analytics function from a business-owned (rather than Technology-owned) position.
  • Familiarity with modern data platform concepts (cloud data warehousing, self-service BI tooling, workflow automation platforms) sufficient to write strong requirements, without engineering-level depth.
  • Experience operating in a post-merger or integration environment where operating models and ownership boundaries are still being established.

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

**The annual US base salary range for this position is $205,000 to $222,000. This salary range may cover multiple career levels at HealthEdge. Final compensation will be determined during the interview process and is based on a combination of factors including, but not limited to, your skills, experience, qualifications and education.

raw.description:
Help Shape the Future of Global Education Through Data

At Keypath Education, we partner with leading universities to design, launch and grow high-quality online education programs that transform lives. As a global EdTech leader operating across Australia and Southeast Asia, we're driven by innovation, data-informed decision making, and a shared commitment to expanding access to education.

We're looking for a commercially minded Senior Analyst, Forecasting & Commercial Modelling to lead the forecasting and commercial modelling capabilities that underpin strategic decision making across our APAC business. If you enjoy translating complex data into actionable insights that influence growth, investment, pricing, workforce planning and business strategy, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Join Keypath?

  • Work for a rapidly growing global EdTech organisation making a real impact in education

  • Flexible "Work Anywhere" approach with remote, hybrid and office-based options

  • High visibility role with influence across executive and senior leadership teams

  • Collaborative, innovative and people-first culture

  • Access to professional development, certifications and LinkedIn Learning

  • Certified Great Place to Work in Australia and Malaysia

  • Employee wellbeing initiatives and Employee Assistance Program

  • Technology and tools provided to help you succeed

The Opportunity

This is a highly visible and strategically important role responsible for owning Keypath's enrolment forecasting, pacing and commercial modelling capability across the APAC region.

You'll lead the development of forecasting frameworks, scenario models and financial analyses that guide critical business decisions. From forecasting student demand and evaluating growth opportunities to modelling new products and investment scenarios, your work will directly influence how we plan, grow and invest.

Working closely with stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Product, Finance, Workforce Planning and Data Engineering, you'll provide the insights and models that help shape Keypath's future growth.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead Enterprise Forecasting

  • Own and maintain the APAC enrolment forecasting framework across university partners and study periods

  • Develop, refine and continuously improve forecasting methodologies, assumptions and scenario models

  • Deliver rolling forecasts, variance analysis and study-period performance reporting

  • Prepare and present forecast reviews and recommendations to senior stakeholders

  • Drive the annual enrolment forecasting process to support budget and planning cycles

Drive Performance Through Pacing & Scenario Modelling

  • Develop automated pacing tools that provide real-time visibility into enrolment performance

  • Identify risks and opportunities early through scenario analysis and predictive modelling

  • Evaluate the commercial impact of pricing changes, marketing initiatives, operational capacity and channel performance

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

Thriveworks is currently seeking provisionally licensed individuals pursuing Florida Licensure as a LMHCin Floridato provide telehealth sessions.

About the job
Thriveworks is a mental health care company founded by clinicians in 2008 and still led by them today. With 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model, we serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and we're growing. In addition to working directly with clients, we partner with health systems and primary care providers because we believe mental health is inseparable from physical health. As a clinician-led organization, we're built to support the people who do this work with the tools, community, and stability you need to build a career that lasts.

About the Role
We’re hiring licensed clinicians to provide compassionate, evidence-based care to our more than 175,000 clients across the country. You may be a good fit for this role if you’re:

  • Approved by the board as a RMHCI

  • Must be seeking independent licensure and living in Florida

  • A graduate of an approved 60-credit hour program

  • Graduate or Post-graduate work experience in a counseling setting treating depression and anxiety is required

  • Graduate or Post-graduate work experience independently conducting intakes and diagnosing (preferred) according to the current DSM-5 under a licensed supervisor.

  • Consistently available to clients for a minimum of 25 sessions with 30 hours of availability weekly

  • A behavioral health generalist who is open to treating a variety of clients, including couples and children

  • Invested in helping your clients achieve measurable progress

  • Confident working with modern clinical technology, including telehealth and EHR tools

  • A good teammate — we’re building a clinical community and value positive contributors

Compensation
Up to $60,500 based on licensure type, session volume, and bonus opportunities. Full-time clinicians are eligible for health insurance, student loan repayment assistance, paid time off, and other employer-sponsored benefits.

How We Support You
We handle the administrative work so you can focus on what you do best: providing exceptional care. That means credentialing, billing, scheduling, and marketing support taken care of for you, plus paid orientation and training to get you started. You'll build a full caseload within 90 days of credentialing, with flexible scheduling available seven days a week from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. ET.

Benefits
As a W2 employee, you'll be eligible to receive:

  • Guaranteed bi-weekly pay for completed sessions

  • FREE group and individual clinical supervision provided

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) with employer matching

  • Paid time off

  • Short- and long-term disability insurance

  • Company-paid life and AD&D insurance

  • CEU reimbursement and free in-house training

  • Student loan repayment assistance

Our Community
Being a clinician can feel isolating, especially in a telehealth world. We're built to make sure it doesn't. You'll have access to live clinical support, monthly case consultations, and a vibrant online and in-person community of more than 2,700 licensed providers. All clinical leadership is promoted from within, so the people supporting you have been exactly where you are.

Ready to Join Us?
Apply today to become part of a team that’s changing mental health care for clients and clinicians alike.


Interested in joining Team Thriveworks? We're thrilled to meet you!


With Job scams becoming more and more frequent, here's how to know you're speaking with a real member of our team:

  • Our recruiters and other team members will only email you from or an @thriveworks.com email address.
  • Our recruiters and other team members may also contact you via text or phone to schedule an interview.
  • A google meets interview invitation will be sent via email and will only come from an @thriveworks.com email address.
  • Our interviews will take place over Google Meet (not Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or any other platform).
  • We will never ask you to purchase or send us equipment.

If you see a scam related to Thriveworks, please report it to . You can contact with any questions or concerns.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
