Travel Insured International (TII), a Crum & Forster company, is hiring a Director, Business Development & Key Accounts on our Travel Business Center (TBC) team.

Travel Insured International is a leading travel insurance provider with more than 30 years in business. As a key component of our Specialty Business Unit, within the Accident & Health division, TII provides travel protection plans to help each individual travel confidently. Travel Insured International is proud to offer products to consumers and to agency partners of all sizes. We're committed to providing dependable coverage, great value, and end-to-end satisfaction for all customers.

Job Description

The Director, Business Development & Key Accounts, plays a crucial role in driving new business growth and increasing market share for Travel Insured International within the travel agency distribution channel across both consortia and non-consortia segments.

The Director, Business Development & Key Accounts has two main areas of focus: Opening New Business Accounts and Managing & Growing Top Accounts. This role is responsible for identifying, prospecting, and activating new travel agency accounts across both consortia and non-consortia channels. This includes opening new accounts both for personal production and to feed the field team (Regional Business Development Managers/BDM’s), fueling the overall growth pipeline and expanding TII's market share.

The Director, Business Development & Key Accounts, will also serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of assigned top accounts, with full responsibility for growing that book of business and increasing market share. This is one of two Director, Business Development & Key Accounts positions on the team, each managing a separate portfolio of accounts. This is an individual contributor role within the Travel Business Center.

This is a 100% remote position with regular travel required.

What YOU Will Do:

  • Identify, prospect, and acquire new top-tier and mid-tier travel agency partnerships across consortia and non-consortia channels.
  • Open and activate new business accounts for personal production and transition appropriate accounts to Regional BDMs for ongoing management, maintaining a strong pipeline of opportunities.
  • Develop and execute strategic growth plans to achieve new business premium and account targets through disciplined follow-up, consistent sales execution, and field engagement.
  • Create and deliver tailored presentations, proposals, co-op programs, and bonus override structures that drive measurable partner growth, activation, conversion, retention, and ROI.
  • Represent TII at industry conferences, trade shows, and consortium events to generate leads, expand relationships, and strengthen the new business pipeline.
  • Meet or exceed weekly KPIs for sales activity, pipeline development, and new business production.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of top accounts, with responsibility for growing revenue, market share, and overall book health.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with agency owners and key stakeholders, conducting regular business reviews to assess performance, address concerns, and identify growth opportunities.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans that enhance client satisfaction and expand adoption of additional products and services.
  • Proactively resolve client issues by leveraging internal resources and cross-functional support as needed.
  • Build and maintain relationships with travel agency owners, consortia, and key industry stakeholders.
  • Represent Travel Insured International through event attendance, networking, and speaking engagements, while providing event coverage for Host or Regional BDMs when needed.
  • Monitor industry trends, market dynamics, and competitive activity to identify opportunities and inform channel strategy.
  • Lead by example in business development, account management, strategic planning, and problem-solving.
  • Support team members in strengthening their sales and account management capabilities while fostering a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive team environment.
  • Partner with Regional Business Development Managers to onboard and transition newly opened accounts for long-term success.
  • Manage pipeline activity, forecasting, account performance, and initiative tracking in Salesforce and other reporting tools, ensuring compliance and alignment with company goals.
  • Use AI tools and data-driven insights to identify opportunities, optimize outreach, improve conversion, and deliver performance reporting to senior leadership.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What YOU will bring to C&F:

  • Influencing the Sale — Advanced ability to convince prospective partner executives and agency owners to partner with TII and, in turn, influence their advisors to actively sell TII products. Comfortable leading persuasive conversations that move prospects from interest to commitment.
  • Strategic Account Management — A demonstrated ability to build and maintain long-term relationships with top accounts and stakeholders, ensuring client satisfaction and retention while growing your book of business.
  • Relationship Management — Superior interpersonal skills with the ability to cultivate deep, trusted relationships both internally and externally. Proven success building partnerships with consortia leadership, travel advisor networks, and agency owners at all levels.
  • Collaborative Leadership & Mentorship — The ability to work cross-functionally with underwriting, claims, and other internal teams while mentoring and guiding peers and junior team members to elevate overall team performance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration — Ability to work effectively across product, marketing, finance, underwriting, and technology teams to align business development and account management strategies with company objectives and bring cohesive solutions to partners.
  • Communication & Presentation — Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to deliver polished, professional presentations that engage and influence decision-makers at all levels within consortia and travel trade organizations.
  • Negotiation — Advanced negotiation skills with the ability to structure mutually beneficial partnerships, co-op agreements, and override programs that drive measurable outcomes.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills — Expertise in analyzing complex account and pipeline data, identifying opportunities for growth, and resolving challenges effectively.
  • Resilience & Self-Direction — Maintains a high level of personal accountability for achieving outcomes. Works effectively with minimal direction, remains dependable under pressure, and demonstrates consistent follow-through on commitments and deadlines.
  • Driving for Results — Self-assured and persistent. Responds confidently to objections, does not give up easily, and maintains relentless focus on achieving sales targets, weekly KPIs, and bottom-line growth. Proven ability to analyze performance and optimize strategies to drive continuous improvement.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required
  • Minimum 8 years of travel industry experience required
  • Proven track record of acquiring new business, growing revenue, and exceeding sales targets
  • Proven track record of managing and growing large, complex, or top-tier accounts
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing relationships with travel agency owners, consortia, and industry stakeholders
  • Experience representing a company at industry conferences, trade shows, and events — including public speaking or panel participation
  • Strong understanding of the travel agency distribution model, including consortia, host agencies, and independent agencies
  • Familiarity with industry organizations, conferences, and trade associations
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including intermediate-level skills in Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and OneNote
  • Proficiency in Salesforce or related CRM platforms preferred; demonstrated ability to manage pipeline, track opportunities, and generate reports
  • Working knowledge of AI tools and a willingness to leverage technology to enhance productivity, outreach, and sales performance
  • Travel required 25%–35% of the time by car, plane, and/or train — including evenings and weekends, both domestically and internationally; must hold a current passport
  • Ability to attend multiple conferences and events per year, including international travel
  • Must be able to work independently and effectively in a 100% remote environment
  • Strong time management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment with evolving targets and expectations
  • Must maintain established weekly KPI levels for sales activity, pipeline development, and new business production

What C&F will bring to you

  • Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching

ABOUT OLIPOP

At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we’re doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that’s delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn’t be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben’s vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we’re also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we’re committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let’s write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

THE ROLE

As a Demand Planner, you own the demand plan for an assigned portfolio of customers and SKUs, and you own the assumptions behind it. You will build and publish the monthly forecast in Anaplan, quantify risk and opportunity ahead of the cycle, and bring your portfolio and your reasoning into consensus and S&OP. You are the company’s expert on order behavior for the accounts you carry, and the first person to know when something in your portfolio is moving.

This role sits inside an active transition from Excel-based planning to Anaplan. You will plan in the system, not around it, and you will help shape how the demand review cycle runs as functionality comes online. That means comfort with a process that is still being built, and a point of view on how it should work. The role carries real ownership of a forecast and real exposure to Sales, Revenue Growth Management, and Finance. It is the level where a planner stops producing a number and starts defending a position.The Senior Manager is your escalation path on complex or high dollar changes, not an approval gate on routine cycles.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Forecast Ownership

• Build, validate, and publish the monthly demand forecast in Anaplan for an assigned portfolio of customers and SKUs, including baseline, promotional lift, new item ramp, and phase-out, and stand behind the assumptions you set.
• Review the statistical baseline in Anaplan each cycle, apply overrides at the appropriate level with documented reasoning, and maintain override discipline rather than defaulting to manual entry.
• Build and compare scenario versions in Anaplan for risk and opportunity, promotional plans, supply constraints, and pricing changes, so the business sees the range before it commits to a number.
• Hold forecast accuracy and bias to target for your portfolio, review results every cycle, and come to the review with root cause on misses and a corrective action, not only the variance.
• Build launch forecasts for new items using historical analogs, planned marketing support, and account level merchandising plans, then track performance against the ramp and adjust.

Business Partnership

• Represent your portfolio in consensus and S&OP, presenting forecast changes, the drivers behind them, and the risk and opportunity attached, to Sales, Revenue Growth Management, and Finance.
• Collect and challenge assumptions covering promotional activity, launches and discontinuations, distribution changes, pricing, and customer specific plans, and reflect them in the plan with a documented rationale.
• Quantify and communicate risk and opportunity early enough for the business to make a decision rather than react to a result.
• Partner with Supply Planning on inventory position, weeks of supply, fill rate risk, and allocation decisions, and flag supply and demand imbalance before it reaches the customer.
• Become the company expert on retailer and channel trends for your accounts using internal, POS, and syndicated data, and communicate what customer order behavior is telling us.
• Support the annual operating plan and long range planning cycles with portfolio level demand inputs and scenario analysis in partnership with Finance and Commercial.

Systems and Process

• Participate in the Anaplan implementation for your portfolio, including user acceptance testing, data validation against source systems, and migration of your accounts off Excel.
• Partner with the Demand Planning Analyst on master data accuracy, reporting needs, and analysis, and escalate data breaks that affect the forecast.
• Adhere to the demand review calendar and forecast lock dates, and keep your portfolio current between cycles as conditions change.
• Identify where the cycle is slow, manual, or unreliable, and help fix it.


QUALIFICATIONS:

REQUIRED:

  • Planning Platform: Proficiency in Anaplan
  • ERP System: Experience with NetSuite for managing order, shipment, and inventory history
  • Data Analysis: Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH, and the ability to handle large data sets
  • Presentation Skills: PowerPoint proficiency, with the ability to build materials suitable for driving consensus and presenting to leadership

PREFERRED:

  • Syndicated and POS Data: Familiarity with NielsenIQ, Circana, or SPINS, as well as retailer portals such as Retail Link or Vendor Central
  • BI and Visualization Tools: Experience with Sigma, Power BI, or Tableau

IDEAL CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE:

• 3-5 years of professional supply chain experience, with at least one to two years at the demand planner or demand planning analyst level or equivalent.
• Experience owning a customer or category portfolio through a full monthly forecast cycle.
• Hands-on experience forecasting in Anaplan or a comparable integrated business planning platform.
• Advanced Excel proficiency and experience working in an ERP.
• Working knowledge of statistical forecasting fundamentals, along with the judgment to recognize when the statistical answer needs a commercial override and the discipline to document why.
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to explain an analysis to a non-analytical audience.
• Strong written and verbal communication, with a collaborative and influencing approach across Sales, Finance, Supply Planning, and Commercialization.
• Experience in a CPG, beverage, or manufacturing environment.

Nice-to-Have

• Experience through an Anaplan or comparable planning platform implementation, including user acceptance testing, data validation, or migration off spreadsheet-based planning.
• Anaplan Level 1 certification or equivalent platform training.
• Experience with syndicated and POS data sources and retailer portals.
• Exposure to annual operating plan or budget cycles alongside Finance.

REPORTS TO:

Senior Manager, Demand Planning

COMPENSATION:

$80,000-90,000 + Bonus

HOW WE WORK

We may be fully remote, but we’re anything but disconnected. OLIPOP has grown from a few passionate people around a table to a nationwide team, and we’ve done it without losing our collaborative spirit or sense of purpose.

Connection here is intentional. From cross-functional projects and IRL offsites to thoughtful Slack threads and spontaneous gifs, we make the effort to stay close, even across time zones. Sure, we move quickly, but we lead with trust, transparency, and a shared commitment to doing work that matters.

We value thoughtful debate. We give feedback with care and receive it with curiosity, knowing that real growth, both personal and collective, comes from listening as much as leading. Because at OLIPOP, it’s not just about getting things done. It’s about growing together, staying true to what matters, and building something with lasting impact.

WHAT WE VALUE

At OLIPOP, our values aren’t just posters on a wall. They shape how we show up: for each other, for our customers, and for the mission we’re chasing together.

  • Mission Connectivity: Everything we do ladders up to our shared goal: supporting human health. Whether launching a new flavor or conducting clinical research, the mission stays front and center.
  • Indomitable Spirit: When things get messy, we get inventive. We stay curious, adapt quickly, and find the path forward, most likely with a dedicated Slack thread and a beautifully overbuilt deck.
  • Lead at Every Level: Leadership isn’t about titles, it’s about ownership. We speak up, follow through, and lift each other up. If you’ve got ideas and initiative, you’ve got influence.
  • Courageous Humility: We’re confident in what we bring and curious about what we don’t know (yet). We give feedback with care, take it with grace, and know that real growth takes both.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Success at OLIPOP doesn’t come from checking boxes; it comes from living our values, staying curious, and finding energy in both the pace and the purpose. We’re building something big, and we’re looking for people who:

  • Think big, move fast, and take thoughtful risks
  • Thrive in a high-performance, feedback-rich environment
  • Value real human connection and honest collaboration
  • Are fired up by building something new, and making it better every day

Startup life at OLIPOP is equally fun and fast-paced. If you’re energized by a dynamic environment, eager to grow, and excited to help shape something meaningful from the inside out, OLIPOP is a one-of-a-kind ride.

Do you have expertise in, and passion for, Medical Affairs? Would you like to apply your expertise to impact the patients in a company that follows the science and turns ideas into life changing medicines? Join the Medical Affairs team and make it happen, as Medical Science Liaison. Together we can make this the greatest decade ever in the fight against cancer.

Business Area

A dedicated Oncology unit, this is the place to build a world-class career. Here we are always looking to learn more, welcoming the varied opportunities to expand our horizons or develop expertise. Embrace the unparalleled access to industry-leading research, technology, and pipeline product launches with a footprint in every region. Coupled with our agility and sharp focus on talent development, there is an exciting opportunity to accelerate a rewarding and meaningful career.

What you’ll do

In this function you will be a scientific expert in the field (100 % is dedicated to field interaction) with a specific focus on engaging in high-level scientific exchange, on building and maintaining at highest level scientific partnership with external experts and on understanding and uncovering unmet medical needs and on generating relevant insights.

You will help develop the medical product strategy and its implementation within the framework of the brand plan, mainly based upon the customer insights you gather in the field. Building and maintaining peer level relationship with key external experts to support understanding of the Romanian market & clinical dynamics and to engage with the medical / scientific community in a highly credible, balanced, and objective manner, representing AstraZeneca’s dedication to and excellence in science.

Other responsibilities will include:

  • Work in a cross-functional brand team as a medical-scientific expert in the therapeutic area
  • Development of solid Field Engagement Plans and x-functional Account Management plans
  • Work closely with Regulatory, Market Access, and Marketing and other functions on field related medical issues and help support the oncology compounds during the entire lifecycle.
  • Support local, regional and global AstraZeneca clinical research program and externally sponsored research projects.
  • Help create meaningful real-world evidence data generation projects in collaboration with the brand team across the lifecycle of the brands in your therapeutic areas.
  • Provide medical-scientific input on our sales promotion and other activities, including their implementation and potentially the material used.
  • Help set up and provide medical-scientific training and further education in your therapeutic area for the sales force and other AZ personnel.
  • Organization and execution of scientific events such as symposia, other educational initiatives for healthcare professionals
  • Organization of and participation in (regional) advisory board meetings
  • Build and maintain expertise in your therapeutic area by continuous education and by participation in national and international congresses and AstraZeneca events.
  • Support of the Medical Governance-Team (Medical Information / Patient Safety) in handling of external medical and scientific requests
  • Ensure compliance with all local regulatory requirements and AstraZeneca Local and Global Policies and Guidelines

Your Profile

  • University degree in a health-related or bio-sciences field
  • Good understanding of the execution of field medical affairs plans, previous knowledge and expertise in oncology and/or haemato-oncology is a strong plus.
  • Professional experience of working in the pharmaceutical industry, preferentially as MSL or within Medical Affairs in one of the therapeutic areas mentioned above; experience within Clinical research will also be considered.
  • Thorough knowledge of the local regulatory and market access requirements related to medical affairs activities.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the legal and ethical framework and the procedural guidelines that apply to the promotion and approval of medicinal products in Romania.
  • Quick self-learner, ability, and willingness to work in a team and independently.
  • Communicative competence and presentation skills
  • Very good command of written and spoken English and Fluent Romanian
  • High-level of scientific knowledge and ability to analyse and process clinical and scientific data.
  • Experience in liaising with healthcare professionals
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including communicating complex technical, scientific, or medical information to broad audience types.

· Driving license

Why AstraZeneca?

At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a phenomenal Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and fuel your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients, and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

The MES Design Specialist provides flex coverage and independent review capacity across both workstreams. This role is not a junior support role — it requires genuine OpCenter hands-on capability, because this person may be handed a mid-complexity PI and expected to move it forward independently when one of the Lead Designers is at capacity. The Specialist also serves as the segregation-of-duties reviewer for Design Review Checklists, which means they must be competent enough to identify design errors, gaps in master data, and test case coverage issues without guidance. Think of this as a third designer with a broader mandate rather than a specific workstream.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on Siemens OpCenter Execution Pharma configuration experience — including PI design, Test-PI build, sMBR development, and MES master data creation
  • Experience working in an FDA-regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environment with demonstrated understanding of GMP requirements for electronic batch records
  • Ability to perform independent DRC review (Design Review Checklist execution) for PIs designed by another engineer — this requires the ability to critically evaluate design decisions, not just check formatting
  • Experience building Test-PIs aligned to Use Cases and sBMR templates for Sub-PI testing
  • Working knowledge of MES master data: workcenters, equipment instances, classes, properties, statuses, and sMBR structure
  • Proficiency with Kneat or equivalent electronic validation management system for validation form management and incident tracking
  • Proficiency with Veeva VQD or equivalent for specification file creation and document management
  • Ability to operate independently under schedule pressure and shift between workstreams fluidly without needing to be re-onboarded to each PI

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience on a formal MES implementation program with a defined schedule and milestone commitments (not just maintenance or support work)
  • Familiarity with transport request process and TEST/VAL/PROD environment management
  • Exposure to SAP-to-MES or OSI-PI-to-MES interfaces at a conceptual level
  • Prior experience functioning in a flex or cross-workstream capacity on a multi-team implementation
  • Experience supporting engineering or E2E water runs in a pharmaceutical MES environment

Key Tools & Platforms

Siemens OpCenter Execution Pharma (required, hands-on) | Kneat (required) | Veeva VQD (required) | SAP (awareness) | OSI-PI / PI System (awareness) | Microsoft Teams / SharePoint

Sr Data Analyst I, RWE

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
    • We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
    • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Contribute to the design of RWE studies, including protocol development, ability to lead statistical analysis plans (SAPs), and other key study documents with minimal/modest supervision; must be able to lead SAP development without supervision for “straightforward” studies, e.g., treatment patterns, purely descriptive studies.
    • Apply comprehensive knowledge of real-world data sources (e.g., claims, EMR/EHR, registries, omics data, wearable data, PROs) to inform study design, feasibility assessments, and methodological decisions.
    • Strong fluency in at least one of SAS or R is mandatory.
    • Perform advanced statistical analyses using SAS, R, Python, SQL, and/or other appropriate tools, ensuring data quality, reproducibility, traceability, and methodological rigor.
    • Develop operational definitions, code lists, and analytical specifications aligned with study objectives and industry standards.
    • Prepare high-quality tables, figures, and listings (TFLs) and contribute to study reports, manuscripts, and client deliverables with clear interpretation of findings and articulation of limitations.
    • Experience in providing client-facing support, including presenting planning and project updates, explaining methodologies, addressing technical questions, and contributing to strategic discussions.
    • Demonstrate a consulting-oriented approach by proactively identifying risks, proposing solutions, and adapting to evolving client needs.
    • Manage programming timelines and analytical workstreams across multiple concurrent projects; communicate progress, risks, and mitigation strategies effectively to internal and external stakeholders.
    • Occasional support of proposal development, desk research, and exploratory analyses as needed.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Master’s degree or higher in Biostatistics, Statistics, Epidemiology, Public Health, Health Economics, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience (to demonstrate experience, explicit supporting evidence is required).
    • 5 years (minimum of 3 years) of project-based experience conducting RWE research using secondary healthcare data sources (e.g., claims, EMR/EHR, registries, hospital databases, lab/genomic data, wearable data, PROs).
    • 5 years (minimum of 2 years in a consulting setting) of hands-on statistical programming experience (e.g., SAS, R, Python, SQL) in a research or consulting setting.
    • Strong understanding of RWE methodologies, observational study designs, bias and confounding control methods, and data governance considerations.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with client-facing experience and preparing deliver-ready results and presenting to stakeholders.
    • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver high-quality outputs under tight timelines.
    • Demonstrated consulting mindset with the ability to translate analytical results into strategic insights and practical recommendations.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist

Remote | Gastroenterology | Part-Time, 40 hours/week | Rate: $6.5/hour

About the Role

This Gastroenterology practice is looking for a highly organized, patient-focused Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist to support its clinics in two locations in Texas.

This role is heavily focused on appointment scheduling and patient communication, with a high daily call volume of approximately 70 to 90 calls per day. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced healthcare environment, managing multiple communication channels, and maintaining accurate patient documentation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Appointment Scheduling

  • Handle approximately 70 to 90 inbound and outbound calls daily related to appointments for the Lewisville and Denton locations.

  • Schedule, reschedule, and cancel patient appointments while ensuring accurate and timely communication with patients.

  • Maintain and update provider schedules in RingCentral and eClinicalWorks (eCW) based on availability and scheduling requirements.

2. Fax Management

  • Send and receive faxes involving patient records, referrals, insurance documents, and other clinical or administrative information.

  • Review incoming fax communications and route documents to the appropriate provider, department, or patient record.

  • Accurately log, upload, and organize faxed documentation within the clinic's systems.

3. Language Interpretation Support

  • Provide occasional language interpretation assistance between patients and clinic staff when needed.

  • Help ensure medical and administrative information is communicated clearly and accurately across language barriers.

  • Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and accuracy when assisting with patient-provider communication.

4. Outbound Calling

  • Conduct outbound calls for appointment reminders, follow-ups, patient updates, and care coordination.

  • Contact insurance companies, referring providers, pharmacies, or other healthcare offices when necessary.

  • Document call outcomes, follow-up requirements, and relevant information accurately in the patient's record.

5. Patient Text Messaging

  • Send appointment confirmations, reminders, updates, and other approved patient communications through text messaging.

  • Monitor and collect patient responses and escalate questions or concerns to the appropriate clinic team member when needed.

  • Document relevant text conversations and patient responses in RingCentral and eCW to maintain continuity of care.

6. Billing and Payment Reminder Support

  • Contact patients regarding outstanding balances, billing reminders, or upcoming payment obligations as instructed by the clinic.

  • Provide basic payment-related information and direct patients to the appropriate billing resource when additional assistance is required.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in medical administration, medical virtual assistance, patient scheduling, front desk support, or a similar healthcare role is strongly preferred.

  • Comfortable handling a high-volume call environment, including approximately 70 to 90 calls per day.

Reports to:

Chief Product Officer

Location:

United States

About Ottimate

Ottimate is an AI-native accounts payable (AP) automation and payments platform serving mid-market, multi-location operators across hospitality, healthcare, grocery and retail, and client accounting services (CAS). We help finance teams capture, code, approve, and pay invoices with AI handling the repetitive work — across AP automation, Vendor Pay payments, and spend management.

We're PE-backed (FTV Partners) and moving fast toward a more autonomous, agentic future for B2B finance. It's a great time to join and own real surface area early.

About The Role

You'll own the strategy and roadmap for Ottimate's newest product initiatives — the categories that extend our platform beyond AP automation and into the rest of the purchasing lifecycle. This portfolio includes procurement, budgeting and spend planning, contract management, and adjacent capabilities that connect what our customers buy to what they ultimately pay. These are 0-to-1 and early-stage products: you'll define the vision, validate it with customers, and take it to market.

This role also leads our Design and UX function. You'll manage product managers and designers as one team, setting a high bar for craft and ensuring that new products feel coherent, intuitive, and unmistakably Ottimate from day one.

This is a leadership role. You'll set direction for the new-initiatives portfolio, manage and grow a team of product managers and designers, and partner directly with engineering, data science, and go-to-market to expand what Ottimate does for the finance teams who depend on us.

Responsibilities

    • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Ottimate's new-initiatives portfolio, including procurement, budgeting and spend planning, and contract management.
    • Lead customer discovery and market validation for new product categories — identify the problems worth solving, size the opportunity, and build the business case for investment.
    • Take new products from concept through launch: define MVPs, set success metrics, and iterate quickly based on customer and market feedback.
    • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of product managers and designers; set clear goals, develop talent, and build a culture of craft and accountability.
    • Lead the Design and UX function — own design quality, consistency, and the evolution of Ottimate's design system across new and existing products.
    • Partner with engineering and data science leadership on prioritization, sequencing, and delivery; ensure the team ships predictably against committed milestones.
    • Collaborate with sales, marketing, and customer success on positioning, pricing inputs, launch readiness, and early customer adoption.
    • Define and track portfolio-level metrics; use data to make build/kill/pivot decisions and communicate progress to executive leadership.
    • Represent the voice of the customer in executive planning, and represent the product externally with customers, prospects, and partners.

Requirements

    • 8+ years in product management, including 3+ years managing product managers, designers, or both.
    • Deep experience with B2B SaaS platforms; fluency in workflow, data, or automation products.
    • Domain experience in one or more of: procurement / procure-to-pay, budgeting and spend management, contract lifecycle management, or sourcing. This is highly valuable and will be weighted heavily.
    • A track record of taking new products from concept to launch — comfort with ambiguity, customer discovery, and building the case for investment before the data exists.
    • Demonstrated leadership of design and UX — either direct management of designers or a career-long, hands-on partnership with design organizations, with strong instincts for product craft.
    • Strong analytical instincts — comfortable defining metrics, reading product data, and using it to drive decisions.
    • Experience working with multi-entity, multi-location, or otherwise operationally complex customers.
    • Clear, credible communication with executives, engineers, and customers alike.
  • Nice to Have
    • Domain knowledge in accounts payable, source-to-pay suites, or finance operations.
    • Experience shipping AI/ML-powered features and an intuition for where automation should be confident and where it should ask for help.
    • Familiarity with design systems and design ops at scale.
    • Exposure to agentic / MCP-based architectures.
  • What Success Looks Like
    In your first year, you've taken at least one new product category from concept to paying customers, built a validated roadmap for the broader new-initiatives portfolio, elevated the craft and consistency of Ottimate's product design, and built a combined product and design team that ships with confidence.

Benefits

We care deeply about making Ottimate an incredible place to work and invest a significant amount of time and energy into creating and maintaining a company culture that provides our team with a generous level of support whilst inspiring them to do their best work.

The specific benefits/perks we offer are continually evolving, but currently include:

  • Salary Range: USD $175,000-190,000 per year + annual bonus.
  • Medical, Dental, Vision and other Company-Subsidized Benefits for you and your family.
  • Employer-sponsored 401(k) with company match.
  • Paid Time Off (and the encouragement to use it).
  • Annual company retreats.
  • Promote from within philosophy.

Beyond the tangible benefits, though:

  • You will be part of a growing team, at a pinnacle moment of scale for the business, and experience the excitement of working in a startup where each action makes a huge difference.
  • You will have the agency to solve difficult problems creatively, the freedom to explore work that inspires you, and infrastructure to ensure you're constantly challenged and developing.
  • You will work with sharp, passionate teammates solving some of the most unique challenges and positioning our product as a premier finance automation solution.
  • Our commitment to empowering a diverse and inclusive workforce, celebrating differences, and creating a safe space for our employees to bring their whole selves to work is second to note.
  • We are transforming entire industries using innovative technology including Artificial Intelligence, Payment Tech, and Neural Networks.
  • Our leaders lead with a people-first approach; inspiring excellence, nurturing ideas, and finding creative ways to eliminate obstacles for cultivating growth.
  • We truly love what we do and who we do it with - and we think you will too!

Ottimate is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or marital status. If you are excited about the role but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. Nothing in this job posting should be construed as an offer or guarantee of employment.

  2. Lead the end-to-end technical implementation process, mapping and configuring API connections with customers and validating setup over screen share in real time. The average implementation timeline is days, not months.
  3. Monitor logs, dashboards, and tools like Postman to identify when APIs are misconfigured or behaving unexpectedly, and independently resolve the majority of issues without engineering involvement.
  4. Draft clear technical documentation for each issue encountered, including root cause, steps taken, and resolution, to build a reliable internal record and knowledge base.
  5. Escalate unresolved or complex issues to engineering with well-documented context, ensuring a smooth handoff and minimal back-and-forth.
  6. Translate customer inquiries and data needs into clear technical tasks and configuration notes, acting as the bridge between customer expectations and technical execution.
  7. Partner with the Partner Success Managers and Clinical Support teams to align technical capabilities with customer expectations throughout the relationship.
  8. Identify recurring issues or friction points across implementations and recommend ways to simplify, document, or automate the process.
  9. Maintain a high level of responsiveness, ownership, and customer empathy across both the finite implementation period and ongoing expansion work.

Success Looks Like…

  • Quick integration timelines driving a seamless go-live.
  • High customer satisfaction scores during integration and beyond.
  • Low number of escalations needing hands-on engineering resources.
  • Accuracy and completeness of documentation.
  • Responsiveness and collaboration across technical and customer teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years’ experience in a customer-facing technical support or implementation role with an emphasis on API-driven applications. Must be comfortable working with customers’ technical teams live, troubleshooting on video calls.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads, and HTTP status codes; comfortable reading logs and API documentation to identify root cause and resolve configuration issues without engineering support.
  • Familiarity with data mapping, payload structures, or basic scripting (Python, JavaScript, or SQL).
  • Experience using tools such as HubSpot, Postman or equivalent for troubleshooting and testing API calls.
  • Technically-savvy and able to communicate technical concepts and processes to both technical and non-technical users. This is a technical support/implementation role, not a software development role, so you won’t be writing production code, but you should be able to independently resolve the majority of configuration and integration issues you encounter.
  • Experience documenting integration processes or producing customer-facing support materials for internal and external use including workflows, process diagrams and SOPs.
  • High attention to detail and organization; able to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and ability to learn new systems, data flows, and integration logic quickly.
  • Customer-first mindset: you thrive in helping customers solve problems and find clarity.
  • Experience in SaaS or healthcare technology integrations, a plus.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary: The targeted range for this mid-level position is $72,500 - $85,000 per year, DOE.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits package includes health, dental, and vision insurance with generous subsidy, company-covered life and disability insurance, and 401(k) with match for full-time, US-based employees.
  • Professional Development Opportunities: We are committed to investing in our employees' professional development and offer a variety of on the job training and growth opportunities.
  • Flexible Work Arrangements: We are a fully remote team who collaborate both synchronously and asynchronously to achieve the best outcomes.
  • Collaborative and Supportive Work Environment: We foster a collaborative and supportive work environment where employees are encouraged to share ideas and contribute to the company's success.

  • Experience using email marketing platforms such as Klaviyo, Mailchimp, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, GoHighLevel, or similar
  • Strong copywriting and editing skills, with the ability to create clear and engaging email content
  • Experience with email automation, workflows, customer journeys, and campaign scheduling

  • Comfortable analysing campaign data and using insights to improve performance
  • Experience with A/B testing and conversion optimisation
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when reviewing links, formatting, personalisation, and campaign settings
  • Basic understanding of HTML and email design is an advantage
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of email marketing activities
  • Proactive, analytical, and commercially minded, with a focus on measurable results

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

raw.description:
Head of ASO | UK | Remote
Please Note this is a fully remote role and can be based in either UK or Ireland.

BVGroup brings over 80 years of expertise to every bet, delivering technology-driven betting and gaming experiences to a global audience.

BetVictor is our flagship B2C brand, complemented by multiple partner brands we manage and service such as Heart Bingo, talkSPORT BET to name but a few. Our SaaS platform is fully developed and ready to deploy, requiring minimal setup and no complex configuration.

Join us at BVGroup and make an impact in a fast-paced, global industry. Collaborate with passionate experts, tackle exciting challenges, and help define the next generation of online sports betting and gaming.

Purpose of the role:
As Head of ASO, you will be responsible for owning and enhancing the visibility, discoverability, and performance of BVGroup’s mobile apps across the App Store and Google Play, while driving the implementation of data-led, scalable ASO strategies across multiple brands and markets.
You will be supporting sustainable organic growth by defining and executing end-to-end App Store Optimisation initiatives, in line with industry best practices and evolving platform algorithms and will be responsible for keyword optimisation, store listing management, creative asset performance, and ongoing analysis of ASO metrics, ensuring continuous improvement and measurable commercial impact.

Key Responsibilities:
• Owning and executing ASO strategy across App Store and Google Play to drive scalable organic growth.
• Increasing app visibility and rankings through keyword optimisation, metadata strategy, and ongoing market analysis.
• Managing and optimising app store listings end-to-end, including titles, descriptions, and localisation across multiple markets.
• Defining and leading creative optimisation, including screenshots, video and messaging, to improve install conversion rates.
• Analysing performance and delivering insight-led optimisation, using data to prioritise and scale what works.
• Partnering with User Acquisition teams to align Apple Search Ads, keywords and creative for a seamless install journey.
• Managing and developing an ASO Executive, ensuring high-quality execution and future capability growth.

Essential Skills & Experience:
  • Proven experience in App Store Optimisation (ASO) within a consumer mobile environment.
  • Demonstrable success driving organic installs, rankings and app visibility.
  • Strong understanding of keyword optimisation and metadata strategy.
  • Knowledge of App Store & Google Play ranking factors.
  • Proficiency in store listing conversion drivers.
  • Experience using ASO tools (e.g. AppTweak, Sensor Tower, App Radar).

How we hire:
Our interviews are a two-way process, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting know you! Our interviews are conversational, and we want to get the best from you, so come at us with questions and be curious.

In the event that we receive sufficient applications for the role, this vacancy may be subject to early closure. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible.

Description

We are currently seeking a customer-focused and technically skilled Service Desk Analyst to join a fast-paced support environment serving end users across multiple service areas.

This role is ideal for someone with prior IT support or Service Desk experience who enjoys troubleshooting technical issues, helping users, and working in a structured support environment.

The successful candidate must be comfortable supporting users across a wide operating schedule and working in a performance-driven remote environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide first-level contact and convey resolutions to customer issues.
  • Properly escalate unresolved queries to the next level of support
  • Track, route, and redirect problems to the correct resources.
  • Update customer data and produce activity reports.
  • Walk customers through the problem-solving process.
  • Follow up with customers, provide feedback, and see problems through to resolution.
  • Utilize excellent customer service skills and exceed customers' expectations.
  • Ensure proper recording, documentation, and closure.
  • Recommend procedure modifications or improvements.
  • Preserve and grow your knowledge of Service Desk procedures, products, and services.

Availability Requirements

Candidates must be fully flexible and available to support the following operating hours:

  • Monday-Friday: 7:00 AM - 7:30 PM CST
  • Saturday: 6:00 AM - 6:30 PM CST
  • Sunday: 6:00 AM - 5:30 PM CST

Please only apply if you can support rotating schedules within these operating hours, including weekends and holidays, where required.

Compensation

  • $6.50 USD per hour
  • Paid weekly in arrears
  • Independent Contract

Technical Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

To be considered for this role, candidates must have the following:

  • Stable wired fibre Ethernet internet connection (Wi-Fi-only connections are not accepted)
  • Backup power solution, such as a UPS or inverter
  • Professional headset with microphone
  • A dual monitor setup is preferred for productivity and workflow management

Hiring Process

Our hiring process includes multiple stages to ensure the right fit for both the role and the client environment.

The process includes:

  1. Resume Review
  2. Pre-Screen Questionnaire
  3. One-Way Video Interview
  4. Pre-Screen Interview
  5. Final Interview

Please Note

  • Only candidates who complete both the prescreen questionnaire and one-way video interview will be considered for this position.
  • ﻿Resumes must be submitted in English.

Requirements

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent in Science, Information Technology, or related professional work experience in IT or Desktop Support
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience working in an End User Services capacity
  • Ability to maintain composure and customer focus while troubleshooting and solving technical issues.
  • Ability to prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work successfully as part of a team.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule inclusive of holidays and weekends.
  • Proficiency in English, both spoken and written.
  • Basic skills related to hardware, software, and user provisioning/administration.
  • Basic troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Proficiency in managing both Windows and iOS environments.
  • Working knowledge of managing common infrastructure technologies and tools (Meraki, O365, Azure AD, Workspace One, Bomgar)
  • Working knowledge of Service Desk software (ServiceNow)
  • Understanding of ITIL and Service Management practices
  • Ability to communicate effectively, both written and verbally, with technical teams, business partners, and end users
  • Ability to coordinate and prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and quality.

﻿Preferred Experience

  • Experience working in a help desk or customer support environment.
  • Experience working with computer networks & internet software.

At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Jabil is seeking a Lead Site Reliability Infrastructure and Security Engineer with 7+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Systems Administration, Network Engineering, and Cybersecurity within complex enterprise environments.

  • The ideal candidate serves as a technical leader in cybersecurity, network architecture, firewall technologies, and security operations, designing and maintaining secure, high-performance infrastructures that support factory test, server validation, rack-level testing environments and security compliance.

  • This individual brings 5+ years of hands-on expertise with Fortinet and Arista technologies, delivering resilient, scalable, and secure enterprise network solutions while driving operational excellence through cross-functional collaboration and infrastructure automation.

What Will You Do?

Cybersecurity & Network Security Leadership

  • Serve as the principal technical expert for cybersecurity, firewall technologies, network architecture, and security operations.

  • Design, implement, and maintain secure network infrastructures supporting factory test environments, server validation systems, and rack-level test operations.

  • Develop and enforce cybersecurity standards, firewall policies, network segmentation strategies, and access control frameworks.

  • Lead vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, and remediation activities to minimize operational risk.

  • Drive compliance initiatives and ensure adherence to corporate, customer, regulatory, and industry security requirements.

  • Implement infrastructure hardening and Zero Trust security principles across manufacturing and engineering environments.

Infrastructure & Site Reliability Engineering

  • Provide sustaining engineering support for manufacturing server (L10) and rack (L11) test software and infrastructure, including configuration management and deployment of new product introductions.

  • Architect, Administer, support, and optimize Fortinet security solutions, including firewall policy management, intrusion prevention, and advanced threat protection.

  • Manage Arista network environments, including switching, routing, segmentation, and high-availability network designs.

  • Administer VMware virtualization platforms, including ESXi, vCenter, virtual networking, and lifecycle management.

  • Support enterprise server infrastructure, preferably HPE ProLiant platforms and associated management technologies.

  • Manage SAN storage environments, preferably NetApp, including provisioning, performance optimization, monitoring, and capacity planning.

  • Support backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions to ensure business continuity and data protection objectives are achieved.

  • Monitor infrastructure health, performance, capacity, and availability using enterprise monitoring and alerting platforms.

Operational Excellence

  • Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis across network, security, storage, virtualization, and server technologies.

  • Develop and maintain network diagrams, infrastructure documentation, security standards, operating procedures, and knowledge articles.

  • Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvements that enhance security, reliability, and operational efficiency.

  • Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, customer, and global IT teams to support production schedules and infrastructure requirements.

  • Provide escalation support for business-critical production incidents.

  • Ensure security compliance with company security policies, procedures, and departmental operational requirements.

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and knowledge transfer to engineers and technical team members.

  • Promote engineering best practices and support skill development across the Site Reliability Engineering organization.

  • Act as a trusted advisor for infrastructure security architecture, reliability, and operational strategy.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience may be considered.

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Systems Administration, Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related enterprise technology environments.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience managing Fortinet security platforms and Arista networking technologies in enterprise environments.

  • Proven experience securing manufacturing, engineering, laboratory, test-development, or industrial environments.

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks, risk management, threat mitigation, and security operations.

  • Experience leading cybersecurity compliance programs and implementing security policies, standards, and controls.

  • Demonstrated expertise in network segmentation, access controls, vulnerability management, incident response, and infrastructure hardening.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in complex production environments.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Fortinet certifications (NSE, FCSS, FCX) or equivalent cybersecurity certifications.

  • Experience with Zero Trust architecture and industrial/manufacturing cybersecurity practices.

  • Familiarity with NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, SOC 2, or similar standards.

  • Experience with SIEM platforms, vulnerability assessment tools, and security auditing solutions.

  • Experience supporting hyperscale, cloud, AI infrastructure, or high-volume manufacturing operations.

  • Experience working in global, multi-site, and multicultural environments.

Travel

  • Domestic and international travel up to 25% may be required

Sponsorship

  • This position is not eligible for immigration and/or visa sponsorship.

  • Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship by Jabil.

  • Applicants requiring sponsorship will not be considered.

What Can Jabil Offer You?

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options

  • 401K Match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Paid Time Off

  • Tuition Reimbursement

  • Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance

  • Commuter Benefits

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Pet Insurance

  • Adoption Assistance

  • Annual Merit Increases

  • Community Volunteer Opportunities

The pay range for this role is $100,100 - $180,200. Job Title:

Senior Specialist, Talent Acquisition Recruiter

Job Description:

Sr. Specialist, Talent Acquisition

Core Purpose

The Recruiter plays a critical role in ensuring Entegris has the talent needed to meet current and future business demands. This position focuses on both professional and hourly Operations, Engineering and R&D hiring across multiple sites while acting as a utility player who can support all job types during peak demand. The Recruiter proactively identifies, attracts, and engages in high quality passive and active talent, partnering closely with hiring managers, HR, and Talent Acquisition leadership to deliver timely, high impact hiring outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage full life-cycle recruiting for Operations, Engineering and R&D, and other roles as needed across multiple locations.

  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, timelines, and competencies; set expectations based on market conditions.

  • Source and engage passive candidates using job boards, social networks, databases, web mining, and non-traditional channels.

  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-volume and technical roles to support future workforce needs.

  • Review applications, conduct screens, coordinate interviews, and manage candidates through all hiring stages.

  • Ensure data accuracy and process discipline within Workday and other recruiting tools.

  • Provide regular communication and progress updates to hiring managers, HR partners, and TA leadership.

  • Deliver a high-quality candidate experience through timely communication and professional engagement.

  • Participate in TA projects focused on process enhancement or scaling support for business growth.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Strong sourcing/hunting capabilities with experience recruiting in high-volume or technical environments.

  • Proven ability to partner with and influence hiring managers to drive aligned decisions.

  • Solid understanding of ATS platforms (Workday preferred) and modern sourcing tools.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic setting with strong prioritization and time management skills.

  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Problem-solving skills with the ability to assess candidate markets and provide insights to hiring teams.

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; prior corporate recruiting experience required.

  • Knowledge of the chemical, plastics, or semiconductor industry is a plus.

  • Ability to anticipate hiring constraints and develop solutions proactively.

  • Comfortable navigating complex or changing business demands.

  • Strong consultative skills with the ability to influence hiring managers.

Job Title: Senior SAP ABAP Developer (Digital Manufacturing Integration)
Location: Remote / Global Travel Required
Experience Level: 8–12+ Years

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior SAP ABAP Developer to support the global upgrade and implementation of our digital manufacturing platform (SAP MII/ME). In this role, you will be the core backend developer responsible for building and optimizing the ERP-side interfaces, custom extensions, and cloud-readiness strategies required to fuel our shop-floor systems. Working with a premier Aerospace & Defense client, you will leverage current ECC instances and they transition to S/4HANA and SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) to ensure seamless, high-performance, and secure data exchange between the enterprise core and MII/ME layers.

Core Responsibilities

  • ECC & S/4HANA Core & Integration Development: Develop, optimize, and maintain modern interfaces utilizing OData services, CDS Views, and AMDP (ABAP Managed Database Procedures) to connect S/4HANA with SAP MII and SAP ME.
  • SAP BTP Extension & Integration: Design and build clean-core extensions, APIs, and integration flows on SAP BTP to orchestrate data between S/4HANA and shop-floor solutions.
  • ERP Custom Enhancement: Create custom ABAP objects, User Exits, BADIs, and Enhancement Spots within core S/4HANA manufacturing modules (PP, QM, MM, PM) using RAP (ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model) or modern extensibility frameworks.
  • Performance Tuning: Troubleshoot, profile, and optimize complex ABAP code and S/4HANA database queries to handle high-volume, real-time data transmissions without latency.
  • A&D Regulatory Adherence: Ensure all custom code, BTP applications, and data structures strictly comply with defense-specific compliance mandates, including ITAR data segregation and secure cloud standards.
  • Technical Collaboration: Partner closely with the Lead Functional Consultant and Principal SAP MII/ME Architect to translate technical specifications into secure, scalable S/4HANA and BTP solutions.

Technical Qualifications

  • ABAP on ECC & S/4HANA migration Expertise: 8–12+ years of advanced SAP ABAP programming experience, with minimum 1-2 projects (3+ years) of hands-on experience migrating & developing natively inside an SAP S/4HANA environment.
  • SAP BTP Proficiency: Practical experience with SAP BTP services (such as SAP Integration Suite, Extension Suite, or BTP ABAP Environment) to develop side-by-side or decoupled extensions.
  • Modern SAP Development Stack: Deep expertise in building CDS Views, OData services, AMDP, and applying SAP's "Clean Core" development principles.
  • Manufacturing Module Knowledge: Deep technical understanding of the underlying database tables and logic inside S/4HANA PP (Production Planning), QM (Quality Management), and MM (Materials Management).
  • Shop-Floor Context: Prior experience developing code specifically designed to interact with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) or SAP MII/ME layers (excluding SCADA).

Soft Skills & Compliance

  • Strong analytical skills with a precise attention to detail required for the highly regulated A&D industry.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across global, distributed technical teams.
  • Due to ITAR regulations and defense contract restrictions, US Citizenship or specific regional security clearances may be required.

Remote (based in Chicago, Dallas, Houston, or Austin) • Full Time • Senior

Manatee is a virtual mental health clinic for kids and families. We partner with pediatricians and health systems to connect families to care, fast. As our Head of Provider Partnerships, you'll set the strategy for how we grow provider relationships across key markets, including Illinois and Texas. You own the partnerships and coach a distributed team toward the metrics that get Manatee to our ambitious financial goals that allow us to scale and serve more families. This is a senior role, reporting into our CEO, and built for someone who is as comfortable setting the strategy in the leadership meeting as they are driving to a pediatrician's office. You’ll spend half your time on the road building relationships in-person, the rest working from home on strategy, team coaching, and follow-through to close, nurture, and grow our referral partnerships.

What You'll Do:

  • Set the Strategy: Own how Manatee grows provider and referral partnerships across Illinois and Texas: where to invest, which practices and health systems to prioritize, and how the team gets there.
  • Lead and Develop the Team: Manage and coach a distributed team of five: Provider Partnerships Associates (BDRs) and the Provider Success Manager), with dotted-line guidance to Marketing. Set goals, run pipeline reviews, and coach your team toward the monthly and quarterly metrics that get Manatee to our goals for growth and impact.
  • Build Relationships Yourself: Conduct your own outreach and in-person meetings with physician practices and health systems. You're a strategic partner, not a door-to-door sales rep. You use data and a real understanding of pediatric behavioral-health referral patterns to have credible, high-impact conversations with skeptical gatekeeper pediatricians who care deeply about their patients and families, you aren’t just there to hard-pitch a rigid solution.
  • Grow the Partner Base: Drive new pediatrician and health-system partnerships from first contact to signed, active referral relationships. You'll personally carry a monthly new-partnership quota alongside your team. You know when to strategically leverage the Founder and CEO for a key, large group kickoff or close, but handle 90% of deals yourself.
  • Own the Engine, Don't Just Manage It: You will keep the CRM and territory pipeline honest. When something needs fixing: a CRM workflow, an associate's pipeline discipline, or marketing that isn’t landing, you're comfortable rolling up your sleeves and hands-on coaching, or bringing it across the line yourself when necessary.
  • Manage Up: Report metrics and progress to Manatee's CEO and Head of Operations, translating what you're seeing in the field into the decisions leadership needs to make. This role exists to create space for the Founder to stay focused on carrier partnerships, market-building, and investor relations.

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years in a quota-carrying sales, business development, or partnerships role
  • At least 5 years specifically in healthcare sales or partnerships, working directly with care providers or physicians
  • Proven experience coaching and developing a team toward measurable sales or partnership targets
  • A strategic operator's mindset, just as willing to optimize a CRM workflow or coach an Associate one-on-one as to set strategy
  • Comfortable with in-person selling and building relationships face-to-face
  • Reliable personal transportation for local relationship-building in your home market (mileage reimbursed); available for meaningful travel to our other core markets — expect roughly 40–50% travel, concentrated on in-person partnership building
  • Comfortable remotely managing people and markets across the country
  • HubSpot or similar CRM experience
  • A track record of hitting partnership or revenue targets you personally owned

Why Manatee:

  • Mission and impact: Your team's work connects families to life-changing care
  • High Growth Environment: Join a fast-scaling company at a pivotal moment: your team's performance is directly tied to Manatee's path to growth and ability to serve more families, with real room to grow in the role and company impact.
  • Ownership: Take the reins of a growing field team, and shape where it goes next as we expand in growth markets.

Compensation: Base $135,000 - 150,000; OTE $250,000-$300,000

Thriveworks is currently seeking provisionally licensed individuals pursuing Pennsylvania Licensure as a LCSW in Pennsylvania to provide telehealth sessions.

About the job
Thriveworks is a mental health care company founded by clinicians in 2008 and still led by them today. With 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model, we serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and we're growing. In addition to working directly with clients, we partner with health systems and primary care providers because we believe mental health is inseparable from physical health. As a clinician-led organization, we're built to support the people who do this work with the tools, community, and stability you need to build a career that lasts.

About the Role
We’re hiring licensed clinicians to provide compassionate, evidence-based care to our more than 175,000 clients across the country. You may be a good fit for this role if you’re:

  • Approved by the board as a LSW

  • Must be seeking independent licensure and living in Pennsylvania

  • A graduate of an approved 60-credit hour program

  • Graduate or Post-graduate work experience in a counseling setting treating depression and anxiety is required

  • Graduate or Post-graduate work experience independently conducting intakes and diagnosing (preferred) according to the current DSM-5 under a licensed supervisor.

  • Consistently available to clients for a minimum of 25 sessions with 30 hours of availability weekly

  • A behavioral health generalist who is open to treating a variety of clients, including couples and children

  • Invested in helping your clients achieve measurable progress

  • Confident working with modern clinical technology, including telehealth and EHR tools

  • A good teammate — we’re building a clinical community and value positive contributors

Compensation
Up to $51,700 based on licensure type, session volume, and bonus opportunities. Full-time clinicians are eligible for health insurance, student loan repayment assistance, paid time off, and other employer-sponsored benefits.

How We Support You
We handle the administrative work so you can focus on what you do best: providing exceptional care. That means credentialing, billing, scheduling, and marketing support taken care of for you, plus paid orientation and training to get you started. You'll build a full caseload within 90 days of credentialing, with flexible scheduling available seven days a week from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. ET.

Benefits
As a W2 employee, you'll be eligible to receive:

  • Guaranteed bi-weekly pay for completed sessions

  • FREE group and individual clinical supervision provided

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) with employer matching

  • Paid time off

  • Short- and long-term disability insurance

  • Company-paid life and AD&D insurance

  • CEU reimbursement and free in-house training

  • Student loan repayment assistance

Our Community
Being a clinician can feel isolating, especially in a telehealth world. We're built to make sure it doesn't. You'll have access to live clinical support, monthly case consultations, and a vibrant online and in-person community of more than 2,700 licensed providers. All clinical leadership is promoted from within, so the people supporting you have been exactly where you are.

Ready to Join Us?
Apply today to become part of a team that’s changing mental health care for clients and clinicians alike.


Interested in joining Team Thriveworks? We're thrilled to meet you!


With Job scams becoming more and more frequent, here's how to know you're speaking with a real member of our team:

  • Our recruiters and other team members will only email you from or an @thriveworks.com email address.
  • Our recruiters and other team members may also contact you via text or phone to schedule an interview.
  • A google meets interview invitation will be sent via email and will only come from an @thriveworks.com email address.
  • Our interviews will take place over Google Meet (not Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or any other platform).
  • We will never ask you to purchase or send us equipment.

If you see a scam related to Thriveworks, please report it to . You can contact with any questions or concerns.


Thriveworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our people are our most valuable assets. We embrace and encourage differences in age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, national origin, physical and mental ability, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, and other characteristics that make our employees unique. We encourage and welcome diverse candidates to apply for any position you are qualified for to bring your unique perspective to our team.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship, either now or in the future.
